description: The space within the roof structure, used for insulation, storage, or conversion into habitable rooms.

name: Internal Partition Wall
description: Non-loadbearing walls that divide the household floor plate into individual rooms and spaces.

name: Loadbearing Wall
description: Structural walls that transfer floor and roof loads to the foundations, defining the structural envelope of the household.

name: Floor Structure / Slab
description: The horizontal structural element forming the floor deck of each storey within the household.

name: Roof Structure
description: The structural assembly at the top of the household that supports the roof covering and weatherproofing layers.

name: External Door
description: Doors providing access between the household interior and the external environment, including front and back doors.

name: Internal Door
description: Doors separating rooms within the household, providing privacy and acoustic separation between spaces.

name: Staircase Assembly
description: The structural and finishing elements of the stairs including treads, risers, stringers, handrails, and balustrading.

name: Kitchen Cabinetry & Fittings
description: Fitted units, worktops, and built-in appliance housings that make up the kitchen installation.

name: Sanitary Ware
description: Fixed bathroom and WC fittings including baths, showers, basins, and toilets installed within wet rooms.

name: Heating, Ventilation & Air Conditioning (HVAC) System
description: The integrated system providing thermal comfort and air quality control throughout the household.

name: Domestic Hot Water System
description: The system supplying hot water to taps and showers, typically via a boiler, cylinder, or heat pump.

name: Electrical Wiring & Distribution System
description: The complete electrical infrastructure supplying power, lighting, and data outlets to all household spaces.

name: Cold & Hot Water Plumbing System
description: Pipework and fittings distributing cold mains and hot water to all sanitary and kitchen points of use.

name: Drainage & Waste Water System
description: The below-floor and above-ground pipework removing wastewater and soil from the household to the sewer.

name: Home Security System
description: Intruder alarms, cameras, and access control devices protecting the household against unauthorised entry.

name: Smart Home / Building Automation System
description: Integrated controls for lighting, heating, security, and appliances managed via automated or remote interfaces.

name: Renewable Energy System
description: On-site energy generation installations such as photovoltaic panels, solar thermal collectors, or heat pumps.

name: Masonry / Blockwork
description: Fired clay bricks or concrete blocks used for load-bearing and partition wall construction within the household.

name: Timber Frame / Engineered Timber
description: Structural and non-structural timber elements used in wall, floor, and roof framing of the household.

name: Insulation Material
description: Thermal and acoustic insulation products installed in walls, floors, and roofs to meet energy performance standards.

name: Plasterboard / Drylining
description: Gypsum board panels used to line internal walls and ceilings, providing a smooth finish substrate.

name: Flooring Finish
description: Surface finish materials applied to floor structures including timber, tile, carpet, vinyl, or stone.

name: Glazing / Double Glazing Units
description: Insulated glass units installed in window and door frames to provide thermal and acoustic performance.

name: Waterproofing & Tanking Membrane
description: Specialist membranes and coatings applied to wet areas, basements, and roofs to prevent water ingress.

name: Site Preparation & Demolition
description: Initial site clearance, stripping of existing structures, and preparation of the plot for new household construction.

name: Foundation Construction
description: Excavation and construction of strip, pad, raft, or pile foundations to support the household structure.

name: Roofing Works
description: Installation of the roof structure, coverings, insulation, and weatherproofing to make the household watertight.

name: External Envelope Cladding & Rendering
description: Application of external wall finishes including brick slips, render, cladding, or rainscreen systems.

name: Internal Partitioning & Drylining
description: Construction of non-structural internal walls and installation of plasterboard linings to define household rooms.

name: First Fix Mechanical & Electrical (M&E)
description: Installation of concealed pipework, ductwork, cable containment, and wiring prior to plastering and boarding.

name: Plastering & Screeding
description: Application of plaster to walls and ceilings and sand-cement or anhydrite screed to floor structures.

name: Second Fix M&E & Kitchen/Bathroom Fit-Out
description: Installation of visible electrical fixtures, sanitary ware, kitchen units, and final mechanical connections.

name: Decorating & Floor Finishing
description: Application of paint, wallcoverings, and floor finishes to complete the aesthetic fit-out of household spaces.

name: Single-Family Detached House
description: A standalone household unit on its own plot, with no shared walls with neighbouring dwellings.

name: Semi-Detached House
description: A household unit sharing one party wall with an adjacent dwelling, typically in a paired arrangement.

name: Terraced House
description: A household unit within a continuous row of dwellings sharing both side party walls with neighbours.

name: Apartment / Flat
description: A self-contained household unit within a multi-storey building, sharing floors, ceilings, and common areas.

name: Studio Flat
description: A compact single-room household unit where the living, sleeping, and kitchen areas are combined in one open space.

name: Duplex / Maisonette
description: A household unit spanning two internal floor levels within a larger building, with its own internal staircase.

name: Bungalow
description: A single-storey household unit where all habitable rooms are on the ground floor level.

name: Public Zone
description: Freely accessible areas open to all building users and visitors without restriction, such as lobbies and plazas.

name: Semi-Public Zone
description: Areas accessible to a broad audience but with implied or soft control, such as shared corridors, atriums, or common lounges.

name: Semi-Private Zone
description: Areas shared among a defined group of occupants, such as departmental meeting rooms or residential floor landings.

name: Private Zone
description: Spaces reserved exclusively for individual or small-group use, such as private offices, bedrooms, or personal studios.

name: Transitional Space
description: Buffer or threshold spaces that mediate movement between zones of differing publicness, such as vestibules, foyers, and anterrooms.

name: Security Checkpoint
description: Physical barrier or screening station that filters occupant flow at the boundary between public and controlled zones.

name: Surveillance & CCTV System
description: Camera and monitoring infrastructure deployed to oversee public and semi-public zones for safety and security.

name: Door Access Hardware
description: Locksets, electronic strikes, and door closers installed on zone-boundary doors to enforce or invite passage.

name: Glazed Partition
description: Transparent or translucent divider that visually signals the transition between zones while maintaining visual openness.

name: Acoustic Separation Element
description: Wall, ceiling, or floor assembly engineered to provide sound privacy appropriate to the privacy level of adjoining spaces.

name: Lobby / Entrance Hall
description: Primary public arrival space that serves as the first graduated threshold into the building's publicness hierarchy.

name: Shared Amenity Space
description: Collectively used facilities such as gyms, cafeterias, or roof terraces that sit at the semi-public or semi-private tier.

name: Circulation Core
description: Vertical and horizontal movement infrastructure (stairs, lifts, corridors) whose publicness level varies by floor and user group.

name: Privacy Screen / Enclosure
description: Moveable or fixed panel used to create visual privacy within an otherwise open or semi-public space.

name: Territoriality Marking Material
description: Flooring, lighting, or material finishes used deliberately to signal a shift in ownership or privacy expectation between zones.

name: Spatial Zoning Layout Activity
description: Design and programming activity in which spaces are deliberately arranged along a publicness gradient to guide occupant behaviour.

name: Access Rights Management Activity
description: Operational process of assigning, auditing, and revoking user permissions that correspond to the publicness tiers of spaces.

name: Security Risk Assessment Activity
description: Systematic evaluation of threats and vulnerabilities at each publicness threshold to inform barrier and surveillance placement.

name: Space Programming Activity
description: Early-stage briefing process that assigns intended publicness levels to each space in the building programme.

name: Outdoor Public Realm
description: External plazas, courtyards, and streetscapes associated with the building that represent the outermost tier of the publicness spectrum.

name: Back-of-House / Service Zone
description: Staff-only or operational areas invisible to the public that represent the most restricted end of the publicness spectrum.

name: Individual Dwelling Unit
description: A single self-contained residential unit within the cluster, housing one household.

name: Shared Courtyard
description: A communal open-air space enclosed or semi-enclosed by the surrounding dwelling units.

name: Common Entrance Lobby
description: A shared entry point providing access to multiple dwellings within the cluster.

name: Pedestrian Pathway
description: Dedicated foot-traffic routes connecting individual units and shared amenities within the cluster.

name: Shared Garden or Green Space
description: Communally maintained landscaped outdoor area available to all residents of the cluster.

name: Parking Bay / Car Port
description: Designated parking area shared among or assigned to cluster residents.

name: Utility Room / Bin Store
description: Shared enclosed space for waste management, recycling bins, and utility meters.

name: Boundary Fence or Wall
description: Perimeter enclosure element defining the outer edge of the cluster site.

name: Shared Roof Structure
description: A continuous or interconnected roof assembly spanning multiple units in the cluster.

name: Shared Drainage and Sewer Network
description: A communal underground pipework system collecting wastewater from all units before connecting to the public sewer.

name: Shared Water Supply System
description: Pipework and metering infrastructure distributing potable water to each dwelling from a common service entry.

name: Communal Electrical Distribution Board
description: Central electrical intake and sub-metering panel serving individual units across the cluster.

name: District or Communal Heating System
description: A shared heat source and distribution network providing space heating and hot water to all units.

name: Shared Broadband / Telecoms Infrastructure
description: Common ducting, cabling, and distribution points enabling internet and telecoms connectivity for all residents.

name: Site Drainage and Permeable Paving
description: Surface water management system including soakaways, channels, and permeable hard-standings for the cluster grounds.

name: Masonry or Timber Frame Construction
description: Primary structural material system used to build the load-bearing walls and frames of the cluster dwellings.

name: Roofing Membrane and Tiles
description: Weather-proofing materials applied to the roof structure of individual and shared roof elements.

name: Insulation (Walls, Roof, Floor)
description: Thermal and acoustic insulation materials installed at the building envelope and between party elements.

name: Render or Cladding System
description: External finish material applied to façade surfaces for weather protection and aesthetic consistency across the cluster.

name: Site Investigation and Ground Survey
description: Pre-construction assessment of soil conditions and site constraints to inform the cluster's foundation design.

name: Masterplanning and Layout Design
description: Design activity establishing the spatial arrangement, density, and circulation logic of the cluster.

name: Planning Permission and Approval
description: Statutory consent process required before construction of the residential cluster can commence.

name: Foundation and Groundworks
description: Earthworks, excavation, and sub-structure construction forming the base of all units in the cluster.

name: Superstructure Erection
description: Construction of the above-ground walls, frames, and floors for each dwelling unit in the cluster.

name: Shared Services Installation
description: Installation of communal utility runs (drainage, water, electricity, telecoms) serving all cluster units simultaneously.

name: Handover and Snagging
description: Final inspection, defect rectification, and formal handover of completed units and shared areas to residents or a management body.

name: Row House / Terraced Housing
description: A closely related housing typology where units share party walls in a linear arrangement, often used interchangeably with cluster housing.

name: Co-Housing Development
description: An intentional community variant of clustered housing emphasising additional shared facilities and resident governance.

name: Mews Development
description: A cluster typology arranged around a shared private road or courtyard, historically converted from stable rows.

name: Residents Management Company
description: Legal and administrative entity established to manage shared assets, maintenance obligations, and service charges across the cluster.

name: Front Facade
description: The street-facing exterior face of each row house unit, typically featuring doors, windows, and architectural detailing.

name: Rear Garden / Yard
description: A private outdoor area at the back of each row house unit, used for recreation, gardening, or storage.

name: Terraced Housing Block
description: The overall continuous block formed by a series of attached row house units sharing party walls along a street frontage.

name: Individual Unit
description: A single self-contained dwelling within the row house block, with its own entrance, floors, and private spaces.

name: Common Entrance Pathway
description: A shared or semi-shared walkway or path providing access from the street to individual unit front doors.

name: Load-Bearing Masonry Wall
description: Structural brick or block walls forming the front, rear, and party wall envelope that carry floor and roof loads.

name: Timber Floor Joist System
description: Horizontal timber framing members spanning between load-bearing walls to support intermediate and upper floor decking.

name: Chimney Stack
description: A vertical masonry flue structure rising through and above the roof, shared between or individual to units, serving fireplaces or boilers.

name: Dormer Window
description: A roof-projecting window structure used to bring light and headroom into a converted loft or attic space above the main floors.

name: Damp Proof Course (DPC)
description: A horizontal moisture barrier installed within the base of masonry walls to prevent rising damp from the ground into the structure.

name: Rainwater Drainage System
description: Gutters, downpipes, and underground drains that collect and discharge roof and surface rainwater away from the row house structure.

name: Shared Utility Corridor / Easement
description: A rear or side access lane or easement shared between row house blocks for bin collection, utility access, and secondary escape.

name: Cellar / Basement
description: A below-ground level space sometimes present in older row houses, used for storage, utilities, or as an additional habitable level.

name: Central Heating System
description: A hydronic or forced-air heating installation serving each individual unit with radiators or underfloor heating circuits.

name: Electrical Wiring System
description: The unit-specific electrical distribution network including consumer unit, circuits, sockets, and lighting within each row house.

name: Plumbing & Sanitation System
description: Pipework, fixtures, and drainage serving bathrooms, kitchens, and utility spaces within each individual row house unit.

name: Fire Stopping & Compartmentation
description: Passive fire-protection measures installed at party walls, floor penetrations, and roof voids to prevent fire spread between units.

name: Sound Insulation (Party Wall)
description: Acoustic insulation boards, resilient bars, or mass-loaded materials applied to party walls and floors to reduce airborne and impact noise transmission.

name: External Wall Insulation (EWI)
description: A retrofitted insulation and render system applied to the exterior face of row house walls to improve thermal performance.

name: Render / Masonry Pointing
description: External surface finish applied to brick or block walls for weather protection and aesthetic appearance.

name: Roof Tile / Slate Covering
description: The primary weatherproof outer layer of the row house roof, typically clay, concrete tile, or natural slate laid over battens and felt.

name: Party Wall Award / Agreement
description: A legal and surveying process required when construction work affects a shared party wall, documenting agreed works and protecting both owners.

name: Loft Conversion
description: A construction activity transforming the attic space of a row house into a habitable room, typically involving dormer additions and structural reinforcement.

name: Rear Extension Construction
description: A building activity adding a single- or two-storey extension to the back of a row house unit to increase ground-floor or upper-floor living space.

name: Re-Roofing
description: The process of stripping and replacing the entire roof covering, battens, and felt on a row house to restore weathertightness.

name: Facade Restoration
description: Repair and conservation works to the street-facing elevation, including repointing, stone cleaning, and window reinstatement to original character.

name: Mews House
description: A variant row house typology originally built as stable and coach house conversions, typically accessed from a rear lane with compact plans.

name: Back-to-Back House
description: A historic dense urban row house variant where two rows of units share a rear party wall with no back garden or rear access.

name: Through-Terrace House
description: A row house variant with front and rear access and windows on both elevations, distinguished from back-to-back configurations.

name: Townhouse (Urban Row House)
description: A taller, multi-storey row house variant common in urban settings, often with a basement and three or more above-ground floors.

name: Residential Units
description: Individual dwelling spaces embedded within the hill structure, ranging from studios to multi-bedroom apartments.

name: Green Roof Layer
description: Vegetated surface layer covering the hill form, providing insulation, stormwater management, and biodiversity benefits.

name: Terraced Landscaping
description: Stepped outdoor terrace spaces cut into the hillside profile for private or shared resident use.

name: Structural Earth Embankment
description: Compacted soil and fill material forming the primary sloped mass of the housing hill.

name: Pedestrian Pathway Network
description: Interconnected walkways and ramps traversing the hill surface connecting entrances, terraces, and rooftop areas.

name: Underground Parking Garage
description: Below-grade parking facility integrated into the base of the hill structure.

name: Drainage Mat
description: Geocomposite or dimple-sheet layer placed beneath the substrate to facilitate water drainage while retaining moisture.

name: Facade / Entry Elevation
description: Exposed architectural front face of the hill where residential entrances, glazing, and ventilation are located.

name: Shared Rooftop Space
description: Communal accessible area at the hill summit used for recreation, urban farming, or social gathering.

name: Fire Escape & Emergency Egress
description: Dedicated escape routes, stairwells, and exits ensuring safe evacuation from all levels of the hill structure.

name: Earthworks & Grading
description: Construction activity involving excavation, cutting, and shaping of the ground to form the hill profile.

name: Green Roof Installation
description: Layered installation process of waterproofing, drainage, substrate, and planting on the hill's roof surface.

name: Structural Concrete Pouring
description: On-site casting of reinforced concrete elements forming the load-bearing frame of the hill building.

name: IfcGeographicElement
description: IFC entity class (schema IFC4). Supertype: IfcElement.

name: Assisted Living Unit
description: A self-contained residential unit designed for elderly occupants requiring daily support and care services.

name: Memory Care Wing
description: A secure, specialized zone within the facility tailored for residents with dementia or Alzheimer's disease.

name: Common Lounge Area
description: Shared social space for elderly residents to gather, relax, and engage in group activities.

name: Dining Hall
description: A communal eating space equipped to serve nutritional meals to a large number of elderly residents.

name: Rehabilitation Gymnasium
description: A dedicated space with therapeutic equipment for physical therapy and recovery exercises.

name: Nursing Station
description: A centrally located operational hub where nursing staff monitor residents and manage medical records.

name: Accessible Bathroom
description: A bathroom designed with grab rails, roll-in showers, and wide doorways to accommodate mobility-impaired elderly users.

name: Outdoor Garden Courtyard
description: A safe, enclosed exterior green space allowing residents to enjoy fresh air and nature safely.

name: Grab Rail System
description: Wall-mounted handrails installed throughout corridors and bathrooms to prevent falls and aid elderly mobility.

name: Nurse Call System
description: An electronic alert system enabling residents to summon nursing staff instantly from their rooms or bathrooms.

name: Stairlift
description: A motorised chair mounted on a staircase rail to transport mobility-limited residents between floor levels.

name: Passenger Lift (Elevator)
description: A wide-cab elevator with low control panels and handrails, sized to accommodate wheelchairs and stretchers.

name: Dementia-Friendly Wayfinding Signage
description: High-contrast, pictogram-based signage system designed to help cognitively impaired residents navigate the building independently.

name: Emergency Wander-Prevention Door System
description: Electronically controlled door locks and sensors that prevent memory-care residents from exiting unsupervised.

name: Handrail Corridor System
description: Continuous bilateral handrail installation along all corridors providing uninterrupted fall-prevention support.

name: HVAC System (Elderly-Optimised)
description: Heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning system calibrated for the thermal sensitivity and respiratory needs of elderly occupants.

name: Medical Gas Supply System
description: Piped oxygen and vacuum services distributed to resident rooms and clinical areas for on-demand medical use.

name: Fire Safety and Evacuation System
description: Sprinkler, alarm, and evacuation-assist equipment designed to safely egress mobility-impaired elderly occupants.

name: Age-in-Place Fitout Works
description: Construction activity involving retrofitting existing spaces with accessibility features to allow residents to remain as their needs increase.

name: Accessible Ramp Installation
description: Construction of sloped pathways at level changes to eliminate trip hazards and enable wheelchair access throughout the facility.

name: Specialist Flooring Installation
description: Laying of anti-slip, cushioned, or dementia-friendly flooring materials requiring specialist trades and product knowledge.

name: Nurse Call System Commissioning
description: Testing and validation activity ensuring all call points, annunciators, and alarm routes function correctly before occupancy.

name: Infection Control Fit-Out
description: Construction works applying hygienic wall linings, coving, and sealed joints to minimise pathogen harbourage in care environments.

name: Residential Care Bedroom
description: Individual sleeping room for an elderly resident, designed with adjustable lighting, emergency call points, and furniture clearance for mobility aids.

name: Medication Preparation Room
description: Secure clinical room where nursing staff prepare and dispense medications to residents.

name: Palliative Care Suite
description: A private, comfortable suite designed to provide dignified end-of-life care for residents and family visits.

name: IfcSpaceHeater
description: IFC entity class (schema IFC4). Supertype: IfcFlowTerminal.

name: Open-Plan Office Area
description: A large, undivided floor area designed for collaborative and flexible desk-based working across teams.

name: Focus Room / Phone Booth
description: A small, acoustically isolated pod or cabin for individual concentration or private calls.

name: Reception / Lobby
description: The primary entry space that manages visitor arrival, security access, and first impressions of the community.

name: Hot-Desking / Flex-Desk Station
description: An unassigned, bookable desk unit that supports multiple users across different times of day.

name: Locker Unit
description: A secure personal storage cabinet assigned to hot-desk users who have no permanent desk.

name: Acoustic Partition / Demountable Wall
description: A relocatable partition system used to subdivide open areas into semi-private zones without permanent construction.

name: IT / Data Network Infrastructure
description: The structured cabling, Wi-Fi access points, and server provisions that deliver connectivity throughout the workspace.

name: Audio-Visual (AV) Presentation System
description: Integrated screens, projectors, speakers, and video-conferencing hardware installed in meeting and collaboration spaces.

name: Desk Booking & Space Management Software
description: A digital platform enabling occupants to reserve desks, rooms, and amenities and providing utilisation analytics.

name: Interior Fit-Out
description: The construction phase involving installation of partitions, ceilings, flooring, joinery, and furniture within the shell.

name: Cat-A to Cat-B Conversion
description: The process of upgrading a base-build shell (Category A) to a fully tenanted and branded workspace (Category B).

name: Space Planning & Programming
description: The design activity of allocating and arranging zones, workpoints, and amenities to match an organisation's headcount and work patterns.

name: Workplace Occupancy Study
description: A post-occupancy measurement activity that tracks desk utilisation rates to inform future space strategies.

name: Decommissioning & Strip-Out
description: The removal of existing fit-out elements, furniture, and services when a work community space is being refurbished or vacated.

name: Glass Partition Glazing
description: Frameless or framed clear or frosted glass used to enclose offices and meeting rooms while maintaining visual openness.

name: Ergonomic Task Chair
description: An adjustable seating component designed to support prolonged seated work and reduce musculoskeletal strain.

name: Sit-Stand Desk
description: A height-adjustable workstation component allowing users to alternate between sitting and standing postures during the day.

name: Collaboration Whiteboard / Writable Surface
description: A wall-mounted or freestanding writing surface that facilitates brainstorming and visual communication in team areas.

name: IfcSpace (Work Community Zone)
description: The IFC schema entity used to model and classify each discrete space or zone within the work community in a BIM environment.

name: Saw-tooth Roof Structure
description: A repetitive angled roof profile with north-facing glazing panels, characteristic of industrial ribbon buildings to provide even daylighting to the interior.

name: Clerestory Glazing Band
description: A continuous horizontal strip of windows positioned high on the wall or roofline to admit natural light deep into the industrial floor plate.

name: Structural Steel Portal Frame
description: Rigid steel frames spanning the full width of the building bay, providing the primary load-bearing skeleton of the industrial ribbon.

name: Precast Concrete Panel Cladding
description: Factory-manufactured concrete panels used as the external envelope skin of the industrial ribbon, offering durability and rapid on-site assembly.

name: Corrugated Metal Sheeting
description: Profiled steel or aluminium sheets used for roof and wall cladding, a common lightweight envelope material in industrial ribbon buildings.

name: Column-Free Production Floor
description: A large, open interior floor plate deliberately free of intermediate columns to allow flexible arrangement of machinery and production lines.

name: Loading Bay / Dock
description: A recessed or raised platform at the building perimeter where goods vehicles interface with the production or storage floor for loading and unloading.

name: Overhead Travelling Crane Rail
description: A longitudinal runway beam fixed to the structural frame along which an overhead bridge crane travels for heavy material handling inside the building.

name: Industrial Ventilation System
description: Mechanical or natural ventilation infrastructure, including ridge vents, louvres, and ductwork, designed to manage heat, fumes, and air quality across the wide-span floor.

name: High-Bay Lighting System
description: Specialised high-intensity luminaires suspended at significant height to illuminate tall industrial interiors uniformly without glare.

name: Concrete Ground-Bearing Slab
description: A heavily reinforced and often power-floated concrete floor slab designed to withstand heavy point loads from industrial plant and forklift traffic.

name: Mezzanine Floor
description: An intermediate level inserted within the high-bay volume, typically used for offices, storage, or ancillary functions above the production area.

name: Welfare / Ancillary Block
description: A subsidiary building section or attached unit housing toilets, changing rooms, rest areas, and administrative offices for workers.

name: Fire Suppression Sprinkler System
description: A network of overhead water-discharge heads and pipework providing automatic fire suppression across the industrial floor area.

name: Site Groundworks and Foundations
description: Excavation, pile installation, and ground-beam construction activities required to prepare the substructure before the superstructure is erected.

name: Cladding and Roofing Installation
description: The fixing of metal sheeting, insulated panels, or precast units to complete the weathertight envelope of the industrial ribbon.

name: Concrete Floor Slab Laying
description: Pouring, levelling, and power-floating the reinforced ground-bearing slab to the specified flatness and load tolerances.

name: Single-Storey Industrial Unit
description: A self-contained, single-level enclosed workspace within or adjacent to the ribbon layout, often subdivided and let to individual tenants.

name: Multi-Bay Industrial Shed
description: A variant of the industrial ribbon comprising several parallel structural bays joined laterally to increase total floor area under one roof.

name: Flex / Hybrid Industrial Unit
description: A mixed-use industrial variant combining warehouse, light manufacturing, and office space within a single ribbon building envelope.

name: Roof Lantern / Monitor
description: A raised glazed superstructure running along the roof ridge to introduce daylight and ventilation into the centre of a deep industrial floor plate.

name: IfcIndustrialFacility
description: The IFC schema class used to classify the overall industrial ribbon building within a BIM model for data exchange and asset management purposes.

name: Academic Faculty Offices
description: Dedicated office spaces where faculty members conduct research, hold student consultations, and perform administrative duties.

name: Lecture Hall
description: Large-capacity tiered seating spaces designed for formal instruction and presentations to sizable student audiences.

name: Research Laboratory
description: Specialized rooms equipped with scientific instruments and safety infrastructure for experimental research activities.

name: Student Union Building
description: A hub space offering social, recreational, and organizational services catering to the student community.

name: Library & Knowledge Commons
description: Information resource centers combining physical book stacks, digital access points, and collaborative study zones.

name: Innovation & Incubation Hub
description: Open-plan workspace where students and faculty prototype, develop, and commercialize ideas in a startup-like environment.

name: Maker Space / Fabrication Lab
description: Workshop area equipped with 3D printers, CNC machines, and craft tools supporting hands-on project creation.

name: Campus Retail Kiosk
description: Small, modular vendor units positioned in high-traffic corridors to sell food, beverages, or merchandise.

name: Food Hall & Dining Pavilion
description: Large communal eating space featuring multiple vendor stalls, seating areas, and food-service infrastructure.

name: Exhibition & Gallery Space
description: Open floor areas with adaptable display systems used to showcase student and faculty creative or research work.

name: Conference & Event Centre
description: Flexible multi-purpose venue supporting academic conferences, industry expos, and large-scale networking events.

name: Co-Working & Hot-Desk Zone
description: Shared open-plan work areas with rentable desks and connectivity infrastructure for students, staff, and external users.

name: Technology Transfer Office
description: Administrative space managing intellectual property licensing, spin-out company formation, and industry partnerships.

name: Career & Employability Centre
description: Service space where students access job placement support, career counseling, and employer engagement programs.

name: Campus Wayfinding & Signage System
description: Integrated network of digital and physical signs guiding visitors across the campus marketplace environment.

name: Smart Building Management System (BMS)
description: Centralized control infrastructure monitoring HVAC, lighting, and energy across all campus buildings in real time.

name: Campus-Wide IT & Wi-Fi Network
description: High-density wireless and wired network infrastructure providing seamless connectivity throughout all campus zones.

name: Access Control & Security System
description: Electronic door access, CCTV, and identity management systems controlling entry to sensitive academic and research spaces.

name: Modular Partition Wall System
description: Demountable wall panels enabling rapid spatial reconfiguration to adapt spaces for different marketplace functions.

name: Raised Access Flooring
description: Elevated floor system with removable tiles allowing flexible routing of power, data, and mechanical services beneath.

name: Exposed Structural Concrete
description: Visible cast-in-place or precast concrete surfaces used architecturally to signal industrial creativity in innovation spaces.

name: High-Performance Glazing System
description: Double or triple-glazed curtain wall units with solar control coatings used to maximize daylight while managing heat gain.

name: Photovoltaic Roofing Panel
description: Building-integrated solar panels generating on-site renewable energy to support the campus sustainability agenda.

name: Flexible Furniture & Loose Fit-Out
description: Lightweight, reconfigurable tables, seating, and storage units that support diverse learning and trading activities.

name: Digital Display & Wayfinding Screen
description: Interactive and passive screen units installed at key nodes to advertise events, provide maps, and display real-time data.

name: Space Fit-Out & Interior Construction
description: Construction activity encompassing partitioning, ceiling installation, flooring, and joinery works to complete usable spaces.

name: MEP Rough-In & Services Installation
description: Installation of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing rough-in works embedded within the building fabric prior to finishes.

name: Curtain Wall & Facade Installation
description: Fixing of external cladding, glazing, and rain-screen systems to the structural frame to enclose and weatherproof the building.

name: Landscape & Public Realm Works
description: Outdoor construction activities creating pedestrian plazas, planting areas, and hard-landscaping that animate the campus marketplace.

name: Commissioning & Systems Testing
description: Structured verification process ensuring all building systems operate to design intent before occupation.

name: Adaptive Reuse & Refurbishment
description: Conversion of existing campus buildings into new marketplace-ready spaces through selective demolition, strengthening, and fit-out.

name: Council Chamber
description: The primary deliberation room where elected officials and councillors convene for formal meetings and votes.

name: Public Gallery
description: A designated seating area within the council chamber allowing members of the public to observe official proceedings.

name: Mayor's Office
description: A private executive office reserved for the mayor or head of the local authority for administrative duties.

name: Clerk's Office
description: An administrative workspace where council clerks manage official records, agendas, and correspondence.

name: Public Reception / Enquiry Hall
description: A front-of-house space where members of the public access council services and are directed to relevant departments.

name: Committee Room
description: A smaller meeting room used for sub-committee deliberations, hearings, and working-group sessions.

name: Registrar's Office
description: A dedicated office for conducting civil registration services such as births, deaths, and marriages.

name: Register Office Ceremony Room
description: A formal room used for civil marriage and partnership ceremonies conducted by the registrar.

name: Council Staff Open-Plan Office
description: A general-purpose open office accommodating administrative and departmental council staff.

name: Archive and Records Room
description: A secure, climate-controlled room for long-term storage of official council documents and historical records.

name: IT Server / Network Room
description: A dedicated technical room housing servers, networking equipment, and AV infrastructure for council operations.

name: Accessible Toilet Block
description: Sanitary facilities designed and equipped to full accessibility standards for visitors and staff with disabilities.

name: Councillor Breakout Lounge
description: An informal rest and preparation space for elected councillors adjacent to the chamber.

name: Press / Media Room
description: A dedicated space for accredited journalists and media representatives covering council proceedings.

name: Loading Bay and Goods Entrance
description: A service-side space for deliveries, refuse collection, and utility access separated from the public entrance.

name: Ceremonial Entrance Hall / Foyer
description: A grand entry vestibule reflecting civic dignity, often featuring heritage displays or civic regalia.

name: Council Chamber Raised Dais
description: An elevated platform within the council chamber where the presiding mayor and senior officers are seated.

name: Public Address and Voting System
description: An integrated audio and electronic voting system enabling councillors to speak, be heard, and cast recorded votes.

name: Acoustic Panelling
description: Sound-absorbing wall and ceiling panels installed to control reverberation in the council chamber and meeting rooms.

name: Security Access Control System
description: Electronic door access, CCTV, and intruder detection systems managing secure zones within the building.

name: Civic Flag and Mast
description: Exterior flagpole and fittings used to display the local authority's flag and national flags on ceremonial occasions.

name: Hearing Loop (Induction Loop) System
description: An assistive listening system installed in public spaces to support visitors using hearing aids.

name: Structural Steel or Concrete Frame
description: The primary load-bearing structural framework supporting floors, walls, and the roof of the building.

name: Curtain Wall / Facade Glazing
description: A non-structural external glazed facade system providing weather protection and civic aesthetic to the building exterior.

name: Portland Stone or Civic Masonry Cladding
description: Dressed natural stone or high-quality masonry traditionally used on town hall facades to convey civic authority.

name: Hardwood Joinery and Panelling
description: Solid timber panelling and bespoke joinery used in chambers and formal rooms to reflect civic prestige.

name: Accessible Ramp and Lift Installation
description: Ramps and passenger lifts ensuring step-free access to all floors and public areas in compliance with accessibility regulations.

name: Emergency Evacuation System
description: Signage, PA alerts, and refuge point infrastructure coordinating safe evacuation of all building users.

name: Refurbishment of Council Chamber
description: Planned works to update seating, dais, audiovisual systems, and finishes within the formal council chamber.

name: Facade Conservation and Restoration
description: Specialist conservation works to clean, repair, and preserve historic stonework or listed building fabric.

name: Accessibility Upgrade Works
description: Construction activities to install ramps, platform lifts, and compliant sanitary facilities meeting current equality legislation.

name: Asbestos Survey and Remediation
description: Statutory inspection and safe removal of asbestos-containing materials often found in older civic buildings.

name: Mechanical and Electrical (M&E) Upgrade
description: Replacement or modernisation of heating, ventilation, electrical distribution, and data infrastructure throughout the building.

name: Roof Replacement or Repair
description: Works to replace or restore the roof covering, including lead, slate, or membrane systems, to prevent water ingress.

name: AV and Digital Infrastructure Installation
description: Installation of screens, microphones, voting panels, and streaming equipment to support hybrid or digital council meetings.

name: Security Systems Upgrade
description: Replacement or enhancement of access control, CCTV, and alarm systems to meet current security standards.

name: Listed Building Consent Application
description: The statutory planning process required before carrying out works to a designated listed civic building.

name: Civic Square / Public Forecourt
description: An exterior public realm space fronting the town hall used for civic events, markets, and community gatherings.

name: IfcPublicFacility
description: The IFC classification representing publicly accessible civic and administrative facilities within a building model.

name: IfcOffice
description: The IFC space type classifying administrative office areas occupied by council staff and elected members.

name: IfcMeetingRoom
description: The IFC space classification applied to committee rooms and formal meeting spaces within the civic building.

name: Community Garden Plot
description: A designated outdoor cultivable area within the necklace layout where community members collectively or individually grow plants and food.

name: Outdoor Amphitheatre
description: An open-air performance and gathering space integrated into the necklace sequence for communal events and public programming.

name: Pop-Up Market Pavilion
description: A flexible, partially enclosed structure along the necklace corridor designed to host temporary markets, stalls, and vendor activities.

name: Community Workshop Hub
description: A shared maker-space or craft workshop node providing tools, benches, and facilities for skill-sharing and fabrication activities.

name: Pocket Park Node
description: A small landscaped rest area acting as one bead in the necklace, offering seating, greenery, and informal social interaction points.

name: Pedestrian Linkage Path
description: The connective walkway or trail thread that strings together each project node, forming the physical 'string' of the necklace.

name: Community Noticeboard Structure
description: A freestanding or wall-mounted display structure at each node for posting local announcements, maps, and project information.

name: Shade Canopy Structure
description: A tensile, pergola, or solid overhead canopy element providing weather protection at key nodes along the necklace.

name: Seating and Rest Furniture
description: Fixed or movable benches, chairs, and loungers positioned at each community node to encourage lingering and social interaction.

name: Outdoor Lighting System
description: Pathway, accent, and feature lighting infrastructure ensuring safety and ambiance throughout the necklace at night.

name: Stormwater and Drainage System
description: Surface drainage channels, rain gardens, and permeable paving infrastructure managing water runoff across all necklace nodes.

name: Irrigation and Water Supply System
description: Pipework and controller infrastructure supplying water to gardens, planters, and any water features within the necklace network.

name: Electrical and Power Distribution System
description: Underground or overhead cabling and switchboards distributing electrical power to pavilions, lighting, and event infrastructure across nodes.

name: Permeable Paving
description: Porous surface material used on pathways and plazas to allow rainwater infiltration and reduce surface runoff.

name: Recycled Timber Decking
description: Sustainably sourced or reclaimed timber boards used for platform decks, seating surrounds, and node flooring surfaces.

name: Cor-Ten Steel Cladding
description: Weathering steel panels used on pavilion walls and signage structures, providing a durable, low-maintenance aesthetic finish.

name: Native Landscaping Planting
description: Indigenous and locally adapted plant species used throughout garden beds and green spaces to support biodiversity and reduce maintenance.

name: Concrete Pathway Kerbing
description: Precast or in-situ concrete edge restraints defining and protecting the edges of pedestrian paths throughout the necklace.

name: Community Engagement and Co-Design Workshop
description: Participatory planning sessions held with local residents to collaboratively define the program, design, and priorities of each node.

name: Site Preparation and Earthworks
description: Clearing, grading, and soil conditioning of each node site in preparation for construction of structures and landscape elements.

name: Pathway and Paving Installation
description: Construction activity involving laying, compacting, and finishing all pedestrian path surfaces connecting and surfacing necklace nodes.

name: Pavilion Structure Erection
description: Fabrication and on-site assembly of lightweight shade structures, market pavilions, and community hubs at designated nodes.

name: Landscape Planting and Establishment
description: Horticultural activity of installing, irrigating, and maintaining plant material across all garden and green space nodes.

name: Utility Trenching and Services Installation
description: Excavation and laying of underground conduits, cables, and pipes for power, water, and drainage across the entire necklace corridor.

name: Artwork and Placemaking Installation
description: Commissioning and installing public art, murals, and interpretive elements that give each node a distinct cultural identity.

name: Ongoing Community Activation Programming
description: Scheduled events, workshops, and activations managed post-construction to sustain community use and engagement across the necklace.

name: IfcCivilElement
description: IFC entity class (schema IFC4). Supertype: IfcElement.

name: Individual Retail Unit
description: A single self-contained shop or stall space leased or occupied by one tenant within the market.

name: Common Circulation Corridor
description: Shared pedestrian walkway or aisle connecting multiple shop units and allowing customer flow throughout the market.

name: Loading Bay
description: Dedicated service area where goods are delivered and dispatched to individual shops.

name: Market Management Office
description: Administrative space housing market operations, security monitoring, and property management staff.

name: Shopfront Facade System
description: The assembly of glazed panels, frames, signage rails, and shutters forming the front boundary of each retail unit.

name: Demountable Partition Wall
description: Flexible non-load-bearing wall system dividing retail units that can be reconfigured as tenant requirements change.

name: Retail Signage Pylon
description: Freestanding or wall-mounted structure displaying tenant directories, wayfinding, and promotional information.

name: Canopy or Awning
description: Projecting overhead cover attached above shopfronts or entrances to provide weather protection for pedestrians.

name: Security Roller Shutter
description: Retractable metal shutter installed at the entrance of each shop unit to secure it when closed.

name: Market Roof Structure
description: Primary structural frame and roof deck spanning the overall market building, often incorporating skylights or clerestory glazing.

name: Public Seating Furniture
description: Fixed or loose benches, chairs, and tables installed in rest areas and food courts for shopper comfort.

name: Tenant Fit-Out
description: Interior fixtures, fittings, shelving, and equipment installed by or for individual tenants within their retail units.

name: Electrical Distribution System
description: Main switchboards, sub-meters, distribution boards, and cabling supplying power to each retail unit and common area.

name: Plumbing and Drainage System
description: Water supply, waste, and stormwater pipework serving toilets, food vendors, cleaning stations, and the loading bay.

name: Public Address and Wayfinding System
description: Audio announcement, digital signage, and directory boards guiding visitors through the market and communicating events.

name: Vertical Transportation System
description: Lifts, escalators, and travelators connecting multiple trading levels in multi-storey market buildings.

name: Concrete Floor Slab
description: Reinforced concrete structural floor used in trading and circulation areas designed to bear high foot traffic and point loads.

name: Roof Installation
description: Laying of roof decking, waterproofing membranes, insulation, and glazing units over the completed structural frame.

name: Shopfront and Partition Installation
description: Fixing of shopfront frames, glazing, roller shutters, and demountable partitions to define individual retail units.

name: Fit-Out and Finishes
description: Second-fix trades completing floor finishes, ceilings, joinery, signage, and tenant-specific interior fit-outs.

name: Tenant Handover
description: Formal process of delivering completed retail units to individual tenants ready for their own fit-out or trading.

name: Outdoor Market Precinct
description: External hardscaped area adjacent to the market building used for open-air stalls, events, or overflow trading.

name: IfcMarket
description: IFC classification representing a market facility as a typed building within the built environment data schema.

name: Reception and Waiting Area
description: The front-of-house zone where patients check in and wait before consultations or treatments.

name: Consultation Room
description: Private room where healthcare professionals conduct patient examinations and discussions.

name: Treatment Room
description: Dedicated space equipped for minor medical procedures, dressings, and clinical interventions.

name: Nurse Station
description: Centralized working area for nursing staff to monitor patients and manage clinical records.

name: Pharmacy Dispensary
description: Secure area for storing, dispensing, and managing prescription medications.

name: Diagnostic Imaging Room
description: Shielded room housing X-ray, ultrasound, or other diagnostic imaging equipment.

name: Laboratory / Pathology Room
description: Space for collecting and analyzing blood, urine, and tissue samples on-site.

name: Sterilization Room
description: Room dedicated to cleaning, disinfecting, and sterilizing reusable medical instruments.

name: Clean Utility Room
description: Storage area for sterile and clean supplies ready for clinical use.

name: Dirty Utility Room
description: Separate room for the disposal and processing of used or contaminated clinical materials.

name: Patient Toilet and Accessible WC
description: Sanitary facilities designed for patients, including fully accessible units for people with disabilities.

name: Staff Changing and Locker Room
description: Private area where clinical and administrative staff change and store personal belongings.

name: Medical Records Office
description: Secure administrative space for storing and managing patient documentation and health records.

name: Medical Gas Pipeline System
description: Built-in network supplying oxygen, nitrous oxide, and vacuum lines to clinical rooms.

name: HVAC with HEPA Filtration
description: Heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning system incorporating high-efficiency particulate filters for infection control.

name: Nurse Call and Patient Alert System
description: Electronic system allowing patients to signal nursing staff and enabling rapid clinical response.

name: Infection Control Hand-Wash Station
description: Dedicated touchless or elbow-operated washbasin installed at every clinical point of care.

name: Clinical Flooring (Vinyl / Antimicrobial)
description: Seamless, impervious floor finish resistant to chemicals and microbial growth used in clinical zones.

name: Radiation Shielding (Lead-Lined Wall)
description: Lead-lined or barium-sulphate wall construction used in imaging rooms to contain radiation exposure.

name: Acoustic Partition Wall
description: High-performance partition providing speech privacy between consultation rooms and common areas.

name: Automatic Sliding Door (Infection Control)
description: Hands-free door system minimizing touch points to reduce cross-contamination between zones.

name: Emergency Eyewash and Safety Shower
description: Plumbed safety fixture for immediately flushing eyes or body following exposure to hazardous substances.

name: Sharps Disposal and Waste Management Unit
description: Wall-mounted or freestanding containers and chutes for the safe segregation of clinical waste streams.

name: Disabled Access Ramp and Handrail
description: Accessible ramp and continuous handrail system ensuring barrier-free entry for mobility-impaired patients.

name: Clinical Fit-Out and Joinery Installation
description: Construction activity covering the installation of medical cabinetry, benchtops, and built-in clinical furniture.

name: Medical Gas System Installation and Testing
description: Specialist activity for installing, pressure-testing, and commissioning the piped medical gas network.

name: Radiation Shielding Works
description: Specialist construction activity involving the installation of radiation-protective materials in imaging rooms.

name: Infection Control Commissioning
description: Pre-occupancy validation activity confirming HVAC, finishes, and hand-hygiene facilities meet clinical hygiene standards.

name: Hazardous Material (Clinical Waste) Management Plan
description: Activity encompassing the planning and implementation of clinical and chemical waste handling procedures during and after construction.

name: General Practice (GP) Clinic
description: A primary-care variant of a health center focused on family medicine and general consultations.

name: Community Mental Health Unit
description: A specialized variant providing outpatient mental health consultations and therapeutic group spaces.

name: Allied Health Suite
description: Cluster of rooms housing physiotherapy, occupational therapy, dietetics, and related allied health services.

name: Telehealth / Virtual Consultation Room
description: Purpose-configured room with AV and data infrastructure enabling remote clinical consultations.

name: IfcMedicalDevice
description: IFC entity class (schema IFC4). Supertype: IfcFlowTerminal.

name: IfcSpace (Clinical Zone)
description: IFC spatial element used to model and tag each distinct clinical or administrative room for FM and compliance tracking.

name: Interstitial Floor Plate
description: A structural floor layer inserted between primary occupied floors to house building services and allow flexible reconfiguration without disturbing habitable spaces.

name: Buffer Zone
description: A transitional spatial layer between two distinct programmatic areas that mediates climate, acoustics, or privacy.

name: Double-Skin Facade
description: A layered facade system creating an intermediate cavity between inner and outer skins used for ventilation, insulation, and acoustic buffering.

name: Transitional Threshold Space
description: A semi-enclosed zone at the boundary of dwelling units that serves as a spatial mediator between public and private realms.

name: Service Void
description: A concealed interstitial cavity designed to route mechanical, electrical, and plumbing services between occupied floor zones.

name: Structural Transfer Slab
description: A heavy-duty reinforced concrete or steel slab that redistributes loads between differently structured zones of a building, enabling program transitions.

name: Access Gallery / Corridor Bridge
description: An external or semi-external walkway linking separate dwelling units or blocks, functioning as a shared circulation and social in-between space.

name: Communal Terrace
description: A shared outdoor or semi-outdoor platform inserted between residential levels for collective use and social interaction.

name: Sky Garden
description: A landscaped elevated space integrated within the building envelope between floor plates, providing greenery, light, and ventilation to adjacent units.

name: Winter Garden / Conservatory
description: A glazed semi-conditioned transitional space attached to or embedded within a dwelling that buffers the interior from external climate extremes.

name: Acoustic Separation Layer
description: A composite material assembly—such as resilient mats, mass-loaded vinyl, or sound-absorbing boards—installed between adjacent occupied spaces to control noise transmission.

name: Thermal Mass Insert
description: High-density materials such as concrete, brick, or phase-change panels positioned in interstitial zones to store and release heat, moderating temperature swings.

name: Demountable Wall Construction
description: The on-site assembly and installation of reversible non-load-bearing wall systems designed for future adaptation or removal with minimal waste.

name: Interstitial Services Installation
description: The coordinated routing and fixing of MEP services within interstitial floor or ceiling voids during construction or fit-out phases.

name: Structural Transfer Level Construction
description: The formwork, reinforcement, and concrete pouring sequence required to construct a transfer slab or transfer beam between differing structural grids.

name: Façade Cavity Ventilation Strategy
description: A passive or active airflow management system within a double-skin or cavity facade that controls heat gain, moisture, and air quality in the interstitial layer.

name: Gradient Privacy Zoning
description: A spatial planning concept that sequences public, semi-public, semi-private, and private zones in a graduated transition across a dwelling or building cluster.

name: In-Between Program Space
description: An ambiguously programmed spatial zone intentionally left open to accommodate multiple uses and foster informal social or creative activities.

name: Plug-In Unit (Secondary Dwelling)
description: A prefabricated or modular secondary living unit that can be inserted into, attached to, or detached from an existing building structure.

name: Void Former / Permanent Formwork
description: Lightweight polystyrene or recycled plastic void formers embedded within concrete slabs to reduce dead load while maintaining structural depth for services routing.

name: Sound-Absorbing Ceiling Baffle
description: Suspended acoustic panels installed within interstitial or communal ceiling zones to reduce reverberation and noise transfer between levels.

name: Social Infrastructure Fit-Out
description: The fitting-out of shared community spaces—laundries, workshops, lounges—embedded within a housing development to support collective living.

name: IfcSpace (Interstitial)
description: An IFC schema entity representing a named spatial zone classified as interstitial, enabling BIM-based tracking of non-habitable service or buffer spaces.

name: IfcBuildingStorey (Transfer Level)
description: An IFC building storey entity assigned to a transfer or interstitial level, allowing discipline-specific model coordination across program boundaries.

name: Cul-de-Sac Termination
description: A dead-end circular turning area at the terminus of a looped road branch, allowing vehicles to reverse direction safely.

name: Loop Road Carriageway
description: The paved travel surface of the looped local road that carries vehicular traffic around the loop.

name: Road Pavement Structure
description: The layered structural system (subbase, base course, and wearing course) providing load-bearing capacity for the road surface.

name: Kerb and Channel
description: The concrete or granite edging element forming the boundary between carriageway and footpath, directing surface water to drainage channels.

name: Footpath / Shared Path
description: A dedicated pedestrian (or pedestrian-cyclist) pathway running alongside or within the road reserve of the looped local road.

name: Nature Strip / Verge
description: The vegetated or grassed buffer strip between the carriageway kerb and the property boundary or footpath.

name: Road Reserve
description: The total width of land allocated for the local road corridor, encompassing carriageway, verge, footpaths, and services.

name: Subsoil Drainage
description: Perforated pipes and filter media installed beneath the pavement to remove groundwater and protect structural integrity.

name: Street Lighting
description: Luminaire poles and electrical infrastructure providing nighttime illumination along the looped local road.

name: Traffic Calming Device
description: Physical interventions such as speed humps, raised thresholds, or chicanes installed to reduce vehicle speeds on local roads.

name: Intersection / Junction Node
description: The at-grade connection point where the looped road meets a collector or arterial road, requiring geometric design and sight-distance assessment.

name: Signage and Line Marking
description: Regulatory, warning, and directional signs plus pavement markings guiding road users through the looped road network.

name: Underground Service Corridor
description: The designated zone beneath the road reserve accommodating utility conduits for water, sewer, gas, electricity, and telecommunications.

name: Retaining Wall (Road Embankment)
description: Structural wall supporting road embankment fill or cut batters where grade changes occur along the looped road alignment.

name: Road Subgrade Preparation
description: Earthworks activity involving excavation, compaction, and stabilisation of the in-situ soil to achieve design formation level.

name: Pavement Laying and Compaction
description: Construction activity covering placement, spreading, and compaction of granular base and bituminous or concrete wearing course layers.

name: Kerb and Channel Construction
description: Activity of forming, pouring, and curing concrete kerb and channel elements along the road edge prior to pavement surfacing.

name: Stormwater Pit and Pipe Installation
description: Trenching, laying, jointing, and backfilling drainage pipes and precast pits within the road reserve.

name: Road Marking and Signage Installation
description: Post-construction activity of applying thermoplastic or paint line markings and erecting regulatory and street-name signs.

name: Asphalt (Bituminous Mix)
description: Hot-mix or warm-mix bituminous material used as the wearing and binder course of the road pavement surface.

name: Granular Base Course Material
description: Crushed rock or gravel aggregate layer placed between subbase and wearing course to distribute traffic loads.

name: Concrete (Kerb, Gutter & Pavement)
description: Portland cement concrete used for kerb-and-channel elements and rigid pavement sections of the local road.

name: Geotextile Separation Fabric
description: Non-woven fabric installed between subgrade and granular layers to prevent fines migration and maintain pavement performance.

name: Collector Road Connection
description: The higher-order road onto which the looped local road connects at one or both ends, forming the access hierarchy.

name: Residential Driveway Crossover
description: The hardened connection between a private driveway and the local road carriageway, crossing the kerb and verge.

name: Accessible Kerb Ramp (Kerb Cut)
description: A ramped transition through the kerb line at pedestrian crossing points to comply with accessibility requirements.

name: Road Safety Audit
description: Formal assessment activity examining the looped road design for potential hazards to all road users before construction or opening.

name: As-Constructed Survey
description: Post-construction surveying activity to verify that built road geometry and service locations match design drawings for record purposes.

name: T Junction Node
description: The central intersection point where one corridor or passage meets another at a perpendicular angle, forming the characteristic T shape.

name: Junction Floor Finish
description: Flooring material applied at the T junction area, often requiring special cutting or pattern alignment to accommodate the branching geometry.

name: Junction Ceiling Treatment
description: Ceiling finish or soffit material used at the T junction, which may differ from or need to integrate with adjacent corridor ceilings.

name: Corner Wall Reinforcement
description: Structural or protective reinforcement applied to the interior wall corners of the T junction to resist impact and wear from traffic turning movements.

name: Junction Lighting Fixture
description: Luminaires specifically positioned at the T junction to ensure uniform illumination across all three branch directions without dark spots.

name: Emergency Exit Signage
description: Illuminated or photoluminescent exit signs positioned at the T junction to clearly indicate evacuation routes along each branch.

name: Fire Suppression Sprinkler Head
description: Sprinkler head(s) located at the T junction ceiling to provide overlapping fire suppression coverage across the branching space.

name: HVAC Duct Branch
description: The mechanical ductwork branching system that splits airflow from a main supply duct into the perpendicular branch at the T junction.

name: Electrical Conduit Junction
description: The electrical infrastructure node at the T junction distributing power and data cabling into each corridor branch.

name: Slip-Resistant Floor Nosing
description: Anti-slip strip or nosing installed at transition edges within the T junction to improve pedestrian safety at the change in direction.

name: Accessible Turning Circle
description: A minimum clear floor area at the T junction designed to allow wheelchair users and mobility-aid users to turn and navigate each branch safely.

name: Corridor Branch Arm
description: Each of the two or three corridor segments that radiate from the T junction node, defining the spatial extent of the intersection.

name: Junction Fire Door Assembly
description: Fire-rated door set installed at one or more branch openings of the T junction to compartmentalise the building in case of fire.

name: Traffic Flow Planning
description: The design and analysis activity that models pedestrian or vehicle movement patterns through the T junction to optimise circulation efficiency.

name: Junction Layout Marking
description: On-site setting-out activity that precisely marks the T junction geometry on slabs or subfloor prior to partition and finish installation.

name: Wall Partition Installation at Junction
description: Construction activity involving the erection of partition walls that form the stem and head of the T junction, requiring careful alignment and bracing.

name: Ceiling Grid Installation at Junction
description: Activity of installing suspended ceiling grid work across the T junction area, coordinating with lighting, HVAC, and sprinkler penetrations.

name: Wayfinding Design
description: The planning and specification activity that determines optimal signage placement and messaging strategy at the T junction to support occupant navigation.

name: Accessibility Compliance Check
description: Inspection and verification activity confirming the T junction meets applicable accessibility standards for width, turning radius, and tactile indicators.

name: Tactile Ground Surface Indicator
description: Textured floor tiles or strips installed at the T junction to warn visually impaired occupants of the change in direction and branching paths.

name: Security Camera Mount
description: CCTV camera bracket or housing positioned at the T junction to provide surveillance coverage of all three approach corridors simultaneously.

name: Pipe Service Branch
description: Plumbing or hydraulic pipework that branches at the T junction to serve fixtures or equipment along each corridor arm.

name: L Junction
description: A two-way corridor corner intersection that is a closely related variant to the T junction but involves only two branches meeting at a right angle.

name: Cross Junction
description: A four-way corridor intersection that extends the T junction concept by adding a fourth branch, requiring additional spatial and safety planning.

name: Corner Protection Column
description: A structural or decorative column element placed at the exposed corner of a T junction wall to protect it from impact by trolleys, carts, or vehicles.

name: Bioswale
description: Vegetated, shallow channels designed to slow, filter, and infiltrate stormwater runoff along street corridors.

name: Street Tree Pit
description: Structured underground cell or open pit system that supports tree root growth while bearing pavement loads above.

name: Tree Grate
description: Metal or composite grid installed at grade around a street tree to protect roots while maintaining a walkable surface.

name: Kerb Extension (Bulb-out)
description: Widened pavement area that extends the kerb line into the parking lane, often planted to manage stormwater and traffic calming.

name: Green Median Strip
description: Planted central reservation dividing opposing traffic lanes, incorporating vegetation and often stormwater management features.

name: Pedestrian Footpath
description: Paved or permeable walkway along the street edge designated for pedestrian movement and access.

name: Solar Street Lighting
description: Energy-efficient street lighting system powered by photovoltaic panels, reducing grid energy consumption along the corridor.

name: Growing Medium / Engineered Soil
description: Specially formulated soil blend used in green street planters and bioswales to support plant growth while providing stormwater treatment.

name: Mulch Layer
description: Organic or inorganic surface covering applied over soil in planted areas to retain moisture, suppress weeds, and prevent erosion.

name: Native / Adaptive Planting
description: Selection of locally adapted plant species installed in green street spaces to ensure ecological resilience and low maintenance.

name: Roadway Carriageway
description: The paved vehicle travel lanes forming the central functional corridor of the street.

name: Subsurface Structural Cell
description: Modular load-bearing plastic framework installed below paving to create void space for root growth and stormwater storage.

name: Street Construction and Reconstruction
description: Civil works activity involving excavation, base preparation, and reinstatement of the street to incorporate green infrastructure elements.

name: Vegetation Planting and Establishment
description: Horticultural activity covering the supply, installation, and early maintenance of plants within green street zones.

name: Stormwater Infrastructure Installation
description: Specialist construction activity for laying pipes, inlet structures, detention tanks, and infiltration systems within the street corridor.

name: Pavement Surfacing
description: Application of asphalt, concrete, or permeable paving materials to the carriageway, footpaths, and shared zones.

name: Urban Heat Island Mitigation
description: Integrated design approach using shading trees, permeable surfaces, and vegetation to reduce ambient air temperatures in the street environment.

name: Wayfinding and Signage System
description: Coordinated set of signs, markers, and information panels guiding pedestrians and cyclists through the green street network.

name: Vehicular Roadway
description: A paved or graded surface corridor engineered to support the movement of cars and other motor vehicles.

name: Cycling Lane
description: A marked or physically separated strip within or alongside a roadway reserved exclusively for bicycle travel.

name: Intersection Node
description: A junction point where two or more paths or roads cross, merge, or diverge within the network.

name: Parking Area
description: A designated zone or structure where vehicles can be temporarily stored when not in use.

name: Traffic Roundabout
description: A circular junction that guides vehicular flow around a central island to manage traffic without signals.

name: Asphalt Surfacing
description: A bituminous bound mixture applied as the top wearing course on roads, paths, and parking areas.

name: Concrete Paving
description: Rigid cement-based slabs or in-situ concrete used as a durable surface for paths and roadways.

name: Road Marking
description: Painted or thermoplastic lines, symbols, and text applied to road surfaces to guide and regulate traffic.

name: Traffic Sign
description: Standardised vertical signage mounted on posts or structures to convey regulatory, warning, or informational messages to road users.

name: Guard Rail And Barrier
description: Safety barriers installed along road edges, medians, or elevated sections to prevent vehicle run-off incidents.

name: Pedestrian Crossing
description: A marked or signalised point where foot traffic is given priority to cross a vehicular carriageway safely.

name: Speed Control Device
description: Physical measures such as speed humps, raised tables, or chicanes installed to reduce vehicle speeds in sensitive zones.

name: Electric Vehicle Charging Station
description: Infrastructure unit installed in parking or roadside areas to supply electrical energy for recharging electric vehicles.

name: Road Construction And Earthworks
description: The civil engineering activity of excavating, grading, and compacting subgrade to establish the road formation level.

name: Pavement Laying
description: The construction activity of placing and compacting base courses and wearing surfaces to form the finished road or path.

name: Road Maintenance And Resurfacing
description: Periodic inspection and repair activities including pothole patching, crack sealing, and overlay resurfacing to sustain road condition.

name: Entrance Lobby
description: A transitional interior space immediately inside the main gateway that buffers between the exterior and the building interior.

name: Swing Door (Double-leaf)
description: A traditional hinged two-panel door assembly used as the primary operable barrier at main building gateways.

name: Security Turnstile
description: A controlled-access rotating barrier installed at main gateways to enforce one-at-a-time pedestrian entry and integrate with access-control systems.

name: Canopy / Entrance Canopy
description: A projecting overhead shelter structure positioned above the main gateway opening to protect occupants from weather during entry and exit.

name: Glazed Curtain-Wall Surround
description: A framed glass facade assembly framing the main gateway opening that provides transparency, natural light, and visual prominence to the entrance.

name: Door Frame & Threshold
description: The structural surround and floor-level sill unit that supports the door leaf, provides sealing, and defines the opening geometry of the gateway.

name: Weatherstrip & Draught Seal
description: Flexible sealing strips fitted around door edges and thresholds to prevent air infiltration, water ingress, and heat loss at the gateway opening.

name: Entrance Mat & Matwell
description: A recessed floor cavity fitted with a dirt-trapping mat system located immediately inside the main gateway to capture debris from footwear.

name: Signage & Wayfinding Panel
description: Directional and identification signage elements mounted at or near the main gateway to orient visitors and communicate building identity.

name: Intercom & Video Entry System
description: An audio-visual communication system at the gateway that allows remote identification and remote release of door locks for visitor management.

name: Lighting System (Entrance)
description: Dedicated interior and exterior luminaires, including feature and emergency lighting, installed to illuminate the gateway area safely and attractively.

name: Structural Portal Frame / Lintel
description: The load-bearing beam or frame spanning the gateway opening that transfers overhead structural loads around the door void.

name: Ramp & Level-Access Threshold
description: A graded or flush transition element at the gateway entry point that provides wheelchair and mobility-aid accessibility in compliance with accessibility standards.

name: Fire Escape & Emergency Egress Door
description: A dedicated outward-opening door assembly integrated within or adjacent to the main gateway that provides a compliant emergency exit route.

name: Air Curtain Unit
description: A high-velocity fan unit installed above the gateway opening that projects a continuous air stream to prevent heat loss, insects, and dust from entering the building.

name: Bollards & Vehicle Barrier
