description: Protective edge strip applied to the front of each seating tread to improve durability, slip-resistance, and visibility.

name: Structural Raker / Rake Beam
description: Inclined structural beam beneath the seating tiers that transfers loads to the primary building frame.

name: Sub-structure Infill
description: Concrete, masonry, or steel infill material beneath the seating tiers used to form and support stepped geometry.

name: Lighting Fixture (Step Light)
description: Low-level luminaires recessed into risers or side walls to illuminate each step for safety in low-light conditions.

name: Drainage Channel
description: Recessed or surface channel integrated into each seating tread to collect and redirect rainwater in open-air venues.

name: Acoustic Finish Panel
description: Sound-absorbing or reflective panel applied to riser or soffit surfaces to tune the acoustic performance of the seating area.

name: Precast Concrete Seating Unit
description: Factory-cast concrete element manufactured as an integrated tread-and-riser unit for rapid on-site assembly.

name: Natural Stone Seating Slab
description: Quarried stone (e.g., marble, granite, limestone) used as a durable and historically authentic seating surface material.

name: Timber Seating Plank
description: Hardwood or engineered timber boards fixed to the tread substrate to provide a warm, comfortable seating surface.

name: Steel Grandstand Seating
description: Proprietary modular steel-framed tiered seating system with integrated risers, treads, and support structure for temporary or permanent installations.

name: Telescopic Seating System
description: Retractable, motorised or manually operated tiered seating system that folds flat to convert the space for alternative uses.

name: Bleacher System
description: Open, bench-style tiered seating system without backs, commonly used in sports venues and arenas.

name: Amphitheatre Seating Tier
description: A distinct seating level or zone within an outdoor or semi-outdoor amphitheatre arranged in a curved raked configuration.

name: Lecture Theatre Seating Rake
description: Tiered seating arrangement within an enclosed academic or conference hall designed for optimal sightlines to a stage or podium.

name: Stadium Bowl
description: The overall spectator enclosure of a sports stadium, comprising multiple continuous tiers of stair seating arranged around a central field.

name: Vomitory / Concourse Access
description: Tunnel or passage that penetrates the seating tiers to connect the concourse level with the seating bowl.

name: Accessible Seating Platform
description: Level platform integrated into the stair-seat tiers to accommodate wheelchair users and mobility-impaired spectators.

name: Press / Media Box
description: Enclosed or open elevated seating area within the tiers designated for media personnel and broadcasting equipment.

name: Formwork & Shuttering
description: Installation and striking of temporary molds to cast in-situ concrete stair seat geometry.

name: Concrete Pouring & Curing
description: Placement, compaction, and controlled curing of in-situ concrete to form stair tread and riser elements.

name: Precast Unit Installation
description: Crane-lifting, alignment, and fixing of precast concrete or stone seating units onto the structural subframe.

name: Rake Beam / Steel Frame Erection
description: Fabrication and erection of inclined structural steelwork or concrete rake beams that support the seating tiers.

name: Nosing & Surface Finishing
description: Application of anti-slip nosings, coatings, or surface treatments to tread edges for safety compliance.

name: Waterproofing & Drainage Installation
description: Application of waterproof membranes and installation of drainage channels to protect seating tiers from water ingress.

name: Seating Fixture Installation
description: Bolting or adhering of individual seat shells, tip-up seats, or bench planks onto prepared tread substrates.

name: Handrail & Balustrade Installation
description: Fabrication and fixing of handrails, guard rails, and balustrade systems along aisles and tier edges.

name: IFC Stair
description: IFC schema class (IfcStair) used to model the stair geometry and properties of stair seat assemblies in BIM environments.

name: IFC Ramp
description: IFC schema class (IfcRamp) applicable when accessible ramp elements are integrated within the stair seating layout.

name: IFC Slab
description: IFC schema class (IfcSlab) used to represent individual tread and riser slab elements within the stair seat assembly.

name: IFC Railing
description: IFC schema class (IfcRailing) used to model handrails, guardrails, and balustrades associated with stair seat tiers.

name: Intermediate Floor Slab
description: A structural horizontal slab that forms the floor of an intermediate or mid-level space within a building.

name: Half-Landing
description: A flat platform positioned midway between two full floor levels on a staircase, providing transition and rest points.

name: Mid-Level Void / Atrium Cutout
description: An open vertical void cut through an intermediate floor level, allowing light, air, and visual connection between floors.

name: Interstitial Space
description: A concealed intermediate zone between occupied floors used to route building services such as mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems.

name: Split-Level Floor Plate
description: A floor plate offset vertically from adjacent areas to create staggered levels within the same storey height.

name: Transfer Beam / Transfer Structure
description: A large structural beam or system that redistributes loads from upper levels at an intermediate storey, enabling column-free spaces below.

name: Mid-Floor Structural Steel Frame
description: A steel framing system specifically designed to support and form an intermediate-level floor within a multi-storey building.

name: Secondary Beam
description: A beam spanning between primary beams or girders to provide intermediate support for the floor deck at a mid-level.

name: Intermediate Structural Column
description: A column introduced at a mid-level to support a transfer or intermediate floor where columns from upper storeys do not continue to the ground.

name: Guardrail / Balustrade at Mid-Level
description: A protective railing or barrier installed at the open edges of a mezzanine or intermediate floor to prevent falls.

name: Mid-Level Access Staircase
description: A staircase specifically connecting the intermediate floor level to adjacent full floor levels above or below.

name: Platform Lift / Mid-Level Lift
description: A vertical lift or platform device providing accessible vertical movement between a mid-level space and surrounding floor levels.

name: Intermediate Fire Compartment Barrier
description: A fire-rated wall, floor, or barrier that subdivides the building at the intermediate level to limit the spread of fire and smoke.

name: Sprinkler System – Intermediate Zone
description: A fire suppression sprinkler installation specifically zoned and designed for the intermediate floor level of the building.

name: MEP Services Distribution – Mid-Level Plenum
description: Mechanical, electrical, and plumbing service runs distributed horizontally through the intermediate floor or ceiling plenum zone.

name: Intermediate Floor Construction
description: The construction activity of forming and casting or assembling the structural elements of an intermediate or mezzanine floor level.

name: Propping and Falsework Installation
description: Temporary support works erected to carry loads during the construction of an intermediate floor slab until it gains full strength.

name: Mid-Level Services Rough-In
description: The activity of installing first-fix mechanical, electrical, and plumbing services within the intermediate floor zone before finishing works.

name: Mezzanine Fit-Out Works
description: Interior finishing and fit-out activities specific to a mezzanine or intermediate-level space, including partitions, finishes, and fixtures.

name: Waterproofing of Intermediate Slab
description: Application of waterproof membranes or coatings to an intermediate floor slab, particularly in wet areas or where the slab is exposed to water.

name: Concrete – Mid-Level Slab Pour
description: Structural concrete placed for the construction of an intermediate or mezzanine floor slab within the building.

name: Composite Deck (Metal Decking)
description: Profiled steel decking used as permanent formwork and tensile reinforcement for composite concrete intermediate floor slabs.

name: Acoustic Interlayer / Impact Insulation
description: A resilient material layer incorporated within or beneath the intermediate floor build-up to reduce impact and airborne sound transmission between levels.

name: Thermal Insulation – Intermediate Floor
description: Insulation material installed within the intermediate floor build-up to control heat transfer between different occupancy zones above and below.

name: IFC – IfcSlab (Mezzanine)
description: The IFC class used to model a mezzanine or intermediate structural floor slab element within a BIM dataset.

name: IFC – IfcSpace (Mezzanine Zone)
description: The IFC class representing the spatial volume of a mezzanine or intermediate-level space for area, zoning, and occupancy tracking.

name: IFC – IfcBeam (Transfer / Secondary)
description: The IFC class used to model transfer or secondary beams that structurally support an intermediate floor level.

name: Public Entry Zone
description: The outermost transitional space (e.g., lobby or foyer) where visitors first enter and interaction is open and unrestricted.

name: Semi-Public Corridor
description: A connecting passage accessible to guests or clients but signaling a shift toward more controlled access.

name: Semi-Private Lounge or Anteroom
description: A buffer space between public and private zones, used for screened or invited interactions.

name: Private Room
description: A fully enclosed, restricted-access space reserved for occupants or explicitly invited individuals.

name: Threshold Element
description: A physical marker—such as a step, change in ceiling height, or material transition—that signals a shift in privacy level.

name: Transitional Door or Gate
description: A door, gate, or operable partition that physically enforces the boundary between zones of differing intimacy.

name: Visual Screening Device
description: A screen, partition, louver, or planting element that limits sightlines between zones without fully blocking movement.

name: Acoustic Separation System
description: Insulation, absorptive panels, or sound-masking installations that provide auditory privacy between gradient zones.

name: Lighting Gradient System
description: A deliberately designed progression from bright, open lighting in public zones to softer, dimmer lighting in private zones.

name: Flooring Material Transition
description: A deliberate change in floor finish—such as tile to carpet or hard to soft—that reinforces the sensory shift between zones.

name: Wall Finish Gradient Material
description: A progression of wall finishes (e.g., exposed concrete → plaster → timber panelling) that signal increasing enclosure and warmth toward private zones.

name: Operable Partition
description: A movable wall or folding panel that allows the gradient to be reconfigured based on occupancy or program needs.

name: Privacy Glazing
description: Frosted, fritted, or switchable glass used on interior facades to modulate visibility between adjacent zones.

name: Spatial Programming Activity
description: The design process of assigning uses and access levels to each zone to establish the intended intimacy progression.

name: Privacy Zoning Layout Design
description: The architectural planning activity of arranging spaces in sequence from most public to most private on a floor plan.

name: Access Control Installation
description: The construction activity of fitting locks, card readers, or biometric devices at zone boundaries.

name: Threshold Construction
description: The building activity of constructing steps, recesses, archways, or other physical markers that define transitions between intimacy zones.

name: Defensible Space
description: A related spatial concept where design features extend a sense of ownership and surveillance to semi-public areas, reinforcing the gradient.

name: Transitional Landscape Buffer
description: An outdoor or semi-outdoor planted zone—such as a forecourt or courtyard—that introduces the gradient before occupants enter the building.

name: Alcove or Nook
description: A small recessed area within a larger space that provides a localized increase in enclosure and intimacy without a full room boundary.

name: Sun Tunnel / Tubular Daylighting Device
description: A reflective tube that channels sunlight from a roof-mounted dome to a diffuser in an interior ceiling.

name: Solar Control Glazing
description: Spectrally selective glass or film that admits visible light while limiting heat gain from solar radiation.

name: Daylight Redirecting Film
description: A micro-structured prismatic film applied to glazing that redirects incident sunlight toward the ceiling plane.

name: External Solar Shading / Brise-Soleil
description: Fixed or adjustable exterior fins, louvres, or overhangs that modulate the amount of direct sun entering a façade.

name: Interior Roller Blind / Solar Blind
description: An adjustable interior screen fabric that reduces glare and solar heat gain while preserving views and some daylight.

name: Heliostatic Mirror System
description: A motorised array of tracking mirrors that redirects sunlight into deep-plan or north-facing interior zones.

name: Daylighting Simulation & Analysis
description: Computational modelling of solar angles, illuminance, and glare to optimise window placement and shading design.

name: Solar Path / Sun Path Study
description: Analysis of the sun's seasonal and daily trajectory relative to a building site to inform orientation and fenestration strategy.

name: Glare Assessment
description: Evaluation of discomfort or disability glare caused by direct or reflected sunlight in occupied spaces.

name: Building Orientation Design
description: Deliberate positioning of a building on its site to maximise beneficial sunlight penetration to key interior spaces.

name: Fenestration Installation
description: The construction activity of fitting windows, curtain walls, rooflights, and associated framing to admit daylight.

name: Reflective Interior Surface Finish
description: High-reflectance paint or cladding applied to ceilings and walls to redistribute admitted sunlight further into a space.

name: Solar Gain Zone
description: A designated interior buffer space, such as a sunspace or conservatory, that captures and redistributes solar heat and light.

name: Circadian Lighting System
description: An integrated daylighting and artificial lighting system tuned to support occupants' biological rhythms using natural sunlight patterns.

name: Daylight Factor Measurement
description: On-site or modelled quantification of the ratio of interior illuminance to simultaneous exterior illuminance under overcast sky conditions.

name: IFC Spatial Zone (Daylight Zone)
description: An IfcSpatialZone instance used in BIM models to delineate and track areas receiving defined levels of natural daylight.

name: Lobby / Entry Foyer
description: The primary welcoming space at the building's entrance that transitions visitors into the common area network.

name: Shared Lounge
description: A furnished, informal seating area available to all occupants for relaxation and social interaction.

name: Communal Dining / Break Room
description: A shared space equipped with tables and kitchenette facilities where occupants gather for meals and informal meetings.

name: Collaboration Hub / Co-working Zone
description: An open-plan flexible work area designed to encourage impromptu teamwork and cross-group interaction.

name: Staircase & Landing
description: Shared vertical circulation elements that also serve as informal social nodes within the building.

name: Multipurpose / Event Hall
description: A large adaptable room that can be reconfigured for events, presentations, and community gatherings.

name: Outdoor Terrace / Courtyard
description: An exterior or semi-exterior communal space integrated into the heart of the building for fresh-air socialising.

name: Rooftop Common Area
description: A shared amenity deck on the roof providing panoramic views and outdoor communal activities.

name: HVAC – Common Area Distribution
description: Heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning subsystem specifically sized and zoned for high-occupancy shared spaces.

name: Fire Detection & Suppression – Common Areas
description: Life-safety network of detectors, sprinklers, and alarm devices covering all shared circulation and gathering spaces.

name: Data & Wi-Fi Network Infrastructure
description: Structured cabling and wireless access-point network providing high-speed connectivity throughout shared spaces.

name: Vertical Transportation System (Lifts)
description: Elevator cars, machine rooms, and controls that form the primary vertical movement system serving the common area core.

name: Raised Access Floor / Floor Box System
description: Modular floor system beneath common-area floors providing concealed routing for power, data, and HVAC services.

name: Feature Ceiling / Suspended Ceiling
description: Architectural ceiling element in common areas that integrates lighting, acoustics, and services into a unified plane.

name: Reception / Concierge Desk
description: A custom-built counter and workstation that serves as the staffed focal point of the central lobby or common area.

name: Feature Staircase
description: A prominently designed statement staircase acting as both circulation and a visual centrepiece of the shared heart space.

name: Glazed Partition & Curtain Wall
description: Transparent or translucent vertical enclosures that define common area boundaries while maintaining visual openness.

name: Sliding / Folding Partition Wall
description: Movable wall systems that allow common areas to be subdivided or merged for different occupancy configurations.

name: Soft Furnishings & Loose Furniture Package
description: Curated collection of seating, tables, rugs, and soft goods specified to support social interaction in shared spaces.

name: Planter & Biophilic Elements
description: Living walls, potted planting, and water features integrated into common areas to enhance wellbeing and air quality.

name: Public Art & Feature Wall
description: Commissioned artwork, murals, or textured feature walls that establish the identity and character of the shared heart.

name: High-Performance Acoustic Glass
description: Laminated glazing with enhanced sound-damping properties used in common-area partitions and facades to limit noise transmission.

name: Polished Concrete / Terrazzo Flooring
description: Durable, low-maintenance floor finish commonly specified for high-footfall common areas due to its longevity and aesthetic appeal.

name: Engineered Timber / Mass Timber Cladding
description: Warm, sustainably sourced wood products used for wall and ceiling linings to create a welcoming biophilic aesthetic in shared spaces.

name: Acoustic Ceiling Tile / Panel
description: Mineral fibre or recycled composite tiles installed in suspended ceiling grids to reduce noise levels in busy communal zones.

name: Non-Slip Tile & Stone Finish
description: Ceramic, porcelain, or natural-stone floor tiles with certified slip-resistance ratings appropriate for high-traffic common areas.

name: Low-VOC Paint & Wall Coating
description: Interior coatings with minimal volatile organic compound emissions, specified for common areas to maintain indoor air quality.

name: Common Area Fit-Out & Interior Design
description: The construction and installation activity encompassing finishes, fixtures, furniture, and feature elements within shared spaces.

name: Structural Core & Slab Construction
description: Concrete or steel framework construction activity forming the floors, columns, and cores that define the common area volumes.

name: MEP Rough-In – Common Areas
description: First-fix installation of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing services within common area zones before finishes are applied.

name: Atrium / Skylight Glazing Installation
description: Specialist glazing activity involving the erection and weatherproofing of large overhead or vertical glazed elements in the central void.

name: Commissioning & Testing – Common Area Systems
description: Verification and performance-testing activity for all building systems (HVAC, lighting, access control, fire) within the common area zones.

name: Soft Landscaping & Planting Installation
description: Horticultural activity involving the placement, planting, and establishment of indoor greenery and living walls in shared spaces.

name: IfcSpace (Common Area)
description: IFC schema class representing a defined spatial zone within the building model annotated as a shared or common-use area.

name: IfcZone (Occupancy Zone)
description: IFC grouping entity that aggregates multiple common-area spaces into a single named zone for energy, access, or management purposes.

name: IfcStair & IfcRamp
description: IFC classes representing shared vertical circulation elements including feature staircases and accessible ramps in common areas.

name: Entry Door
description: The primary door assembly providing controlled access into the entrance room from the exterior or adjacent space.

name: Sidelight Panel
description: Narrow fixed glazing panels flanking the entry door to admit natural light into the entrance room.

name: Transom Window
description: A horizontal window positioned above the entry door to enhance natural light and visual openness.

name: Mud Room
description: An ancillary space adjoining the entrance room designed for removing and storing outerwear, shoes, and wet items.

name: Foyer Flooring
description: Durable, easy-to-clean finish flooring material—such as tile, stone, or hardwood—specified for high-traffic entry areas.

name: Door Mat / Recessed Entry Mat
description: A recessed or surface-mounted mat at the threshold for scraping and absorbing dirt and moisture from footwear.

name: Coat Closet
description: A small built-in storage space within or immediately adjacent to the entrance room for hanging coats and storing accessories.

name: Coat Hooks / Rail
description: Wall-mounted hooks or a continuous rail for hanging coats, bags, and hats near the entrance.

name: Shoe Storage Unit
description: Built-in or freestanding furniture component providing organised storage for footwear in the entrance room.

name: Umbrella Stand
description: A dedicated holder or built-in recess for storing umbrellas and walking aids near the entrance.

name: Entry Bench / Seat
description: A seating component placed in the entrance room to allow occupants to sit while putting on or removing footwear.

name: Console / Hall Table
description: A narrow table or shelf unit providing a surface for keys, mail, and personal items at the entry.

name: Elevator / Lift Lobby
description: A designated waiting area adjacent to the entrance room where occupants access vertical transportation.

name: Lighting System (Entry)
description: Coordinated artificial lighting scheme—including ceiling fixtures, wall sconces, and motion sensors—designed for safe and welcoming illumination of the entrance room.

name: Heating / HVAC Diffuser at Entry
description: HVAC supply and return terminals positioned in the entrance room to maintain thermal comfort and prevent cold draughts.

name: Air Curtain
description: A fan-driven air barrier installed above the entry door to prevent heat loss, insects, and dust ingress when the door is open.

name: Threshold / Sill
description: The horizontal transition strip or sill at the base of the entry door managing the junction between interior and exterior floor levels.

name: Insulated Entry Door (Steel/Fibreglass)
description: High-performance door leaf material offering thermal insulation, durability, and security for exterior entrance applications.

name: Signage / Wayfinding
description: Directional and identification signage mounted in the entrance room to guide occupants and visitors to key destinations.

name: Mailbox / Parcel Locker
description: Secure mail and package reception units integrated into or adjacent to the entrance room.

name: Fire Exit Signage & Emergency Lighting
description: Mandatory illuminated exit signs and battery-backed emergency luminaires ensuring safe egress from the entrance room during a fire or power failure.

name: Flooring Waterproofing / Membrane
description: A waterproof membrane or treatment applied beneath entry flooring to protect the subfloor from moisture tracked in from outdoors.

name: Wall Cladding / Wainscoting
description: Durable wall finish material such as tile, stone, or timber panelling applied to entrance room walls to withstand scuffs and moisture.

name: Ceiling Finish (Entry)
description: The decorative and functional ceiling surface treatment—plaster, gypsum board, or feature material—specified for the entrance room volume.

name: Doorbell / Chime System
description: An audible notification system signalling the arrival of a visitor at the entrance door.

name: Installation of Entry Door Assembly
description: The on-site construction activity of fitting, aligning, and securing the complete door frame, leaf, hardware, and weatherseals.

name: Flooring Installation (Entry)
description: The trade activity of laying, grouting, and finishing the specified floor material within the entrance room.

name: Access Control System Installation
description: The electrical and commissioning work involved in fitting and programming entry access control hardware and software.

name: Painting & Decorating (Entry)
description: Surface preparation, priming, and application of paint or wall coverings to the walls and ceiling of the entrance room.

name: IFC Covering (IfcCovering)
description: The IFC schema class capturing floor, wall, and ceiling finish elements applied within the entrance room.

name: IFC Furnishing Element (IfcFurnishingElement)
description: The IFC schema class representing fixed and loose furniture items such as benches, console tables, and coat hooks in the entrance room.

name: Doorway
description: An opening in a wall that physically connects two adjacent rooms and allows passage between them.

name: Folding Partition
description: An accordion-style movable wall system that can open or close to merge or separate adjacent spaces dynamically.

name: Open-Plan Layout
description: A spatial arrangement that minimizes fixed walls to allow unobstructed visual and physical flow between functional zones.

name: Enfilade
description: A classical arrangement of rooms whose doorways are aligned in a straight axis, creating a dramatic visual corridor through multiple spaces.

name: Sight Line
description: The unobstructed visual axis between spaces that guides occupant perception and directional movement through rooms.

name: Circulation Path
description: The planned network of routes—horizontal and vertical—that connects all spaces and governs occupant movement throughout a building.

name: Natural Ventilation Pathway
description: The sequence of openings and spaces arranged to allow air to flow through rooms, linking spatial flow with environmental performance.

name: Acoustic Separation
description: Construction assemblies and design strategies that control sound transmission between connected rooms while maintaining physical flow.

name: Transition Strip
description: A narrow profile element installed at the junction of two different flooring materials to create a clean, safe boundary.

name: Spatial Layout Planning
description: The design process of arranging rooms and circulation routes to optimize movement efficiency and experiential quality.

name: Partition Wall Construction
description: The building activity of erecting non-load-bearing walls that define room boundaries and influence spatial flow.

name: Accessibility Compliance Review
description: The process of evaluating circulation paths and doorways against universal design and disability access regulations.

name: Anteroom
description: A short waiting or transitional space immediately preceding a main room.

name: Breezeway
description: A short covered outdoor passage connecting two separate structures or building wings.

name: Passage Door
description: A door unit installed within a short passage to control access or provide separation between zones.

name: Ceiling Soffit
description: The exposed underside surface of the passage ceiling, often lowered relative to adjacent spaces.

name: Skirting Board
description: A trim board fixed at the base of passage walls to protect and finish the wall-floor junction.

name: Passage Flooring
description: Hard-wearing floor finish material (e.g., tile, vinyl, or stone) selected for high-traffic passage zones.

name: Passage Lighting Fixture
description: A ceiling- or wall-mounted luminaire providing adequate illumination along the passage length.

name: HVAC Duct
description: Air distribution ductwork routed through or along the passage to supply ventilation and conditioning.

name: Electrical Conduit System
description: The network of conduits and cable trays carrying electrical wiring through passage walls and ceilings.

name: Fire Compartmentation System
description: Assembly of fire-rated walls, doors, and seals that limit fire and smoke spread through passages.

name: Passage Layout & Design
description: The planning and architectural design activity that determines passage dimensions, routing, and spatial relationships.

name: Partition Wall Installation
description: Construction activity involving erecting the walls that form and enclose the passage.

name: MEP Rough-In Works
description: First-fix installation of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing services within passage walls and ceilings before finishes are applied.

name: IFC Spatial Element (IfcSpace)
description: The IFC class used to model the short passage as a defined spatial unit within the building information model.

name: Tiered Step Seating Platforms
description: Stepped horizontal platforms integrated into the staircase that double as seating or audience tiers for performances or gatherings.

name: Performance Landing
description: A widened intermediate landing within the staircase designed to serve as a stage or focal performance area.

name: Integrated Stage Lighting
description: Architectural lighting system embedded in treads, risers, or soffits to illuminate performers and create theatrical ambiance.

name: Acoustic Reflector Panels
description: Angled surfaces or panels positioned around the staircase void to project and direct sound toward an audience.

name: Handrail and Balustrade System
description: Continuous guardrail and infill system that provides safety while contributing to the visual framing of the performance space.

name: Stringer / Structural Spine
description: The primary load-bearing structural element running along the side or beneath the stair flights, supporting treads and risers.

name: Stepped Concrete or Timber Bleacher
description: Mass material—concrete, stone, or engineered timber—used to form robust stepped seating and performance tiers.

name: Retractable or Foldable Seating
description: Fold-away seat units that can be deployed on step surfaces to convert the stair into a formal auditorium configuration.

name: Audio-Visual Infrastructure
description: Embedded conduit, speaker housings, projection surfaces, and AV cabling routed through the staircase structure for live events.

name: Central Void / Atrium Well
description: The open vertical volume framed by the staircase flights, providing sightlines and acoustic resonance for performances.

name: Audience Circulation Zone
description: The surrounding floor area at the base or sides of the staircase allocated for standing or moving audience members.

name: Staircase Soffit
description: The underside surface of the stair flight, which can house concealed lighting, speakers, or act as a sculptural ceiling element.

name: Non-Slip Performance Flooring Finish
description: Slip-resistant surface material applied to treads and landings to meet safety standards while allowing performers to move freely.

name: Acoustic Flooring Underlayer
description: Sound-dampening substrate beneath tread finishes that reduces impact noise and enhances the acoustic quality of the performance space.

name: Fire and Life Safety System
description: Integrated sprinkler heads, smoke detection, and emergency lighting meeting egress code requirements while preserving the stage aesthetic.

name: Crowd and Egress Management System
description: Capacity sensors, signage, and control technology ensuring safe occupant flow during events staged on the staircase.

name: Staircase Construction and Installation
description: The fabrication, delivery, and structural installation of the stair flights, stringers, treads, and risers as a unified assembly.

name: Stage Platform Fit-Out Works
description: Construction activity covering the installation of performance-specific elements such as levelled landing surfaces, AV rough-in, and acoustic panels.

name: Structural Formwork and Concrete Pour
description: Construction activity of erecting temporary formwork and casting in-situ concrete to form monolithic stepped seating tiers.

name: Amphitheatre
description: An open or semi-enclosed tiered performance venue sharing the seating-as-steps typology with the staircase-as-a-stage concept.

name: Bleacher Seating Assembly
description: Prefabricated or site-built stepped seating unit closely related to the stair-stage hybrid, used in sports and event venues.

name: Public Atrium
description: A tall multi-level interior void that frequently incorporates staircase-stage elements as centrepieces for civic or commercial interaction.

name: IfcPerformanceHistory
description: IFC entity class (schema IFC4). Supertype: IfcControl.

name: Framed Opening
description: A precisely sized aperture—window, door, or wall cutout—that crops the exterior landscape into a deliberate, picture-like composition.

name: Viewing Alcove
description: A recessed niche or seat bay positioned to align an occupant's sightline directly with the featured natural scene.

name: Borrowed Landscape (Shakkei)
description: The external natural scenery—garden, water body, mountain, or forest—intentionally 'borrowed' as a visual element of the interior composition.

name: Transition Threshold
description: An entry sequence or intermediary zone that obscures the view before revealing it, heightening the moment of visual discovery.

name: Shoji Screen
description: A translucent sliding panel of paper and timber lattice that filters and frames light while softening the boundary between inside and outside.

name: Low Sill Window
description: A floor-level or below-seat-height window that frames ground-plane landscape elements and draws the eye downward into the scene.

name: Engawa (Veranda Buffer)
description: A narrow transitional veranda that mediates between the enclosed interior and the garden view, extending the perceptual reach of the space.

name: Natural Light Diffuser
description: Materials such as washi paper, frosted glass, or bamboo screens that soften and diffuse daylight entering through the viewing aperture.

name: Timber Frame Surround
description: Exposed wood used to border the viewing opening, providing a warm, tactile contrast to the natural scene beyond.

name: Stone or Gravel Garden Feature
description: A curated karesansui (dry landscape) or roji pathway element placed within the sightline to anchor the composed view.

name: Water Feature Element
description: A pond, stream, or tsukubai (stone basin) positioned as a focal point within the framed scene to add movement and reflection.

name: Planting Composition
description: Carefully selected and positioned trees, shrubs, or moss that define seasonal change and layered depth in the viewed landscape.

name: Acoustic Insulation Layer
description: Insulating material integrated around the viewing opening to maintain interior quiet consonant with the meditative quality of the space.

name: IfcWindow (Framed View Opening)
description: The IFC schema entity representing the primary glazed or open aperture through which the Zen view is experienced.

name: IfcSpace (Viewing Zone)
description: The IFC spatial entity bounding the interior zone whose occupant position and sightline are designed around the composed view.

name: Site Survey & Sightline Analysis
description: Pre-design assessment of the site to identify and measure the most compelling natural features available to be framed.

name: View Cone Layout & Positioning
description: Design activity of calculating and plotting the precise occupant sightline, opening size, and distance to the focal landscape feature.

name: Opening Fabrication & Installation
description: Construction activity of cutting, framing, and finishing the aperture to the tolerances required for the intended scenic composition.

name: Landscape Grading & Feature Placement
description: Earthworks and placement of garden elements to align the external scene precisely with the framed opening from the interior viewpoint.

name: Interior Materiality Specification
description: Selection and specification of muted, natural interior finishes that recede visually and draw attention toward the framed view.

name: Seasonal Maintenance of Planting
description: Ongoing horticultural activity to preserve the integrity of the composed planting as it changes through the seasons.

name: Minimalist Interior Fit-Out
description: A coordinated system of restrained furnishings, surfaces, and lighting designed to eliminate visual noise and foreground the exterior scene.

name: Clerestory Windows
description: High-level windows positioned near the ceiling to admit diffused daylight deep into the interior while maintaining privacy.

name: Light Wells
description: Vertical shafts cut through the building fabric to channel natural light from above into otherwise dark interior zones.

name: Shadow Projection Wall
description: A specially designed wall surface that acts as a canvas for projected shadows, enhancing the spatial drama of contrasting light and dark.

name: Perforated Screen Panel
description: Decorative and functional panels with patterned perforations that cast intricate shadow patterns across surfaces when light passes through.

name: Light Diffusing Membrane
description: A translucent fabric or film material stretched across openings to soften and scatter incoming light, reducing harsh contrasts.

name: Dark Absorptive Surface Finish
description: Matte, high-absorption paint or cladding material applied to selected surfaces to define deep shadow zones within the space.

name: Reflective Ceiling Panel
description: Polished or mirror-finished ceiling elements that bounce and redistribute natural or artificial light across the space.

name: Artificial Accent Lighting System
description: A curated network of spotlights, uplights, and directional fixtures that supplement natural light to sustain the light-and-dark composition at night.

name: Daylight Harvesting Control System
description: An automated sensor-driven system that adjusts artificial lighting levels in response to real-time natural light availability.

name: Motorised Shading System
description: Automated blinds, louvers, or shades that modulate incoming sunlight to preserve the intended contrast ratios within the space.

name: Translucent Partition
description: Semi-transparent interior dividers that allow filtered light transmission between zones while maintaining spatial separation.

name: Interstitial Shadow Zone
description: A deliberately darkened sub-space or alcove designed to provide visual relief and contrast against brightly lit areas.

name: Light Atrium
description: A central multi-storey void flooded with natural light, serving as the primary bright anchor of the light-and-dark spatial composition.

name: Brise-Soleil
description: An external sun-shading fin or louvre system fixed to the facade to control direct sunlight entry and sculpt shadow patterns.

name: Photometric Modelling and Simulation
description: The computational analysis of light levels, contrast ratios, and shadow distribution to validate the design intent before construction.

name: Daylighting Design and Specification
description: The specialist design activity of determining aperture sizes, orientations, and materials to achieve target luminance and contrast goals.

name: Lighting Control Commissioning
description: The on-site process of programming, calibrating, and testing all artificial and automated lighting systems to meet the design brief.

name: Surface Finish Installation
description: The application of light-reflective and light-absorptive surface finishes to walls, ceilings, and floors to achieve the intended tonal contrast.

name: Glazing and Fenestration Installation
description: The construction activity of fitting all windows, skylights, and light-transmitting assemblies that govern natural light entry into the space.

name: Master Bathroom (Ensuite)
description: A private bathroom directly connected to the master bedroom, exclusively serving the couple.

name: Walk-In Closet
description: A dedicated dressing and wardrobe room adjoining the master bedroom for the couple's clothing and accessories.

name: His-and-Hers Vanity
description: A dual-sink vanity unit designed for two users to groom simultaneously within the ensuite bathroom.

name: Freestanding Soaking Tub
description: A luxurious standalone bathtub placed in the ensuite, intended for relaxation and intimate bathing.

name: Double-Head Rain Shower
description: A shower system fitted with two overhead rain-style heads to accommodate two bathers at once.

name: King-Size Bed Platform
description: A structural bed platform or base sized for a king or super-king mattress as the focal furniture piece of the master suite.

name: Bedside Reading Nook
description: A small alcove or seating corner adjacent to the bed for quiet reading or relaxation.

name: Sitting / Lounge Area
description: A private seating zone within or attached to the master suite where the couple can relax away from shared living areas.

name: Private Terrace or Balcony
description: An outdoor extension exclusive to the master suite offering privacy and open-air enjoyment for the couple.

name: Fireplace
description: A decorative and functional hearth unit installed in the master suite to create a warm, intimate ambiance.

name: Blackout Window Treatment
description: Heavy curtains, blinds, or motorised shutters that fully block external light for undisturbed sleep.

name: Smart Home Lighting System
description: An automated, dimmable lighting control system that allows mood and scene setting throughout the couple's realm.

name: HVAC Zoning System
description: A dedicated climate-control zone for the master suite, enabling independent temperature management for the couple.

name: In-Floor Radiant Heating
description: Underfloor heating installed in the ensuite and bedroom for comfort, particularly underfoot on hard floor surfaces.

name: Luxury Flooring (Hardwood / Stone)
description: Premium flooring materials such as engineered hardwood or natural stone tiles used to elevate the aesthetic of the suite.

name: Feature Wall / Accent Finish
description: A decorative wall treatment—such as textured wallpaper, panelling, or stone cladding—used as a design focal point behind the bed.

name: Built-In Wardrobe System
description: Custom-fitted shelving, hanging rails, and drawer units integrated into the walk-in closet for organised storage.

name: Vanity Mirror with Integrated Lighting
description: An illuminated mirror above the bathroom vanity providing optimal task lighting for grooming.

name: Security & Privacy Lock System
description: Dedicated door locking and access-control hardware ensuring the couple's suite remains private and secure.

name: Interior Design & Space Planning
description: The design process of laying out furniture, finishes, and spatial flow to create a cohesive and intimate couple's retreat.

name: Electrical & Data Wiring
description: Rough-in and fit-out of electrical circuits, lighting, USB charging points, and data cabling throughout the suite.

name: Tiling & Waterproofing Works
description: Application of waterproof membranes and tile finishes in the ensuite bathroom to prevent water ingress.

name: Joinery & Cabinetry Installation
description: Fitting of custom wardrobes, vanity units, and built-in furniture pieces within the suite.

name: Painting & Decorative Finishing
description: Application of paint, wallcoverings, and feature finishes to walls and ceilings to achieve the desired aesthetic.

name: Play Area

name: Reading Nook
description: A quiet, cozy corner space furnished for children to engage in reading and quiet activities.

name: Craft & Activity Table
description: Child-height tables purpose-built for arts, crafts, and structured learning activities.

name: Soft Play Equipment
description: Foam-padded climbing structures and play units designed for safe indoor physical play.

name: Children's Storage Cubbies
description: Low-level open storage units for children to store belongings, books, and play materials.

name: Interactive Display Wall
description: A wall-mounted panel or digital surface featuring interactive educational or entertainment elements for children.

name: Child-Scale Seating
description: Chairs, stools, and benches scaled and ergonomically designed for young children.

name: Safety Flooring
description: Impact-absorbing, slip-resistant floor material such as rubber or foam tiles suitable for child play environments.

name: Non-Toxic Wall Paint
description: Low-VOC, child-safe paint used on walls and surfaces within areas occupied by children.

name: Acoustic Ceiling Panels
description: Sound-absorbing ceiling tiles or baffles that reduce noise levels in active children's spaces.

name: Themed Décor Finishes
description: Decorative surface treatments, murals, and graphic wraps applied to create an engaging themed environment for children.

name: Children's HVAC Zoning
description: A dedicated ventilation and climate control zone maintaining air quality and temperature appropriate for children's occupancy.

name: Child-Level Lighting System
description: Lighting fixtures and controls positioned and tuned to provide safe, glare-free illumination at child height.

name: CCTV & Supervision System
description: Camera and monitoring infrastructure enabling adult supervision and safeguarding within the children's space.

name: Access Control & Secure Entry
description: Controlled entry system ensuring only authorised adults and children can enter or exit the realm.

name: Emergency Evacuation Signage
description: Low-mounted, pictogram-based wayfinding and emergency exit signs designed to be visible to children.

name: Toilet & Nappy-Change Facility
description: Child-scaled bathroom and infant changing amenity directly associated with or adjacent to the Children's Realm.

name: Parental Waiting Area
description: A supervised seating zone for accompanying adults positioned with sightlines into the children's play space.

name: Storage Room for Play Equipment
description: A dedicated back-of-house room for housing, cleaning, and maintaining toys and play equipment when not in use.

name: Installation of Safety Flooring
description: Construction activity involving the laying and bonding of impact-absorbing floor finishes within the children's space.

name: Themed Mural Painting
description: Specialist decorative painting activity applying child-themed artwork to walls and ceilings of the realm.

name: Soft Play Structure Assembly
description: On-site installation and commissioning of modular soft-play units and climbing frames.

name: Child-Proofing & Safety Inspection
description: Post-construction inspection activity verifying all fixtures, edges, and surfaces meet child safety standards.

name: FF&E Installation – Children's Furnishings
description: Supply and installation of all child-scaled furniture, fittings, and equipment within the realm.

name: IfcSpace – Children's Realm
description: IFC spatial element classifying the Children's Realm as a named, bounded building space within the facility model.

name: IfcFurnishingElement – Play Equipment
description: IFC class representing fixed and loose play furniture and equipment objects within the children's space model.

name: IfcZone – Child Supervision Zone
description: IFC zone grouping all spaces under active child supervision for facilities management and safety compliance tracking.

name: East-Facing Bedroom
description: A bedroom with its primary window or orientation directed toward the east to capture morning sunlight.

name: Morning Light Window
description: A window positioned on the eastern wall to allow early morning natural light into the sleeping space.

name: Solar Orientation Analysis
description: The process of evaluating and planning a building's orientation to optimize east-facing sleeping spaces for natural light and thermal comfort.

name: Blackout Curtain / Blind System
description: Window treatment system installed in east-facing sleeping areas to block early morning light when desired.

name: Thermal Mass Wall (East)
description: An eastern wall constructed with high thermal mass material to absorb and moderate morning solar heat gain in the sleeping area.

name: Sun Path Study
description: A design-phase analysis of the sun's trajectory to inform window placement and shading for east-oriented sleeping rooms.

name: Passive Solar Glazing
description: Specially coated glazing used in east-facing windows to manage solar heat gain and UV transmission in sleeping spaces.

name: External Shading Device
description: A fixed or adjustable overhang, louvre, or fin mounted on the eastern façade to control direct sunlight entering the bedroom.

name: Ventilation System (Cross Ventilation)
description: A ventilation strategy that pairs east-facing openings with opposing windows or vents to promote natural airflow through the sleeping space.

name: Bedroom Interior Layout Planning
description: The spatial arrangement activity that positions the bed and furniture to best exploit the eastern light and views.

name: Thermal Comfort Assessment
description: An evaluation of temperature, humidity, and radiant heat conditions in the east-facing sleeping space throughout the day.

name: IfcSpace (East Bedroom)
description: The IFC data model class used to represent and exchange the east-facing sleeping room as a defined space within a BIM environment.

name: IfcWindow (East-Facing)
description: The IFC class representing the east-facing window opening and its properties within the building information model.

name: Reflective Roofing / Ceiling Material
description: A ceiling or roof surface material with high reflectivity used to manage radiant heat above east-facing sleeping spaces.

name: Window Installation (East Wall)
description: The construction activity of fitting and sealing windows on the eastern elevation of the sleeping room.

name: Insulated Wall Construction (East Façade)
description: The building activity of erecting and insulating the eastern external wall of the sleeping space to meet thermal and acoustic performance targets.

name: Feng Shui / Biophilic Design Compliance Check
description: A design review activity confirming that the east-sleeping orientation meets biophilic or cultural spatial wellness guidelines.

name: Night Noise Barrier
description: A barrier element such as a berm, fence, or façade feature on the eastern perimeter to reduce noise intrusion into the sleeping area.

name: Apron-Front Farmhouse Sink
description: A large, deep, exposed-front sink iconic to farmhouse kitchens, typically made of fireclay or cast iron.

name: Kitchen Island
description: A freestanding or built-in central work surface providing additional prep space, storage, and seating in the kitchen.

name: Open Shelving
description: Wall-mounted shelves without cabinet doors, used to display and access dishware and pantry items in a rustic style.

name: Shaker-Style Cabinetry
description: Recessed-panel wood cabinets with clean, simple lines characteristic of traditional farmhouse aesthetics.

name: Butcher Block Countertop
description: A thick wood countertop surface made from end-grain or edge-grain hardwood, commonly used in farmhouse kitchens.

name: Subway Tile Backsplash
description: Rectangular ceramic or porcelain tiles arranged in a brick pattern used as a wall covering behind cooking and prep areas.

name: Exposed Wood Ceiling Beams
description: Structural or decorative timber beams left visible on the ceiling to reinforce the rustic farmhouse character.

name: Reclaimed Wood
description: Salvaged timber repurposed for shelving, islands, or accent features, adding authentic aged character to the space.

name: Vintage-Style Range
description: A large freestanding cooking appliance with retro or period-inspired styling, often a focal point of the farmhouse kitchen.

name: Pot Rack
description: An overhead or wall-mounted hanging system for storing and displaying cookware, typical of farmhouse kitchen organization.

name: Pantry Cupboard
description: A dedicated tall cabinet or walk-in closet adjacent to the kitchen used for bulk food and supply storage.

name: Kitchen Lighting System
description: The combined arrangement of pendant lights, under-cabinet lighting, and ambient fixtures designed to illuminate all kitchen zones.

name: Cabinet Installation
description: The trade activity of fitting, leveling, and securing kitchen cabinetry to walls and floors during fit-out.

name: Countertop Fabrication and Installation
description: The process of cutting, finishing, and mounting countertop surfaces onto base cabinets to precise dimensions.

name: Tile Setting
description: The skilled trade activity of applying adhesive mortar and grout to install backsplash or floor tile in the kitchen.

name: Beam Installation
description: The structural or finish carpentry activity of positioning and securing ceiling beams, whether load-bearing or decorative.

name: Kitchen Ventilation System
description: The range hood, ductwork, and exhaust fans that remove cooking smoke, grease, and odors from the kitchen environment.

name: Kitchen Electrical System
description: Dedicated circuits, outlets, switches, and lighting wiring designed to meet the high power demands of kitchen appliances.

name: Farmhouse Dining Nook
description: An informal eating area integrated within or immediately adjacent to the farmhouse kitchen, often featuring a built-in bench.

name: Butler's Pantry
description: A secondary prep and storage room connecting the kitchen to a dining area, used for staging meals and storing tableware.

name: Fireclay
description: A dense, heat-resistant ceramic material commonly used to manufacture farmhouse apron sinks and select tile products.

name: Shiplap Wall Cladding
description: Horizontal wood boards with a rabbet joint overlap used as a wall finish material to add rustic texture to kitchen walls.

name: Terrace Paving / Floor Finish
description: The surface layer of the terrace floor, such as stone pavers, tiles, timber decking, or concrete slabs that pedestrians walk on.

name: Terrace Boundary Wall
description: A solid wall element enclosing or partially enclosing the terrace perimeter to define the private space and provide privacy from the street.

name: Terrace Railing / Balustrade
description: A guard or handrail system along the open edges of the terrace to ensure safety and delineate the space boundary.

name: Terrace Gate / Access Door
description: A door or gate element providing controlled access between the street-level terrace and the adjacent interior or public realm.

name: Terrace Pergola / Overhead Structure
description: An overhead framework or canopy structure providing partial shade or weather protection over the terrace area.

name: Terrace Planters / Landscape Beds
description: Built-in or freestanding planter boxes and landscape features used to introduce greenery and further screen the private terrace from the street.

name: Terrace Drainage System
description: The network of channels, gullies, and downpipes that collect and direct rainwater runoff away from the terrace surface.

name: Terrace Lighting System
description: Electrical fixtures and wiring installed to illuminate the terrace area for safety, ambiance, and night-time use.

name: Terrace Irrigation System
description: A piped or drip-feed water supply system serving planters and landscape elements on the terrace.

name: Terrace Waterproofing Membrane
description: A waterproof layer applied beneath the paving finish to prevent water ingress into the structural substrate or underlying building fabric.

name: Terrace Insulation Layer
description: Thermal or acoustic insulation incorporated into the terrace build-up to meet energy performance or comfort requirements.

name: Terrace Structural Slab / Base
description: The load-bearing concrete or structural deck that forms the primary substrate and support for the entire terrace assembly.

name: Terrace Privacy Screen
description: A vertical panel, louvre, or trellis element specifically designed to shield the terrace occupants from neighbouring or street-level sightlines.

name: Street-Facing Facade Interface
description: The section of the building's external wall or facade that directly adjoins and defines the back edge of the street-level terrace.

name: Terrace Furniture & Fixture Provision
description: Structural fixing points, utility outlets, or built-in seating/table elements designed to accommodate outdoor furniture use on the terrace.

name: Terrace Power & Data Outlets
description: Weatherproof electrical and data connection points installed on the terrace to support appliances, heating, or audio-visual equipment.

name: Terrace Construction & Installation Works
description: The on-site construction activity encompassing excavation, substrate preparation, waterproofing application, and laying of the terrace finish.

name: Terrace Waterproofing Works
description: The specialist activity of applying and testing waterproofing membranes and sealants to the terrace substrate before finish layers are installed.

name: Terrace Landscaping Works
description: The activity of installing planters, soil, planting, and soft landscape elements to complete the terrace's green and aesthetic components.

name: Terrace Maintenance & Inspection
description: Periodic inspection, cleaning, and repair activities required to keep the terrace surface, drainage, and boundary elements in serviceable condition.

name: IfcSpace – Terrace
description: The IFC spatial element used to model the terrace as a defined outdoor room within the building's spatial hierarchy.

name: IfcSlab – Terrace Deck
description: The IFC slab class used to represent the structural deck or base slab of the terrace in a BIM model.

name: IfcRailing – Terrace Balustrade
description: The IFC railing class used to model safety railings and balustrades along the terrace perimeter in a BIM model.

name: IfcWall – Terrace Boundary Wall
description: The IFC wall class used to represent solid enclosure or privacy walls around the terrace perimeter in a BIM model.

name: IfcDoor – Terrace Access Gate
description: The IFC door class used to model the access gate or door element connecting the terrace to adjacent spaces or the street.

name: Roof Terrace (Elevated Private Terrace)

name: Front Garden / Forecourt

name: Podium-Level Terrace
description: A variant of the private terrace situated atop a podium structure above ground level, sharing many construction details with street-level terraces.

name: Outdoor Dining / Amenity Area
description: A functionally related space designation for the terrace when used primarily for dining or social amenity activities, requiring specific furniture and service provisions.

name: Personal Study Nook

name: Lockable Entry Door
description: A solid door with a keyed or thumb-turn lock that ensures the occupant's exclusive access and security.

name: Operable Window
description: A window that the sole occupant can open or close at will, providing personal control over ventilation and natural light.

name: Built-In Wardrobe
description: Integrated storage cabinetry for personal clothing and belongings, fitted flush with the room's walls.

name: Writing Desk
description: A dedicated work surface sized and positioned for correspondence, creative, or intellectual tasks within the private space.

name: Personal Bookshelf
description: Fixed or freestanding shelving for the occupant's books, manuscripts, and personal reference materials.

name: Single Occupancy Bed
description: A bed frame and mattress sized for one person, defining the room's residential and restorative function.

name: Independent HVAC Control
description: A dedicated or zone-controlled heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning unit allowing the occupant to set their own thermal comfort levels.

name: Dedicated Electrical Circuit

name: Natural Daylighting System

name: Artificial Task Lighting System

name: Plaster Wall Finish
description: Smooth or textured plasterwork on interior walls providing a durable, paintable surface suited to a refined private interior.

name: Thermal Insulation Batts
description: Mineral wool or glass fibre insulation fitted within wall and ceiling cavities to improve energy efficiency and comfort.

name: Acoustic Sealing and Detailing
description: Installation of acoustic seals, resilient bars, and perimeter isolation strips to eliminate sound flanking paths around the room.

name: Door Hardware Installation
description: Fitting of hinges, lock sets, door closers, and threshold seals to the lockable entry door.

name: Built-In Joinery Fabrication and Installation
description: Custom manufacture and on-site fitting of wardrobes, desk, and shelving units to the room's precise dimensions.

name: Electrical Fit-Off

name: Interior Painting and Decoration
description: Application of primer, paint, or wallcovering to walls and ceilings to personalise and protect the room's interior surfaces.

name: Artist's Studio

name: Reading Room

name: Meditation or Retreat Room
description: A soundproofed, distraction-free room designed for mindfulness, rest, or personal reflection.

name: IfcSpace (Private Occupancy)
description: The IFC schema entity used to model and classify a single-occupancy private room within a building information model.

name: IfcDoor (Lockable)
description: The IFC schema entity representing a lockable door component providing controlled access to the private space.

name: IfcWall (Acoustic Partition)
description: The IFC schema entity for interior partition walls with acoustic performance specifications bounding the private room.

name: Waiting Lounge

name: Reception Seating Area

name: Transitional Sitting Nook

name: Lounge Zone

name: Conversation Alcove

description: A small table placed adjacent to seating to support occupant activities such as placing drinks or reading material.

name: Coffee Table
description: A low central table around which multiple seats are arranged to define a sitting group within the space.

name: Seat Cushion / Upholstery
description: Soft textile or leather covering applied to seating surfaces to provide comfort and define the aesthetic character of sitting spaces.

name: Soft Flooring (Carpet / Rug)
description: Textile floor covering used to demarcate and soften sitting zones within the spatial sequence.

name: Partition / Screen
description: A partial-height divider used to define and separate individual sitting areas within a larger open plan.

name: Planter / Green Wall
description: Vegetated element used as a soft spatial divider or backdrop to create comfortable, biophilic sitting environments.

name: Lighting Fixture (Ambient / Task)
description: Ceiling, wall, or floor luminaire that provides appropriate illumination levels and ambience within each sitting space.

name: HVAC Comfort System
description: Heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning infrastructure that maintains thermal comfort across all sitting areas in the sequence.

name: Electrical & Data Distribution System
description: In-floor or wall-mounted power and data outlets serving occupants in sitting spaces for device charging and connectivity.

name: Fire Detection & Sprinkler System
description: Life-safety infrastructure including smoke detectors and sprinkler heads installed within sitting spaces as required by code.

name: Audio-Visual System
description: Integrated speakers, screens, or display panels providing information or entertainment within sitting areas of the sequence.

name: Space Layout & Furniture Planning
description: The design activity of arranging seating clusters and circulation paths to create a coherent, comfortable spatial sequence.

name: Furniture Installation
description: The on-site activity of assembling and placing seating elements, tables, and accessories within each sitting space.

name: Lighting Installation & Commissioning
description: The electrical trade activity of fitting luminaires and configuring lighting controls to suit the ambience of each sitting space.

name: Partition / Joinery Installation
description: The carpentry or fit-out activity of constructing screens, built-in benches, and joinery elements that define sitting sub-spaces.

name: Individual Bedroom
description: A single sleeping room within the bed cluster, privately assigned to one or more occupants.

name: Shared Bathroom
description: A communal toilet and bathing facility serving multiple bedrooms within the cluster.

name: Cluster Corridor
description: An internal circulation passage linking individual bedrooms and shared facilities within the cluster.

name: Shared Kitchen / Kitchenette
description: A communal food preparation area shared exclusively by occupants of the bed cluster.

name: Common Lounge / Study Room
description: A shared social or study space accessible only to occupants within the cluster.

name: Cluster Entry Lobby
description: A small entry vestibule or airlock space at the main access point to the bed cluster.

name: Cluster Entry Door
description: A secure access door controlling entry to the bed cluster from the wider building circulation.

name: Bedroom Door
description: An individual lockable door providing privacy and access control to each bedroom unit.

name: Acoustic Wall Lining
description: A sound-attenuating lining applied to partition walls to maintain acoustic privacy between bedrooms.

name: Cluster Access Control System
description: An electronic lock or card/fob-based system managing secure entry to the cluster and individual rooms.

name: Electrical Distribution Board
description: A sub-panel within the cluster metering and distributing electrical power to individual rooms and shared facilities.

name: Heating System (Cluster Zone)
description: A localised heating circuit or zone controller regulating thermal comfort within the cluster independently of the wider building.

name: Data & Telecommunications Network
description: Structured cabling, Wi-Fi access points, and network switches providing internet and communications to cluster occupants.

name: Gypsum Plasterboard
description: The primary board material used to construct and line internal partition walls and ceilings within the cluster.

name: Floor Finish (Carpet / LVT)
description: The surface floor covering—typically carpet or luxury vinyl tile—used in bedroom and corridor spaces of the cluster.

name: Fire-Rated Door Leaf & Frame
description: A certified fire-resistant door assembly required at cluster entry and corridors to contain fire spread.

name: Fit-Out & Partition Installation
description: The construction activity of erecting lightweight partition walls, door frames, and linings to form the cluster rooms.

name: MEP Second-Fix & Commissioning
description: Final connection and testing of all mechanical, electrical, and plumbing fixtures and systems within the cluster.

name: Access Control Programming & Commissioning
description: Configuration and testing of the electronic access control system, including credential assignment for each bedroom and cluster entry.

name: Snagging & Pre-Handover Inspection
description: Systematic defect identification and rectification walk-through of all cluster spaces prior to occupancy handover.

name: Studio Room
description: A variant bedroom unit that incorporates a combined sleeping, living, and kitchenette area within a single room in the cluster.

name: Accessible Bedroom Unit
description: A bedroom designed to Part M / ADA accessibility standards with wider doors, turning circles, and adapted bathroom facilities.

name: Resident Advisor (RA) Room
description: A designated bedroom within the cluster assigned to a resident advisor or cluster supervisor in student accommodation contexts.

name: Bathtub
description: A large fixed basin used for soaking or washing the entire body with water.

name: Shower Enclosure
description: A screened or walled area containing a shower head and drain for standing bathing.

name: Shower Tray / Base
description: The waterproof floor receptor that collects water within a shower enclosure.

name: Shower Head
description: A fixed or handheld fitting that disperses water for showering.

name: Washbasin / Sink
description: A wall-mounted or vanity-integrated basin used for handwashing and face washing.

name: Bidet
description: A low-mounted plumbing fixture used for personal hygiene after toilet use.

name: Vanity Unit
description: A combined cabinet and basin unit providing storage and a washing surface.

name: Mirror / Mirror Cabinet
description: A wall-mounted reflective surface or storage cabinet placed above the washbasin.

name: Towel Rail / Heated Towel Rail
description: A wall-fixed bar or heated rack used for hanging and drying towels.

name: Bathroom Door
description: A privacy door, often with moisture-resistant finish, providing access to the bathing room.

name: Wet-Room Floor Drain
description: A linear or point drain set flush in a wet-room floor to remove standing water.

name: Grab Bar / Safety Rail
description: A fixed support bar installed to assist users with mobility and prevent slips.

name: Soap Dish / Dispenser
description: A recessed or surface-mounted accessory for holding or dispensing soap.

name: Toilet Paper Holder
description: A wall-fixed fitting that holds a toilet paper roll within reach of the WC.

name: Bathroom Lighting Fixture
description: IP-rated luminaires designed for safe use in damp or wet bathroom zones.

name: Underfloor Heating
description: A radiant heating system embedded beneath the floor finish to warm the bathing room comfortably.

name: Hot & Cold Water Supply System
description: The pipework network delivering hot and cold potable water to all bathing room fixtures.

name: Drainage & Waste System
description: The pipe network collecting and removing waste water from baths, showers, basins, and WCs.

name: Thermostatic Mixing Valve (TMV)
description: A safety valve that blends hot and cold water to deliver a pre-set safe outlet temperature.

name: Wet Room
description: An open-plan, fully waterproofed bathing space without a separate shower enclosure.

name: Jack-and-Jill Bathroom
description: A shared bathroom accessed from two separate rooms via individual doors.

name: Accessible / Disability-Adapted Bathroom
description: A bathing room designed or retrofitted to meet accessibility standards for users with disabilities.

name: Steam Room / Hammam
description: A thermally sealed bathing space that uses steam for cleansing and relaxation.

name: Ceramic / Porcelain Floor Tile
description: Anti-slip, water-resistant tiles used as the primary floor finish in bathing rooms.

name: Wall Tile
description: Glazed or unglazed ceramic tiles applied to walls for waterproofing and aesthetics.

name: Waterproof Tanking Membrane
description: A liquid-applied or sheet membrane bonded to substrates to prevent water ingress behind finishes.

name: Natural Stone (Marble / Travertine)
description: Premium natural stone used for floor or wall cladding, requiring sealing for moisture resistance.

name: Sanitary Ware Installation
description: The trade activity of fixing and connecting baths, showers, basins, and WCs to supply and waste pipes.

name: Waterproofing / Tanking Works
description: The application of tanking membranes and sealants to all wet surfaces prior to tiling.

name: Tiling Works
description: The fixing of floor and wall tiles including preparation, adhesive bedding, grouting, and sealing.

name: Ventilation Duct Installation
description: The fitting of ductwork and extraction fans to establish the mechanical ventilation system.

name: Electrical First & Second Fix (Bathroom)
description: IP-rated wiring, circuit protection, and fitting of lighting and heated towel rail connections.

name: Bathroom Accessories Fixing
description: Installation of mirrors, towel rails, grab bars, paper holders, and other surface-mounted accessories.

name: Silicone Sealing & Finishing
description: The final application of silicone sealant at all junctions to complete waterproofing and achieve a clean finish.

name: IfcSpace (Bathroom)
description: The IFC spatial element used to define and attribute the bathing room volume within a building model.

name: Pallet Racking System
description: Structural steel shelving framework designed to store materials on pallets in organised vertical tiers within a bulk storage space.

name: Drive-In Racking
description: High-density racking system that allows forklifts to drive directly into the rack structure to access palletised goods stored in deep lanes.

name: Cantilever Racking
description: Open-armed racking system used to store long or irregularly shaped items such as timber, pipes, or rolled materials.

name: Mezzanine Storage Floor
description: Intermediate raised platform level constructed within a bulk storage space to effectively double usable storage floor area.

name: Dock Leveller
description: Mechanical or hydraulic ramp installed at a loading dock to bridge the height difference between the dock floor and a vehicle bed.

name: Dock Shelter / Seal
description: Flexible perimeter enclosure fitted around a loading bay opening to prevent weather ingress and maintain internal temperature during loading operations.

name: Industrial Sectional Door
description: Large vertically-operating door panel system providing vehicle access to bulk storage areas while offering insulation and security.

name: High-Bay Lighting
description: High-intensity luminaire system suspended at significant heights to uniformly illuminate tall bulk storage areas and racking aisles.

name: Industrial Floor Slab
description: Heavily reinforced, high-load-bearing concrete floor slab specifically designed to withstand the point loads imposed by racking feet and forklift traffic.

name: Floor Joint Sealing
description: Purpose-formulated polymer compound used to fill and protect construction and movement joints in industrial floor slabs against wear and forklift damage.

name: Anti-Dust Floor Coating
description: Epoxy or polyurethane surface treatment applied to concrete floor slabs to suppress dust generation and ease cleaning in storage environments.

name: Forklift Charging Station
description: Dedicated electrical infrastructure area within or adjacent to storage space providing power for recharging electric forklift truck batteries.

name: Fire Sprinkler System (In-Rack)
description: Intermediate-level sprinkler heads mounted within racking bays to provide targeted fire suppression in high-piled storage configurations.

name: Smoke Detection System
description: Early-warning detection network of beam or aspirating detectors suited to large-volume, high-bay storage environments.

name: HVLS Fan System
description: High-volume, low-speed ceiling fans used to destratify air and maintain comfortable, consistent conditions across large bulk storage volumes.

name: Rooflights / Skylight Panels
description: Translucent polycarbonate or GRP panels integrated into the roof to introduce natural daylight into the storage floor without relying solely on artificial lighting.

name: Eaves Ventilation
description: Continuous ventilation strip located at the junction of roof and wall enabling passive air circulation to manage temperature and condensation in storage spaces.

name: Column Guard / Racking Protector
description: Steel or polymer impact-absorbing guard fitted to structural columns and racking uprights to protect them from forklift collision damage.

name: Warehouse Management System (WMS)
description: Digital software and hardware infrastructure tracking stock locations, movements, and inventory levels throughout the bulk storage facility.

name: Goods-in Inspection Area
description: Designated zone adjacent to loading docks where incoming deliveries are checked, labelled, and verified before being moved into main storage.

name: Hazardous Materials Store
description: Segregated, fire-rated and ventilated sub-space for the safe storage of flammable, toxic, or regulated goods within a larger storage facility.

name: Cold Store / Refrigerated Storage
description: Thermally insulated and mechanically refrigerated enclosure within a bulk storage facility for perishable or temperature-sensitive goods.

name: Insulated Composite Panel Wall
description: Prefabricated sandwich panel with insulating core used to form the building envelope of bulk storage structures, providing thermal and structural performance.

name: Steel Portal Frame Structure
description: Primary structural system of clear-span steel columns and rafters forming the main load-bearing skeleton of a bulk storage building.

name: Concrete Ground Beam
description: Reinforced concrete perimeter and internal beams that transfer structural loads from the frame to the foundation in storage building construction.

name: Racking Installation
description: On-site construction activity involving the assembly, levelling, anchoring, and load-testing of storage racking systems within the building.

name: Floor Slab Construction
description: Construction activity encompassing laser-guided concrete placement, power floating, curing, and joint cutting for industrial-grade storage floor slabs.

name: Loading Dock Construction
description: Civil and structural works to form recessed vehicle docking bays including retaining walls, pit construction, and dock equipment installation.

name: Movable Partition Wall
description: Non-structural wall panels that can be relocated to change room sizes and layouts without major construction.

name: Modular Workstation
description: Reconfigurable desk and storage units designed to be rearranged or scaled as team sizes change.

name: Hot-Desking Zone
description: An unassigned seating area where employees share desks on a first-come, first-served basis.

name: Integrated Building Management System
