description: A smart control platform that manages lighting, HVAC, and occupancy sensing across dynamically changing zone layouts.

name: Underfloor Air Distribution System
description: An HVAC approach that delivers conditioned air through the raised floor plenum, allowing ventilation outlets to be repositioned with the layout.

name: Demountable Glazed Partition System
description: A proprietary framing and glazing system enabling transparent dividers to be assembled, moved, and reused without damage.

name: Modular Power & Data Cabling
description: A plug-and-play electrical and network infrastructure using floor boxes and busway tracks that can be easily extended or relocated.

name: Acoustic Ceiling Baffle
description: Suspended sound-absorbing panels that control noise levels in open-plan layouts without fixed walls.

name: Addressable LED Lighting Grid
description: A zoned, programmable lighting system allowing illumination levels to be adjusted per work zone without rewiring.

name: Occupancy Sensor Network
description: IoT-based sensors that monitor desk and room utilisation in real time to support space planning decisions.

name: Activity-Based Working Layout
description: A workplace strategy that assigns different zone types (focus, collaboration, social) rather than fixed individual desks.

name: Space Reconfiguration & Fit-Out
description: The physical process of dismantling, moving, and reinstalling partitions, furniture, and services to adapt the office layout.

name: Workplace Utilisation Study
description: A data-collection exercise that analyses occupancy patterns to inform future space planning and downsizing or expansion decisions.

name: High-Pressure Laminate (HPL) Partition Panel
description: A durable, impact-resistant surface material commonly used on movable partition faces for longevity through repeated reconfigurations.

name: Acoustic Fabric Panel
description: Sound-absorbing fabric-wrapped boards used on walls and screens to reduce reverberation in open office environments.

name: Cafeteria
description: A self-service eating space where occupants select food from counters and eat at shared tables.

name: Canteen
description: A staff or institutional food-service space providing subsidised or fixed-menu meals to building occupants.

name: Breakout Dining Area
description: An informal eating zone adjacent to workspaces or corridors, intended for casual communal meals or snacks.

name: Servery Counter
description: A built-in counter unit from which food is distributed or displayed to diners in a communal setting.

name: Food Preparation Kitchen
description: A back-of-house kitchen space dedicated to preparing meals served in the communal eating area.

name: Pass-Through Window
description: An opening in a partition wall that allows prepared food to be handed from kitchen staff to diners or servers.

name: Communal Dining Table
description: A large shared table designed to seat multiple occupants together during meal times.

name: Bench Seating
description: Fixed or freestanding long-bench seating arranged along dining tables to maximise seating capacity.

name: Tray Rail System
description: A linear rail track along a servery counter that guides diner trays through a cafeteria-style food service line.

name: Commercial Dishwashing System
description: An industrial-grade mechanical dishwashing installation used to clean high volumes of crockery and cutlery after communal meals.

name: Food Waste Disposal System
description: Infrastructure for collecting, segregating, and disposing of organic food waste generated in a communal eating facility.

name: Ventilation & Exhaust Hood System
description: A mechanical ventilation system with canopy hoods designed to remove cooking odours, heat, and smoke from kitchen and dining areas.

name: Grease Trap & Interceptor
description: A plumbing device installed in drainage lines to capture fats, oils, and grease before they enter the sewer system.

name: Cold Storage & Refrigeration
description: Walk-in cool rooms, reach-in refrigerators, and freezers used to store perishable food supplies for communal catering.

name: Non-Slip Floor Finish
description: A durable, slip-resistant flooring material specified for dining and servery areas to meet hygiene and safety standards.

name: Hygienic Wall Cladding
description: Smooth, washable wall surface material (e.g., ceramic tile or stainless-steel sheeting) used in food-service zones to meet health regulations.

name: Stainless Steel Benchtop
description: A robust, corrosion-resistant work-surface material used for food preparation and servery counters in catering environments.

name: Fit-Out of Communal Eating Space
description: The construction activity of installing fixtures, fittings, furniture, and finishes within a communal eating area.

name: Mechanical Services Rough-In (Catering)
description: The early-stage construction activity of installing ductwork, gas lines, and plumbing required for a communal catering facility.

name: Health & Hygiene Compliance Inspection
description: A statutory inspection activity to verify that the communal eating facility meets food-safety and public-health regulations before opening.

name: IfcSpace (Dining)
description: The IFC schema class used to represent a defined dining or eating space within a building information model.

name: IfcFurnishingElement (Dining Furniture)
description: The IFC class used to model fixed or loose dining furniture elements such as tables and benches in a BIM environment.

name: IfcFlowTerminal (Kitchen Equipment)
description: The IFC class representing terminal catering and kitchen equipment connected to building services within a communal eating facility.

name: Team Room
description: A dedicated enclosed room designed for a small team of 4–8 people to work, collaborate, and hold discussions in close proximity.

name: Project Room
description: A bookable or assigned room where a cross-functional project team can display work-in-progress materials and meet repeatedly over a project lifecycle.

name: War Room
description: An intensive, dedicated space for a small team to work together under deadline pressure with ample display surfaces and pinup areas.

name: Breakout Space
description: An informal, loosely defined area adjacent to open-plan offices where small groups can briefly convene away from individual desks.

name: Huddle Room
description: A very small meeting space for 2–4 people designed for quick stand-ups, video calls, or short collaborative sessions.

name: Acoustic Partition System
description: A configurable partition assembly used to define and acoustically isolate small work group zones within a larger floor plate.

name: Modular Workstation Cluster
description: A grouped arrangement of linked worksurfaces, screens, and storage units configured to support a co-located small team.

name: Collaborative Furniture Suite
description: A curated set of tables, chairs, and soft seating selected and arranged to facilitate face-to-face teamwork within a small group space.

name: Integrated AV / Display System
description: A coordinated audiovisual system including screens, cameras, and speakers enabling hybrid collaboration for small on-site and remote teams.

name: Underfloor Power & Data Distribution
description: A below-floor network of conduits and outlets delivering electrical and data connectivity to any point within a flexible team workspace.

name: Sound-Masking System
description: An electronic system that emits a low-level ambient sound signal to reduce speech intelligibility and improve privacy in open team areas.

name: Space Planning & Layout Design
description: The professional activity of analysing team size, workflows, and adjacency needs to produce an optimised furniture and zone layout.

name: Furniture Fit-Out
description: The procurement, delivery, and installation of all loose and fixed furniture items within a small work group space.

name: Security Glazing / Screens
description: Laminated or toughened glass panels that provide a protective barrier at the reception counter while maintaining visibility.

name: Feature Wall / Brand Wall
description: A decorative or branded focal-point wall that communicates the organisation's identity to arriving guests.

name: HVAC / Climate Control
description: Heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning provisions that maintain comfortable temperatures for occupants entering from outside.

name: IT and Communications Cabling
description: Structured data, telephone, and AV cabling infrastructure supporting the reception desk's technology requirements.

name: Wall Cladding / Finish
description: Surface material applied to reception walls, such as stone veneer, timber panelling, or painted plasterboard.

name: Seating / Soft Furnishings
description: Chairs, sofas, and occasional tables provided for visitors waiting in the reception area.

name: Reception Counter Top
description: The surface material—often stone, solid surface, or high-pressure laminate—forming the working top of the reception desk.

name: Reception Space Fitout
description: The construction and installation activity encompassing all joinery, finishes, and furnishings to complete the reception interior.

name: Reception Desk Installation
description: The trade activity of assembling and fixing the bespoke or modular reception counter unit in its final position.

name: Wayfinding Signage Installation
description: The activity of fabricating and mounting all directional and identification signage throughout the reception zone.

name: Feature Lighting Installation
description: Specialist electrical activity to install and commission decorative and architectural lighting elements in the reception space.

name: Concierge / Security Booth
description: A secondary staffed enclosure within or beside reception that houses security or concierge personnel separately from the main desk.

name: Lobby / Entrance Vestibule
description: The transitional airlock or entrance foyer immediately before the main reception area that manages weather ingress and building security.

name: Parcel / Delivery Area
description: A dedicated counter or zone within reception where incoming mail, packages, and deliveries are received and logged.

name: Digital Display / Video Wall
description: Large-format screens or video walls used to display brand content, building information, or welcome messages to arriving visitors.

name: Automatic Entrance Doors
description: Sliding, revolving, or swing doors with automated operation that provide accessible, hands-free entry to the reception space.

name: IFC_SPACE (IfcSpace – Reception)
description: The IFC schema entity used to model and identify the reception room boundary within a Building Information Model.

name: IFC_FURNISHING_ELEMENT (IfcFurnishingElement – Reception Desk)
description: The IFC schema entity used to represent the reception desk as a furnishing element within a BIM environment.

name: Waiting Room
description: An enclosed room dedicated to seating and accommodating people while they wait for a service or appointment.

name: Queue Lane
description: A defined linear or switchback corridor space designed to manage orderly queuing of people awaiting service.

name: Transit Shelter
description: A semi-enclosed outdoor structure providing weather protection for people waiting for public transport.

name: Seating Bench
description: A long fixed or freestanding seat accommodating multiple waiting occupants simultaneously.

name: Waiting Chair
description: An individual chair selected and arranged for comfort during extended periods of waiting.

name: Row Seating System
description: A linked gang-seating assembly of chairs fixed to a common frame, commonly used in airports and clinics.

name: Queue Management Barrier
description: Retractable belt posts or fixed barriers that guide and organise queuing lines within a waiting space.

name: Digital Display / Ticketing Board
description: Electronic screens displaying queue numbers, wait times, or service information to waiting occupants.

name: Ticket Dispenser
description: A kiosk or machine that issues numbered tickets to manage turn-based queuing order.

name: Coat Hook / Luggage Storage
description: Wall-mounted hooks or lockers enabling waiting occupants to safely store outerwear and personal belongings.

name: Accessible Waiting Space
description: A designated area within the waiting space that complies with accessibility standards for wheelchair users and mobility-impaired persons.

name: Children's Play Corner
description: A subdivided zone within a waiting area equipped with safe toys or activities to occupy children during waits.

name: Charging Station
description: A power outlet or USB hub integrated into seating or walls to allow occupants to charge personal devices while waiting.

name: Vending Machine Alcove
description: A recessed or dedicated niche housing vending machines for refreshments accessible to waiting occupants.

name: Anti-Slip Floor Finish
description: A durable, slip-resistant flooring material such as textured vinyl or ceramic tile appropriate for high-footfall waiting areas.

name: Soft Furnishing / Upholstery Fabric
description: Hard-wearing, cleanable textile or foam used on waiting chairs and benches for occupant comfort and hygiene compliance.

name: Data and Wi-Fi Infrastructure
description: Cabling, access points, and network equipment providing internet connectivity to occupants and operational displays within the waiting space.

name: Fit-Out and Interior Finishing Works
description: Construction activity covering installation of wall finishes, flooring, ceilings, and built-in joinery to complete the waiting space interior.

name: Seating Installation
description: The activity of positioning, fixing, and commissioning benches, chairs, or row-seating systems within the waiting area.

name: IfcSpace (Waiting Area)
description: The IFC schema class used to represent and exchange the bounded waiting space geometry and attributes in a BIM model.

name: IfcFurnishingElement (Seating)
description: The IFC class representing furniture elements such as chairs and benches placed within the waiting space in a BIM model.

name: IfcZone (Waiting Zone)
description: An IFC grouping construct that aggregates multiple waiting-related spaces or sub-areas into a single named functional zone.

name: Acoustic Wall Panels
description: Sound-absorbing panels mounted on walls to reduce echo and improve speech intelligibility within the meeting room.

name: Suspended Acoustic Ceiling
description: A dropped ceiling system using acoustic tiles designed to minimize noise transmission between floors and adjacent spaces.

name: Glazed Partition Wall
description: Full or partial-height glass partition that visually opens the space while maintaining acoustic separation from corridors or open-plan areas.

name: Solid Partition Wall
description: Opaque demountable or fixed wall system providing full visual and acoustic privacy for the meeting room.

name: Sliding or Folding Door
description: Space-efficient door system that slides or folds to maximise usable floor area when the room is in use.

name: Acoustic Door Set
description: Solid-core door with acoustic seals and threshold drop-seal rated for sound attenuation between the meeting room and adjacent spaces.

name: Video Conferencing System
description: Integrated camera, microphone, speaker, and display system enabling remote participants to join meetings seamlessly.

name: AV Display Screen / Smartboard
description: Wall-mounted flat-panel display or interactive smartboard used for presentations, whiteboarding, and content sharing.

name: Ceiling-Mounted Projector
description: A projector fixed to the ceiling that projects presentation content onto a screen or wall surface.

name: Motorised Projection Screen
description: Retractable screen that deploys electrically from a ceiling-mounted housing for use with a projector.

name: Integrated AV Control System
description: Central touch-panel or app-based controller that manages lighting, blinds, displays, and conferencing equipment in a single interface.

name: Data & Power Floor Box
description: In-floor or table-mounted unit providing electrical outlets, USB charging, and data ports at the point of use.

name: Structured Cabling (Cat6/Fibre)
description: Network of data cabling infrastructure installed within walls, floors, and ceilings to support connectivity requirements.

name: Wireless Access Point
description: Ceiling- or wall-mounted device providing high-density Wi-Fi coverage within the meeting room.

name: LED Recessed Downlights
description: Energy-efficient recessed luminaires providing general ambient illumination across the meeting room ceiling plane.

name: Tunable White / Circadian Lighting
description: Lighting system capable of adjusting colour temperature and intensity to support occupant wellbeing and different meeting modes.

name: Motorised Roller Blinds
description: Electrically operated window blinds that control solar glare on screens and manage privacy from outside.

name: VAV Diffuser / Grille
description: Variable-air-volume ceiling diffuser or linear grille that distributes conditioned air evenly throughout the space.

name: Low-Noise Ventilation Supply/Extract
description: Mechanical ventilation system designed to meet low noise criteria (NC/NR ratings) critical for speech-based meeting environments.

name: CO2 / Air Quality Sensor
description: In-room sensor monitoring carbon dioxide and air quality levels to trigger fresh-air ventilation and maintain occupant alertness.

name: Room Booking Panel
description: Touchscreen display mounted beside the entry door showing real-time availability and allowing ad-hoc or advance room reservations.

name: Room Booking & Scheduling System
description: Software and hardware platform integrating with calendar applications to manage room reservations, utilisation analytics, and occupancy data.

name: Conference Table
description: Central table sized and shaped to accommodate the intended number of meeting participants with integrated or cable-managed services.

name: Ergonomic Meeting Chairs
description: Task or side chairs selected for comfort during short-duration meetings and stacked or nested for flexible room reconfiguration.

name: Credenza / Side Storage Unit
description: Low storage cabinet positioned along a wall providing surface space for equipment, refreshments, and concealed cable management.

name: Whiteboard / Writing Surface
description: Dry-erase or writable wall surface used for analogue brainstorming, note-taking, and visual collaboration.

name: Demountable Partition Installation
description: Site activity involving the assembly and fixing of modular partition wall systems to define and enclose the meeting room.

name: Fit-Out & Furniture Installation
description: Activity of delivering, positioning, and commissioning furniture, fixtures, and loose equipment within the completed shell.

name: M&E Fit-Out Works
description: Mechanical and electrical trade works including luminaire installation, FCU connections, data outlet termination, and sensor commissioning.

name: Snagging & Post-Occupancy Commissioning
description: Inspection and adjustment process carried out after practical completion to resolve defects and fine-tune building systems.

name: Breakout / Informal Meeting Area
description: Adjacent or nearby open collaborative zone that complements bookable meeting rooms for spontaneous or overflow discussions.

name: IFCSpace (Meeting Room)
description: The IFC schema entity used to represent the meeting room as a defined spatial zone within the building information model.

name: IfcWall (Partition)
description: IFC class representing the partition wall elements bounding and subdividing the meeting room within the BIM model.

name: IfcCovering (Ceiling/Floor Finish)
description: IFC class representing ceiling and floor covering elements such as acoustic tiles and carpet tiles assigned to the space.

name: Workstation Cluster
description: A grouped arrangement of desks and work surfaces shared among a small number of occupants in a semi-open office setting.

name: Low Partition Wall
description: A partial-height divider (typically 1.2–1.5 m) that provides visual separation without fully enclosing individual work areas.

name: Glazed Screen
description: A transparent or translucent glass partition that separates areas while maintaining visual openness and natural light sharing.

name: Shared Meeting Nook
description: A small informal collaboration alcove embedded within or adjacent to the half-private office for short team interactions.

name: Storage Wall Unit
description: Floor-to-ceiling or half-height integrated shelving and cabinet system used to define office boundaries and store materials.

name: Overhead Task Lighting
description: Localised lighting fixtures mounted above individual workstations to provide adequate illuminance for desk-based tasks.

name: Building Management System (BMS) Zone Controller
description: Controls environmental parameters such as temperature and ventilation for the discrete zone formed by the half-private office.

name: Data and Power Outlet Cluster
description: Grouped electrical and network connection points serving each workstation, often integrated into the partition or floor box.

name: Demountable Partition System
description: A relocatable wall system that allows the half-private office boundary to be reconfigured without major construction.

name: Suspended Ceiling with Acoustic Tiles
description: A dropped ceiling grid fitted with sound-dampening tiles to control reverberation within the work zone.

name: Ergonomic Chair
description: Adjustable seating unit supplied as a fitted component of the workstation to support occupant health and productivity.

name: Height-Adjustable Desk
description: A sit-stand work surface that allows occupants to alternate posture throughout the working day.

name: Whiteboard or Writing Surface
description: Writable wall panel or mobile board used for informal ideation and communication within the shared work area.

name: Fit-Out and Joinery Work
description: Carpentry and joinery activities covering the installation of built-in storage units, desk surfaces, and millwork items.

name: MEP Rough-In for Workstation Zones
description: Mechanical, electrical, and plumbing first-fix work to route services to individual workstation locations within the office zone.

name: Furniture Commissioning and Layout
description: The final-stage activity of delivering, positioning, and adjusting furniture to match the approved workstation layout plan.

name: IfcPartitioningElement
description: The IFC class representing non-structural internal division elements such as the low or demountable partitions bounding the space.

name: Shared Kitchen
description: A communal kitchen area where multiple tenants prepare and store food.

name: Shared Living Room
description: A communal lounge or sitting area available to all tenants in a shared rental property.

name: Hallway / Circulation Corridor
description: Internal passage space connecting individual rooms and shared facilities within the property.

name: Locking Door Set
description: A lockable door assembly installed on each rentable room to ensure tenant privacy and security.

name: Individual Meter / Sub-Meter
description: A utility sub-metering device installed per room or zone to monitor and bill individual energy or water consumption.

name: Heating System (Per-Room)
description: A room-level heating unit such as a radiator or electric panel heater controllable by the individual tenant.

name: Internet / Data Cabling Infrastructure
description: Structured cabling or Wi-Fi access point network providing broadband connectivity to each rentable room.

name: Intercom / Access Control System
description: Electronic entry system managing secure access to the building and individual rooms for tenants and visitors.

name: Plumbing Supply & Drainage (Multi-Tenant)
description: Extended hot and cold water supply and waste drainage network serving multiple bathrooms and kitchen facilities.

name: Electrical Distribution Board (Landlord Circuit)
description: A dedicated consumer unit or sub-panel managing electrical circuits for shared and individual tenant spaces.

name: Sound Insulation / Acoustic Lining
description: Acoustic insulation material applied to walls, floors, and ceilings to reduce noise transfer between rented rooms.

name: Fire-Rated Partition Board
description: Gypsum or mineral-fibre board with a certified fire resistance rating used in walls separating tenanted spaces.

name: Intumescent Seal / Smoke Seal Strip
description: Passive fire protection strip fitted around door frames to prevent smoke and fire spread between rooms.

name: Furniture Package (Per Room)
description: A standard set of furnished items (bed, wardrobe, desk, chair) provided in each rentable room by the landlord.

name: Room Fit-Out & Finishing Works
description: Construction and decoration activities to bring individual rooms to a lettable standard, including flooring, painting, and fixture installation.

name: Fire Safety Upgrade Works
description: Retrofit construction activities to meet fire safety regulations for multi-occupancy residential use, including door upgrades and detection installation.

name: HMO Licensing Inspection & Compliance
description: The regulatory assessment and certification process required for a House in Multiple Occupation (HMO) licence from the local authority.

name: Plumbing Extension Works
description: Installation of additional pipework, fixtures, and fittings to serve new or converted bathrooms and kitchenettes for multiple tenants.

name: Electrical Rewire / Circuit Extension
description: Electrical installation work to add or upgrade circuits, sockets, and lighting for each new rentable room.

name: House in Multiple Occupation (HMO)
description: A legally defined residential property category where three or more unrelated tenants share facilities, requiring specific licensing and standards.

name: Bedsit / Studio Unit
description: A self-contained or semi-self-contained single room combining sleeping, living, and sometimes cooking functions for one tenant.

name: Landlord Common Area
description: Any shared internal or external area maintained by the landlord for the collective use of all tenants in the property.

name: Tenancy Agreement / Room Licence
description: The legal documentation and signing process establishing the rental terms between landlord and individual room tenant.

name: Waste & Recycling Storage Area
description: A designated external or internal area for bins and recycling containers serving all tenants of the property.

name: Sleeping Loft
description: An elevated sleeping area within the cottage providing a private bedroom zone for the teenager.

name: Study Nook
description: A dedicated compact area equipped for homework, reading, and personal study activities.

name: Lounge/Hangout Area
description: An informal social space designed for relaxing, gaming, or entertaining friends.

name: Bathroom/Ensuite
description: A private bathroom facility within or directly attached to the cottage for the teenager's exclusive use.

name: Wardrobe/Storage Space
description: Dedicated storage area for clothing, personal items, and general belongings.

name: Entry/Mudroom
description: A small transitional zone at the cottage entrance for removing shoes and storing outdoor gear.

name: Timber Frame Structure
description: The primary structural framing system of the cottage, typically lightweight timber suited to a small detached structure.

name: Insulated Wall Panel
description: Prefabricated or site-built wall panels with integrated insulation to maintain thermal comfort in the cottage.

name: Loft Floor Deck
description: The structural floor platform forming the sleeping loft, including joists, decking, and safety railing.

name: Roof Truss / Rafter System
description: The overhead framing members that support the roof cladding and define the cottage's ceiling profile.

name: Skylights
description: Roof-mounted glazed units that introduce natural daylight and ventilation into the cottage interior.

name: Sliding or Barn Door
description: Space-saving interior or entry door commonly used in compact cottage layouts to maximise usable floor area.

name: Loft Access Ladder or Stair
description: A compact vertical access element connecting the ground floor to the sleeping loft.

name: Deck / Outdoor Platform
description: An external timber or composite platform extending the usable living space outdoors.

name: Mini-Split Air Conditioning Unit
description: A ductless heating and cooling system sized appropriately for a small detached dwelling.

name: Electrical Sub-Board
description: A dedicated electrical distribution board supplying power circuits throughout the cottage.

name: Data and AV Cabling
description: Low-voltage wiring infrastructure for internet, television, and entertainment systems tailored to teenager use.

name: Mechanical Ventilation / ERV
description: A mechanical fresh-air system ensuring adequate air quality within the airtight insulated cottage envelope.

name: Plywood Sheathing
description: Structural panel material used for wall, floor, and roof sheathing providing rigidity and a nail base.

name: Concrete Pier / Pad Footing
description: Concrete foundation elements that elevate and anchor the cottage to the ground without a full slab.

name: Metal Roofing Sheet
description: Lightweight corrugated or standing-seam steel roofing commonly used on small cottages for durability and low maintenance.

name: Acoustic Insulation Batts
description: Sound-absorbing insulation installed in walls and ceiling to provide privacy between the cottage and the main house.

name: Foundation/Footing Installation
description: Construction activity involving placement of concrete piers, pads, or strip footings to support the cottage structure.

name: Framing and Structural Assembly
description: On-site erection of wall frames, floor systems, and roof structure forming the cottage skeleton.

name: Electrical Rough-In and Fit-Off
description: Two-stage electrical installation covering cable routing during construction and fixture installation at completion.

name: Plumbing Rough-In and Fit-Off
description: Two-stage plumbing installation covering pipe installation within the structure and final fixture connection.

name: Internal Lining and Painting
description: Fixing of internal plasterboard or ply lining, jointing, and painting of all interior surfaces.

name: Deck Construction
description: Building the external timber deck including footings, framing, decking boards, and balustrades.

name: Planning Permit / Zoning Approval
description: Administrative approval process to confirm the cottage meets local council regulations for secondary dwellings or outbuildings.

name: Backyard Studio / Granny Flat
description: A closely related secondary dwelling typology that shares design principles with a teenager's cottage but serves broader occupancy.

name: Garden Shed Conversion
description: An adapted outbuilding repurposed as a habitable teenager retreat, representing a related but distinct spatial concept.

name: IfcSpace (Cottage Unit)
description: IFC classification representing the cottage as a bounded spatial unit within a building information model.

name: IfcSlab (Loft Deck)
description: IFC class representing the loft floor slab or deck element within the cottage model.

name: Accessible Entrance Ramp
description: A sloped pathway at the cottage entrance designed to allow wheelchair and mobility-aid access for elderly residents.

name: Grab Rails & Handrails
description: Safety rails installed in bathrooms, corridors, and staircases to support elderly residents in maintaining balance and preventing falls.

name: Step-Free Threshold
description: A flush or ramped door threshold eliminating trip hazards for residents with limited mobility.

name: Wet Room / Walk-In Shower
description: A fully waterproofed bathroom space with no step or tray, specifically designed for safe use by elderly or mobility-impaired occupants.

name: Emergency Call System
description: An integrated alarm and communication system allowing elderly residents to summon help quickly in case of a medical emergency.

name: Widened Doorways
description: Door openings sized to a minimum 900 mm clear width to accommodate wheelchairs and walking frames.

name: Level-Access Bedroom
description: A single-storey or ground-floor bedroom arranged for ease of access and proximity to bathroom facilities for elderly residents.

name: Kitchenette / Adapted Kitchen
description: A compact, ergonomically arranged kitchen with lowered worktops and accessible storage for elderly or less-mobile residents.

name: Insulated External Walls
description: Thermally efficient wall construction to maintain comfortable interior temperatures and reduce heating demands for elderly occupants.

name: Low-Threshold Windows
description: Windows positioned and designed for easy operation and unobstructed views from a seated position for elderly residents.

name: Communal Garden / Outdoor Space
description: A shared or private accessible outdoor area with level paths and raised planters supporting wellbeing and gentle activity for elderly residents.

name: Stairlift Installation
description: The procurement and fitting of a motorised chair lift on a staircase to assist elderly residents in moving between floor levels.

name: Accessibility Adaptation Works
description: Renovation and retrofit activities carried out to upgrade an existing cottage to meet elderly-occupant accessibility standards.

name: Disabled Facilities Grant Assessment
description: A formal evaluation process to determine eligibility and scope of government-funded adaptations for elderly or disabled cottage occupants.

name: Smart Home Assistive Technology
description: Voice-activated and automated controls for lighting, heating, and security enabling elderly residents to manage their environment with minimal physical effort.

name: Dementia-Friendly Lighting Design
description: Carefully specified, high-CRI and well-distributed lighting layout that reduces confusion, shadows, and disorientation for residents with cognitive impairments.

name: Thermally Broken Window Frames
description: Window frame material with an insulating barrier that prevents cold bridging, improving thermal comfort for elderly occupants.

name: Warden / Assisted Living Unit
description: A dedicated on-site or adjacent space for a care warden or support worker overseeing the welfare of elderly cottage residents.

name: IfcSpace (Accessible Dwelling)
description: The IFC schema class used to represent the accessible dwelling space of the old age cottage within a Building Information Model.

name: Fixed Workstation
description: A permanently assigned desk or bench unit where an individual performs focused, stationary work tasks.

name: Enclosed Private Office
description: A fully enclosed room allocated to one or more individuals for concentrated, uninterrupted work.

name: Cubicle / Workstation Pod
description: A semi-enclosed work area defined by low-to-medium-height partition screens providing visual and acoustic separation.

name: Desk Partition / Screen
description: A panel mounted on or between desks to provide acoustic dampening and visual privacy at the workstation level.

name: Under-Desk Cable Management Tray
description: A tray or raceway system fitted beneath the work surface to organise and conceal power and data cabling.

name: Power & Data Floor Box
description: A flush-mounted floor outlet providing electrical power and data connectivity directly at the point of use within the workspace.

name: Office HVAC Distribution System
description: The network of ducts, diffusers, and controls that delivers conditioned air to maintain thermal comfort in settled work zones.

name: Acoustic Ceiling Tile System
description: A suspended tile ceiling system engineered to absorb sound and reduce noise transmission in open and enclosed work areas.

name: Building Automation & Occupancy Sensing System
description: Smart sensors and controls that monitor occupancy and adjust lighting, HVAC, and energy use in real time across work zones.

name: Integrated Office Furniture System
description: A coordinated suite of desks, pedestals, storage units, and screens designed to work together as a modular workplace solution.

name: Acoustic Flooring Finish
description: A carpet tile, resilient vinyl, or rubber surface layer selected for its sound-absorption and underfoot-comfort properties in work areas.

name: Demountable / Relocatable Partition System
description: Prefabricated, reusable wall panels that can be assembled and disassembled to reconfigure settled work boundaries without wet trades.

name: Workstation Installation & Fit-Out
description: The trade activity of assembling, positioning, and commissioning furniture systems, screens, and ancillary components within the work area.

name: Power & Data Cabling Rough-In
description: The first-fix electrical and data cabling installation that provisions outlets and network points at each settled workstation location.

name: Lighting Layout & Commissioning
description: The design, installation, and testing of general ambient and task lighting circuits to achieve required lux levels across the work zone.

name: HVAC Balancing & Commissioning
description: The process of testing and adjusting air-handling equipment and diffusers to achieve design airflow rates throughout the settled work area.

name: Focused Work Zone
description: A designated quiet area within an office floor plate optimised for deep, concentration-intensive individual work.

name: Touchdown / Hotdesk Area
description: A flexible, non-assigned desk zone used on a first-come basis by mobile workers needing a temporary settled work position.

name: Quiet Room / Phone Booth
description: A small, acoustically isolated enclosure adjacent to the open work area providing a retreat for private calls or focused tasks.

name: IfcWorkspace
description: The IFC classification element used to model and exchange data about defined work areas and their spatial boundaries in a BIM environment.

name: Workbench
description: A sturdy, flat-surfaced table used for manual tasks such as woodworking, assembly, or repairs.

name: Tool Storage Cabinet
description: A lockable cabinet or chest dedicated to organizing and securing hand tools and power tools.

name: Pegboard Wall Panel
description: A perforated hardboard panel mounted on walls to hang and display tools for easy access.

name: Overhead Storage Shelving
description: Ceiling-mounted or high-wall shelving units used to store bulky materials and infrequently used equipment.

name: Dust Collection System
description: A ventilation and filtration system that captures sawdust and fine particulates generated during woodworking or cutting operations.

name: Workshop Electrical Power System
description: A dedicated circuit panel with multiple 20–240V outlets, including dedicated circuits for high-draw power tools.

name: Workshop Lighting System
description: High-intensity, shadow-minimizing task and ambient lighting designed specifically for precision work environments.

name: Ventilation & Exhaust System
description: Mechanical ventilation fans and exhaust ducting that remove fumes, vapors, and airborne particles to maintain air quality.

name: Garage Workshop
description: A workshop variant integrated into or converted from a residential garage, sharing vehicle storage and utility access.

name: Basement Workshop
description: A workshop variant located in a home's basement, leveraging existing foundation walls for soundproofing and climate stability.

name: Detached Backyard Workshop
description: A freestanding outbuilding in the backyard purpose-built as a dedicated workshop, separate from the main dwelling.

name: Woodworking Workshop
description: A workshop variant specifically outfitted with woodworking machinery such as table saws, lathes, and routers.

name: Metal Fabrication Workshop
description: A workshop variant equipped for welding, grinding, and metalworking, requiring fireproof surfaces and enhanced ventilation.

name: Electronics / Maker Lab
description: A workshop variant focused on electronics assembly and prototyping, featuring ESD-safe surfaces and precision lighting.

name: Concrete Slab Floor
description: A reinforced concrete floor surface preferred in workshops for its durability, load-bearing capacity, and ease of cleaning.

name: Anti-Fatigue Floor Mat
description: Cushioned rubber or foam matting placed over hard floors to reduce operator fatigue during prolonged standing work.

name: Fire-Resistant Drywall (Type X)
description: Gypsum board with glass fibers providing enhanced fire resistance, used on walls and ceilings adjacent to combustible materials.

name: Soundproofing Insulation
description: Acoustic insulation batts or mass-loaded vinyl installed in walls and ceilings to contain machinery noise within the workshop.

name: Workshop Construction & Fit-Out
description: The construction or conversion process of building out a dedicated workshop space, including framing, insulation, and utility rough-in.

name: Electrical Circuit Installation
description: The installation of dedicated high-amperage circuits, sub-panels, and specialty outlets to support power tool demands.

name: Dust Collection Duct Installation
description: The fabrication and installation of ductwork connecting power tools to a centralized dust collector.

name: Workbench Fabrication & Installation
description: The custom building or purchased assembly and anchoring of workbenches to the floor or walls for stability.

name: Workshop Insulation Installation
description: The installation of thermal and acoustic insulation to regulate temperature and reduce noise transmission in the workshop.

name: Tool Organization & Layout Planning
description: The ergonomic planning and physical arrangement of tools, storage, and machines to optimize workflow and safety.

name: Safety Inspection & Compliance Review
description: A formal review of the workshop against fire, electrical, and occupational safety codes prior to use or permit sign-off.

name: Guardrail
description: A protective barrier at the open side of the stair or landing to prevent falls into open voids.

name: Central Spine Beam
description: A single longitudinal structural member running along the centre of the stair from which individual treads cantilever outward.

name: Tread Fixing Bracket
description: A metal or engineered bracket used to attach individual treads to the stringer or spine without visible fasteners.

name: Glass Balustrade Panel
description: A frameless or framed glass infill panel used in place of traditional balusters to maintain openness and visibility.

name: Cable Railing System
description: A tensioned horizontal or vertical wire-cable assembly used as an open infill between posts and handrail on the stair.

name: Hardwood Timber Tread
description: Solid hardwood plank used as the walking surface of each step, common in contemporary open-stair designs.

name: Structural Glass Tread
description: Laminated or toughened glass used as the tread surface to emphasise transparency and openness in floating stairs.

name: Concrete Stair Tread
description: A precast or cast-in-place concrete element forming each step, often used in open industrial or architectural stairs.

name: Stair Lighting System
description: Integrated LED or recessed luminaires installed in treads, risers, or stringers to illuminate the open stair safely.

name: Acoustic Underlay
description: A resilient material placed beneath or between stair components to dampen footfall impact sound transmission.

name: Stair Installation
description: The on-site assembly and fixing of all stair components including stringers, treads, and balustrade into their final position.

name: Stair Structural Design
description: The engineering analysis and sizing of the stair structure to ensure it meets load, deflection, and safety requirements.

name: Tread Surface Finishing
description: The sanding, staining, painting, or sealing of tread surfaces carried out as a final finish after structural installation.

name: Stair Void
description: The open floor opening through which the stair passes, requiring edge protection and coordinated with structural floor framing.

name: Understairs Space
description: The usable or semi-enclosed area beneath the stair flight, often utilised for storage, services, or integrated furniture.

name: Window Placement Strategy
description: The deliberate positioning of windows on at least two distinct walls of a room to ensure light enters from multiple directions.

name: Exterior Wall Opening
description: A structural aperture cut into an exterior wall to accommodate a window or glazed element that admits daylight.

name: Glazing Unit
description: The glass or transparent panel assembly installed within a window frame that transmits daylight into the interior.

name: Reveal
description: The exposed inner face of a wall between the window frame and the interior surface, which scatters and softens incoming light.

name: Interior Partition Layout
description: The arrangement of interior walls and partitions designed to preserve sightlines and daylight paths to windows on multiple sides of each room.

name: Room Depth-to-Window Ratio
description: The proportional relationship between a room's depth and its window area used to verify adequate bilateral daylighting penetration.

name: Corner Room Configuration
description: A room located at the building corner where two exterior walls are inherently available for window placement on separate sides.

name: Daylight Factor Analysis
description: A simulation or calculation process measuring the ratio of interior illuminance to external sky illuminance to verify adequate bilateral daylighting.

name: Opening Cutting and Forming
description: The construction activity of creating or enlarging apertures in existing walls to accommodate additional windows for bilateral light.

name: Daylighting Design Simulation
description: The use of software tools to model and optimise the distribution of natural light entering a room from multiple window positions.

name: Glazing Performance Testing
description: The testing and verification of light transmittance, U-value, and solar heat gain coefficient of glazing units after installation.

name: Electric Lighting Control System
description: A sensor-based or automated system that dims or switches artificial lighting in response to the level of natural daylight from multiple windows.

name: Drip Edge
description: A metal flashing profile installed at the roof perimeter to direct water away from the fascia and into the gutter.

name: Edge Flashing
description: Sheet metal or membrane detailing installed at roof and wall junctions to prevent water ingress at the building perimeter.

name: Expansion Joint at Perimeter
description: A designed gap with filler at the building edge allowing thermal and structural movement without causing damage.

name: Edge Beam
description: A structural beam running along the perimeter of a floor or roof slab to define and support the building edge.

name: Curtain Wall Edge Condition
description: The termination detail of a curtain wall system at the building perimeter, including anchor, mullion, and weathering provisions.

name: Canopy
description: A projecting roof-like structure at the building edge over entrances or openings, providing weather protection.

name: Verge
description: The edge of a pitched roof at the gable end, finished with a verge trim or barge board to seal and protect the roof edge.

name: Barge Board
description: A board fixed along the sloping gable edge of a roof, protecting the end rafters and providing a decorative finish.

name: Perimeter Insulation
description: Thermal insulation installed at the building edge to prevent cold bridging and maintain the continuity of the thermal envelope.

name: Waterproofing Membrane at Edge
description: A specialist membrane applied at the roof or slab edge to prevent moisture penetration at the most vulnerable perimeter zone.

name: Edge Protection Barrier
description: Temporary or permanent physical barrier installed at open building edges during construction or occupation to prevent falls.

name: Perimeter Scaffold
description: A temporary scaffolding structure erected around the exterior edge of a building to provide safe access for construction and maintenance.

name: Edge Sealing
description: The process of applying sealants or mastics to joints and gaps at the building perimeter to achieve weathertightness and airtightness.

name: Roof Edge Installation
description: The construction activity of fixing drip edges, copings, flashings, and associated components along the roof perimeter.

name: Perimeter Waterproofing
description: The application of waterproofing systems specifically at the building edge and below-grade perimeter to prevent water ingress.

name: Edge Survey
description: An inspection and measurement activity focused on assessing the condition, alignment, and weathertightness of all building edges.

name: South-Facing Window
description: A window oriented toward the south to maximise solar gain and natural light penetration into the space.

name: Thermal Mass Wall
description: A dense wall element (e.g., concrete or brick) that absorbs, stores, and slowly releases solar heat energy within the space.

name: Glazed Facade Panel
description: A large transparent or translucent panel forming part of the enclosure that maximises solar light transmission.

name: Reflective Ceiling Surface
description: A light-coloured or specular ceiling finish used to distribute and amplify natural daylight throughout the space.

name: Solar Heat Gain Glazing
description: High-performance glass with a high solar heat gain coefficient (SHGC) specified to maximise passive solar energy capture.

name: Low-E Coating
description: A microscopically thin metallic coating applied to glazing to selectively admit visible light while reducing unwanted infrared heat transfer.

name: Light-Coloured Floor Finish
description: A pale or reflective floor material that increases light reflectance and contributes to the bright, sunny character of the space.

name: Phase Change Material (PCM) Panel
description: A building material that absorbs and releases latent heat to regulate temperature swings caused by intense solar gain.

name: Sunroom / Solarium
description: A glazed room variant specifically designed to capture and enjoy abundant sunlight, often used for relaxation or plant cultivation.

name: Conservatory
description: A largely glazed structure attached to a building that creates a warm, light-filled transitional space between interior and exterior.

name: Passive Solar Design
description: The architectural process of orienting and configuring a building to harvest free solar energy for heating and lighting.

name: Daylight Factor Simulation
description: A computational activity that models and measures the proportion of exterior daylight available inside the space under overcast sky conditions.

name: Solar Shading Installation
description: The construction activity of fitting external or internal shading elements to balance solar gain and occupant comfort.

name: North-Facing Exterior Wall
description: The primary vertical envelope element on the north side of a building, designed to manage reduced solar gain and increased thermal loss.

name: North Facade Cladding
description: The outermost layer of material applied to the north-facing wall surface, selected for durability against moisture and low-solar-radiation conditions.

name: North Face Glazing
description: Windows and glazed openings positioned on the north face, typically specified for diffuse daylighting while minimising heat loss.

name: North Face Insulation Layer
description: Thermal insulation installed within or behind the north-facing wall assembly to compensate for the lack of solar heat gain.

name: North Face Weatherproofing Membrane
description: A vapour-control or breather membrane applied to the north wall to resist moisture ingress driven by prevailing wind and rain.

name: North Face Parapet
description: The upward extension of the north-facing wall above the roof line, providing edge protection and weather shielding.

name: North Face Lintel
description: Structural beam spanning openings in the north wall, transferring loads around windows and doors.

name: North Face Cavity
description: The air or insulation-filled gap within the north-facing cavity wall construction that improves thermal and moisture performance.

name: North Face Reveal
description: The interior side surfaces of window or door openings cut through the north wall, affecting thermal bridging and finishing details.

name: North Face Shading Device
description: Brise-soleil, fins, or overhangs attached to the north facade to control diffuse sky glare and precipitation run-off.

name: North Face Rainscreen System
description: A drained and ventilated cladding system installed on the north face to manage moisture accumulation and allow the wall to dry.

name: North Face Curtain Wall System
description: A non-load-bearing glazed or panel facade system spanning the full height of the north elevation.

name: North Face Ventilation Opening
description: Purpose-designed vents or louvres in the north wall providing controlled fresh-air intake away from direct solar exposure.

name: North Face Drainage Channel
description: Horizontal drainage elements at the base of the north wall to direct water away from the foundation in the shade-prone, moisture-retaining zone.

name: North Face Foundation Interface
description: The junction between the north external wall and the foundation or ground slab, requiring careful detailing to prevent cold bridging and damp ingress.

name: North Face Roof Junction
description: The abutment detail where the north-facing wall meets the roof structure, critical for weathertightness and thermal continuity.

name: North Face Solar Exposure Zone
description: The external ground-level zone adjacent to the north face characterised by permanent shade, influencing landscaping, drainage, and microclimate.

name: North Face Wind-Driven Rain Zone
description: The atmospheric zone immediately in front of the north facade that receives concentrated wind-driven rain exposure requiring specialist detailing.

name: IFC Curtain Wall (IfcCurtainWall)
description: The IFC schema class representing a non-load-bearing north face curtain wall assembly in BIM data.

name: IFC Window (IfcWindow)
description: The IFC schema class used to model individual glazed openings within the north facade.

name: North Face Facade Survey
description: Inspection and condition assessment of the north-facing facade to identify moisture damage, bio-growth, and material degradation.

name: North Face Cladding Installation
description: The construction activity of fixing cladding panels or masonry to the north-facing wall frame or substrate.

name: North Face Insulation Installation
description: The process of fitting and securing thermal insulation to the north wall to achieve required U-value performance.

name: North Face Weatherproofing Application
description: Application of membranes, sealants, or renders to the north facade to achieve weathertight performance.

name: North Face Glazing Installation
description: Fitting and sealing of windows or curtain wall panels into openings on the north elevation.

name: North Face Cleaning & Maintenance
description: Periodic removal of biological growth (moss, algae) and dirt accumulation that is more prevalent on shaded north-facing surfaces.

name: North Face Thermal Bridging Assessment
description: Engineering analysis to identify and mitigate linear and point thermal bridges within the north wall construction.

name: North Face Air-Tightness Testing
description: Pressure testing of the north facade assembly to verify compliance with air-leakage requirements.

name: North Face U-Value Calculation
description: Thermal transmittance calculation for the north wall build-up to confirm energy performance compliance.

name: North Face Bio-Growth Treatment
description: Application of biocidal treatments to the north facade surface to control persistent moss, lichen, and algae common in low-sun orientations.

name: Shade Sail
description: A tensioned fabric canopy stretched between anchor points to provide sun protection and visual enclosure overhead.

name: Retractable Awning
description: A motorised or manual folding canopy attached to a wall that extends to cover the outdoor space on demand.

name: Garden Wall / Feature Wall
description: A solid masonry or rendered boundary wall that encloses one or more sides of the outdoor room and may serve as a backdrop feature.

name: Outdoor Flooring / Paving
description: A defined ground-level surface of pavers, timber decking, or composite boards that distinguishes the outdoor room from surrounding landscape.

name: Decking Platform
description: A raised or ground-level timber or composite deck that forms the primary floor of the outdoor room.

name: Outdoor Kitchen / BBQ Station
description: A built-in cooking and preparation unit with benchtops, sink, and appliances designed for permanent exterior installation.

name: Outdoor Fireplace / Fire Pit
description: A fixed or portable combustion feature that provides warmth, ambience, and a focal point within the outdoor room.

name: Outdoor Ceiling Fan
description: A weather-rated fan mounted to a pergola beam or ceiling structure to improve air circulation and comfort.

name: Outdoor Heating System
description: Infrared or gas radiant heaters installed overhead or on walls to extend the usability of the space in cooler weather.

name: Misting / Cooling System
description: A high-pressure water misting network installed at the perimeter or overhead to reduce ambient temperature in hot climates.

name: Outdoor Audio-Visual System
description: Weatherproof speakers, screens, and control equipment integrated into the outdoor room for entertainment purposes.

name: Outdoor Drainage System
description: Stormwater channels, grates, and underground pipes designed to manage rainwater runoff from the outdoor room surface.

name: Landscape Planting / Green Screen
description: Strategically planted hedges, climbers, or feature plants that soften enclosure edges and provide living walls.

name: Timber Decking Boards
description: Hardwood, softwood, or composite boards used as the primary flooring material for the outdoor room platform.

name: Natural Stone Pavers
description: Cut or split stone tiles such as bluestone, travertine, or sandstone used for the outdoor room ground surface.

name: Concrete Pavers
description: Pre-cast or poured concrete units forming a durable and cost-effective outdoor flooring surface.

name: Weatherproof Fabric / Shade Cloth
description: UV-stabilised textile used for sail shades, curtains, or screen infills within the outdoor room enclosure.

name: Powder-Coated Steel / Aluminium Framing
description: Corrosion-resistant metal profiles used for pergola posts, beams, and screen frames in exterior environments.

name: Outdoor Curtains / Blinds
description: Weatherproof fabric or PVC roller blinds hung at the perimeter to provide adjustable privacy and wind protection.

name: Concrete Footing & Post Installation
description: Drilling, forming, and pouring of concrete footings to anchor pergola posts and structural columns securely.

name: Structural Framing Erection
description: Assembly and installation of the pergola or overhead structure frame including beams, rafters, and purlins.

name: Electrical Rough-In & Fit-Off (Outdoor)
description: Installation of weatherproof conduit, wiring, outlets, and light fittings to power the outdoor room's electrical systems.

name: Plumbing Rough-In (Outdoor Kitchen/BBQ)
description: Running water supply and drainage lines to service an outdoor kitchen, sink, or misting system.

name: Alfresco Dining Area
description: A dedicated sub-zone within the outdoor room configured with a table and seating for outdoor meals.

name: Outdoor Lounge Zone
description: A relaxed seating sub-zone within the outdoor room furnished with sofas or day beds for leisure and conversation.

name: Transitional Indoor-Outdoor Zone
description: The threshold area where the outdoor room connects to the interior, typically defined by bi-fold or sliding doors.

name: Louvred Roof System
description: An automated or manual adjustable-blade roofing system that controls sun, rain, and ventilation over the outdoor room.

name: Glazing Bar / Muntin
description: Thin dividing bars within the window that subdivide the glazed area into smaller panes, either structurally or decoratively.

name: Window Lintel
description: A horizontal structural beam positioned above the window opening to carry the load of the wall above and transfer it to the surrounding masonry or frame.

name: Window Reveal
description: The recessed depth of wall surface visible between the outer wall face and the window frame, affecting light diffusion and aesthetic appearance.

name: Window Hardware / Ironmongery
description: Handles, locks, hinges, stays, and associated fittings that allow operation, security, and ventilation control of the window sash.

name: Low-E Glazing
description: Glass coated with a microscopically thin metallic layer that reflects infrared radiation to reduce heat transfer while maintaining visible light transmission.

name: Laminated Safety Glass
description: Glass bonded with a polyvinyl butyral interlayer so that, if broken, fragments adhere to the film rather than scattering, enhancing safety and security.

name: Window Frame Material – Aluminium
description: Extruded aluminium alloy profile used for window frames offering high strength-to-weight ratio, corrosion resistance, and slim sight lines.

name: Window Frame Material – Timber
description: Wooden profile used for window frames providing natural aesthetics, good thermal performance, and suitability for heritage or traditional façades.

name: Window Frame Material – uPVC
description: Unplasticised polyvinyl chloride extruded profile used for window frames offering low maintenance, good thermal insulation, and cost-effectiveness.

name: Window Frame Material – Steel
description: Hot- or cold-rolled steel profile used for slender, high-strength window frames typically seen in industrial, heritage, and Crittall-style applications.

name: Sash Window (Double-Hung)
description: A traditional window type with two overlapping sashes that slide vertically within the frame, commonly found on period street façades.

name: Tilt-and-Turn Window
description: A window sash that can both tilt inward from the top for ventilation and turn fully open on a side hinge, common in European construction.

name: Louvred Window
description: A window composed of angled glass or material slats that can be tilted to control airflow and privacy, often used in warm-climate street façades.

name: Oriel Window
description: An upper-storey projecting window supported by corbels or brackets that does not extend to ground level, characteristic of historic street frontages.

name: Shop / Display Window
description: Large-format street-level glazed opening in a commercial building designed to display merchandise and engage pedestrians on the public realm.

name: Window Reveal Depth / Setback
description: The dimensional relationship between the glazing plane and the outer wall face, influencing solar shading, visual depth, and street character.

name: Window Replacement / Refurbishment
description: The construction activity of removing existing windows and installing new units to upgrade thermal, acoustic, or aesthetic performance.

name: Window Opening Formation
description: Structural construction activity of cutting or forming an aperture in an existing or new wall to accommodate a window unit, including lintel provision.

name: Window Sealing and Weatherproofing
description: Application of sealants, flashings, and membranes around the installed window frame to achieve a weathertight and airtight envelope junction.

name: Window Maintenance and Repainting
description: Periodic maintenance activity covering cleaning, repainting or re-staining frames, lubricating hardware, and replacing worn seals to extend window life.

name: Solar Shading / Window Canopy
description: An external shading element—hood, canopy, or overhang—positioned above the window opening to reduce solar gain and glare from the street elevation.

name: Window Blind / Shutter System
description: Internal or external roller blinds, venetian blinds, or shutters integrated with the window to control light, privacy, and solar gain.

name: Natural Ventilation System via Windows
description: A deliberate ventilation strategy that uses operable street windows as air inlets or outlets within the building's passive environmental control system.

name: Window Fire Egress Compliance
description: Design and inspection activity ensuring that designated windows meet minimum clear-opening dimensions and accessibility requirements for emergency escape.

name: Storefront Assembly
description: The full framed facade unit facing the street, integrating glazing, mullions, and structural members to form the primary street-facing opening enclosure.

name: Roll-Up Shutter
description: A retractable metal or composite barrier that secures the street opening when closed while fully retracting to leave the opening unobstructed during operating hours.

name: Folding/Bi-Fold Door System
description: A multi-panel door assembly that folds and stacks to one or both sides, allowing the entire width of the street opening to be fully open.

name: Sliding Glass Door
description: Large glazed door panels that slide horizontally to partially or fully clear the opening, commonly used in retail and hospitality street frontages.

name: Arcade / Colonnade
description: A covered pedestrian walkway formed by a series of arches or columns immediately in front of the street opening, mediating public and private realms.

name: Sill / Threshold Plate
description: The horizontal structural or finish element at the base of the street opening that defines the transition between interior floor and exterior pavement.

name: Transom Glazing
description: Fixed or operable glazed panels positioned above the main door or shutter line to introduce natural light into the interior while maintaining security below.

name: Mullion / Structural Glazing Frame
description: Vertical or horizontal structural members that subdivide the opening and carry glazing loads back to the primary building structure.

name: Security Grille
description: A fixed or retractable metal grille that provides a permeable security barrier across the street opening without fully blocking visibility.

name: Automatic Revolving Door
description: A motorised multi-wing rotating door unit set within the street opening that manages high pedestrian throughput while maintaining a continuous air seal.

name: Accessible Ramp at Threshold
description: A graded ramp element spanning any level change at the street opening to ensure wheelchair and mobility-aid access in compliance with accessibility standards.

name: Street-Level Signage Band
description: A dedicated horizontal zone above the opening frame used to mount illuminated or applied lettering, branding, and wayfinding information.

name: Intercom / Access Control Panel
description: An electronic device mounted at the street opening that manages entry authorisation via audio, video, keypad, or card-reader interfaces.

name: Glazing (Storefront Glass)
description: Tempered, laminated, or insulated glass units specified for high-traffic street-level openings, balancing transparency, thermal performance, and impact resistance.

name: Aluminium Extrusion Framing
description: Thermally broken aluminium profiles widely used as the primary framing material for street-opening assemblies due to their strength, slim sightlines, and corrosion resistance.

name: Structural Sealant / Weatherstrip
description: Elastomeric seals and weatherstripping applied at all junctions of the opening assembly to prevent air and water infiltration at the street interface.

name: Shopfront / Storefront Installation
description: The construction activity of fabricating, delivering, and fixing the complete street-opening frame, glazing, and door system to the building structure.

name: Threshold Waterproofing
description: The application of waterproof membranes and drainage details at the base of the street opening to prevent moisture ingress at the sill level.

name: Security Shutter Installation
description: The fixing and commissioning of roll-up or sliding security shutters, including motor installation, guide rails, and control wiring.

name: Glazing Replacement / Maintenance
description: The periodic inspection, re-sealing, and replacement of glass units within the street-opening frame to maintain performance and appearance.

name: Passive Solar / Daylighting Zone
description: The interior area immediately behind the street opening that benefits from direct solar gain and natural illumination, informing daylighting and energy design strategies.

name: Loading Bay Opening
description: A dedicated street-level opening sized and detailed for goods delivery vehicles, tracked separately from pedestrian entrances in the building programme.

name: Perimeter Wall
description: The enclosing vertical wall structure that defines the boundary of the gallery surround space.

name: Display Niche
description: A recessed alcove within the gallery surround wall designed to showcase artwork or objects.

name: Picture Rail
description: A horizontal rail fixed near the top of the gallery wall used for hanging artwork without damaging surfaces.

name: Cornice Moulding
description: Decorative profiled trim at the junction of the gallery surround wall and ceiling to provide a finished aesthetic edge.

name: Dado Rail
description: A horizontal moulding fixed at mid-height on the gallery wall that divides the wall surface into upper and lower zones.

name: Wainscoting Panel
description: Decorative timber or composite panelling applied to the lower section of the gallery surround wall below the dado rail.

name: Artificial Lighting Track
description: An electrified ceiling-mounted track system carrying adjustable spotlights to illuminate gallery exhibits.

name: Accent Spotlight
description: A directional luminaire mounted on the lighting track to focus light precisely on individual artworks or features.

name: Ambient Lighting System
description: The general illumination system providing even background light throughout the gallery surround space.

name: Daylight Control Blind
description: UV-filtering roller or solar blind fitted to glazed openings to regulate natural light and protect exhibits.

name: UV-Protective Glazing
description: Specialist glass or film that filters ultraviolet radiation to prevent fading and degradation of displayed artworks.

name: Climate Control (HVAC) System
description: Heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning system maintaining the stable temperature and humidity required for artwork preservation.

name: Humidity Sensor Array
description: A network of sensors monitoring relative humidity levels within the gallery surround to trigger environmental controls.

name: Intruder Detection System
description: Motion and proximity sensors embedded in the gallery surround to detect unauthorised access or exhibit interference.

name: Wall Surface Finish
description: The final decorative or functional coating (e.g., gypsum skim, paint, or acoustic plaster) applied to gallery surround walls.

name: Artwork Hanging System
description: An integrated cable, rod, or bracket system enabling flexible and damage-free repositioning of exhibited works.

name: Integrated Display Plinth
description: A built-in pedestal or base element within the gallery surround for the freestanding presentation of sculptural objects.

name: Visitor Circulation Zone
description: The designated walkway area within the gallery surround that channels visitor movement around exhibited works.

name: Electrical Services Conduit
description: Concealed conduit routed within the gallery surround walls and ceiling to distribute power to lighting and AV systems.

name: Data / AV Cabling Infrastructure
description: Structured cabling and pathways supporting audio-visual, interactive display, and building management systems in the gallery.

name: Wall Framing / Stud Partition
description: The internal structural frame (timber or metal stud) forming the gallery surround wall assembly.

name: Wall & Ceiling Plastering
description: The trade activity of applying and finishing plaster to gallery surround wall and ceiling surfaces to achieve a smooth substrate.

name: Specialist Decorating / Paint Application
description: The application of gallery-grade paint or specialist coatings to surround walls, including colour-matching and finish specification.

name: Artwork Hanging & Installation
description: The specialist activity of positioning, levelling, and securing exhibited works within the gallery surround.

name: Fire System Testing & Commissioning
description: The formal testing and sign-off of fire detection and suppression systems installed within the gallery surround.

name: IfcSpace (Gallery Zone)
description: The IFC-compliant spatial element defining the bounded gallery surround zone within the building information model.

name: IfcWall (Gallery Perimeter)
description: The IFC wall element representing the physical perimeter enclosure of the gallery surround in the BIM model.

name: IfcCovering (Wall & Ceiling Finish)
description: The IFC covering element representing applied surface finishes—paint, plaster, or cladding—on gallery surround surfaces.

name: Balcony Guardrail
description: A protective railing system installed at the open edges of the balcony to prevent falls, meeting minimum height code requirements.

name: Balcony Parapet Wall
description: A low solid wall at the perimeter of the balcony that acts as an alternative or supplement to open railings for edge protection.

name: Balcony Door / Sliding Glass Door
description: The primary access door connecting interior living space to the balcony, typically a hinged French door or sliding glass unit.

name: Balcony Soffit / Ceiling
description: The underside surface of the balcony slab visible from the floor below, which may be finished, insulated, or left exposed.

name: Balcony Structural Bracket / Cantilever Connection
description: The structural tie or bracket that anchors the cantilevered balcony slab to the main building frame, designed to transfer loads safely.

name: Thermal Break Insert
description: An insulating connector placed within the cantilever junction to interrupt thermal bridging between the interior slab and the exterior balcony.

name: Balcony Finish Flooring
description: The top surface material of the balcony floor, such as porcelain tile, composite decking, or stone pavers, chosen for durability and slip resistance.

name: Balcony Soffit Finish
description: The cladding or coating applied to the underside of the balcony slab for aesthetic finish, weather resistance, or fire rating purposes.

name: Balcony Lighting System
description: Exterior-rated light fixtures and wiring integrated into the balcony ceiling, walls, or floor for safety and ambiance.

name: Balcony Electrical Outlet
description: A weatherproof exterior electrical receptacle installed on the balcony for appliance and device use.

name: Balcony Glass Balustrade
description: A frameless or semi-frameless tempered glass panel system used as a transparent guardrail alternative on the balcony perimeter.

name: Balcony Metal Railing Post
description: Vertical steel or aluminium posts anchored to the slab edge that support balcony handrails and infill panels.

name: Juliet Balcony Variant
description: A shallow pseudo-balcony with a full-height door and guardrail but insufficient depth for occupancy, often confused with a full six-foot balcony.

name: Recessed / Inset Balcony Variant
description: A balcony configuration where the deck is set within the building envelope rather than cantilevered, providing additional shelter.

name: Wrap-Around Balcony Variant
description: A balcony that extends around two or more facades of a building, offering expanded outdoor space beyond a standard single-face six-foot depth.

name: Rooftop Terrace / Large Balcony Variant
description: An oversized elevated outdoor space that shares construction principles with a six-foot balcony but is significantly larger and may be shared.

name: Balcony Waterproofing Installation
description: The construction activity of applying, curing, and testing waterproof membranes on the balcony deck before finish flooring is installed.

name: Balcony Formwork & Concrete Pouring
description: The construction activity of erecting temporary formwork and casting the concrete balcony slab in situ to the required dimensions.

name: Balcony Tile / Decking Installation
description: The finishing trade activity of laying and grouting tile, stone, or composite deck boards on the prepared waterproofed balcony surface.

name: Balcony Structural Inspection
description: A scheduled regulatory or third-party inspection to verify the structural adequacy, anchorage, and safety of the balcony assembly.

name: Balcony Sealant & Caulking Application
description: The activity of applying weatherproof sealants at joints, thresholds, and penetrations to prevent water ingress at vulnerable balcony junctions.

name: IfcSlab (Balcony Type)
description: The IFC classification used to model the balcony deck slab as a distinct slab element with PredefinedType set to BASESLAB or tagged as balcony in BIM authoring tools.

name: IfcDoor (Balcony Access)
description: The IFC class used to represent the balcony access door or sliding glass door within the wall opening leading to the outdoor space.

name: IfcSpace (Balcony)
description: The IFC space object that defines the volumetric boundary of the balcony for area scheduling, thermal analysis, and room-data-sheet purposes.

name: Slab On Grade
description: A concrete floor slab cast directly on prepared ground, serving as both structure and finished floor.

name: Damp Proof Course
description: A horizontal barrier built into a wall or floor to prevent ground moisture from rising into the building fabric.

name: Perimeter Drain
description: A perforated pipe system installed around the base of foundations to collect and redirect groundwater.

name: Ground Bearing Slab
description: A reinforced or unreinforced slab that relies on continuous soil support beneath it to carry imposed loads.

name: Raft Foundation
description: A large continuous reinforced concrete slab spanning the entire footprint of a building to spread loads over weak soils.

name: Caisson
description: A deep, large-diameter drilled shaft filled with concrete to transfer heavy structural loads to bedrock or dense soil.

name: Earth Anchor
