description: A tensioned rod or cable grouted into the ground to resist uplift or lateral forces on a structure.

name: Ground Improvement
description: Engineering processes such as compaction, grouting, or soil stabilisation carried out to increase the load-bearing capacity of the ground.

name: Hardcore Fill
description: Broken stone, crushed concrete, or gravel compacted beneath slabs to provide a stable, well-drained sub-base.

name: Insulation Below Slab
description: Rigid thermal insulation boards placed under ground-floor slabs to reduce heat loss to the earth.

name: Earthing System
description: Electrical conductors and electrodes embedded in or connected to the ground to provide a safe fault-current path.

name: Geothermal Ground Loop
description: A network of buried pipes circulating fluid to exchange heat between the building and the stable-temperature earth mass.

name: Terrace Platform
description: A flat, usable horizontal surface created between two retaining walls or cuts on a sloped site.

name: Stepped Pathway
description: A series of steps or stairways connecting different terrace levels to allow pedestrian circulation up and down the slope.

name: Slope Stabilisation System
description: An integrated set of engineering measures—such as geotextiles, anchors, or soil nails—used to prevent slope failure and landslide on terraced hillsides.

name: Compacted Fill
description: Engineered soil or granular material placed and mechanically compacted to form stable terrace platforms behind retaining walls.

name: Rubble or Riprap Toe Protection
description: Loose stone or concrete material placed at the base of retaining walls or slopes to absorb hydraulic energy and prevent scour erosion.

name: Earthworks / Cut and Fill
description: The construction activity of excavating (cutting) and relocating (filling) soil to shape a natural slope into a series of level terraces.

name: Slope Compaction and Testing
description: The quality-assurance activity of mechanically compacting placed fill and conducting soil density tests to ensure terrace stability.

name: Vegetation / Landscaping
description: The planting of ground cover, shrubs, or trees on terrace faces and platforms to provide biological reinforcement against erosion.

name: IfcEarthworksCut
description: The IFC class representing the modelled volume of earth removed by cutting operations when forming terraced levels in a slope.

name: IfcRetainingWall
description: The IFC class used to classify and exchange retaining wall elements that hold back soil on each terrace level.

name: Embankment
description: A raised bank of compacted earth forming the sloped face between two terrace platforms, often seeded or reinforced.

name: Terrace Riser Face
description: The near-vertical exposed face of earth or masonry between consecutive terrace levels, which must be stabilised or clad to resist erosion.

name: Access Ramp
description: A graded inclined surface connecting terrace levels to allow vehicular or accessible pedestrian movement without steps.

name: Erosion Control Matting
description: Biodegradable or synthetic rolled matting laid over exposed slope faces to protect bare soil from rain splash and surface wash erosion.

name: Anchor or Ground Nail
description: A tensioned steel rod or nail grouted into the slope to provide lateral restraint to retaining walls or slope-face structures.

name: Terraced Garden / Agricultural Plot
description: A defined outdoor cultivated area occupying one or more terrace platforms, used for food production, horticulture, or amenity planting.

name: Viewing Deck / Terrace Outlook
description: A designated open platform on a terraced slope that serves as a vantage point or recreational outdoor space with views across the landscape.

name: Apple Tree
description: A deciduous fruit-bearing tree commonly planted in orchards or gardens, requiring seasonal pruning and maintenance.

name: Pear Tree
description: A fruit tree producing pears, often espaliered against walls or grown in open orchard layouts.

name: Cherry Tree
description: An ornamental and productive fruit tree yielding sweet or sour cherries, requiring netting for bird protection.

name: Plum Tree
description: A stone-fruit tree cultivated for plums, suited to temperate climates and requiring regular canopy management.

name: Peach Tree
description: A warm-climate fruit tree producing peaches, often fan-trained on sheltered south-facing walls in cooler regions.

name: Fig Tree
description: A Mediterranean fruit tree that can be grown in containers or against warm masonry walls to extend season.

name: Citrus Tree
description: A group of evergreen fruit trees (orange, lemon, lime) typically grown in pots or conservatories in temperate climates.

name: Espalier Training System
description: A framework of wires and supports fixed to walls or fences used to train fruit trees into flat, two-dimensional forms.

name: Rootstock
description: The grafted base plant that controls the ultimate size and vigour of the fruit tree variety grafted onto it.

name: Tree Guard / Stake
description: A protective post and tie assembly installed at planting to support young fruit trees against wind movement.

name: Bird Netting Structure
description: A frame-and-net enclosure erected over fruit trees to prevent bird damage to ripening fruit.

name: Pollination Planting Zone
description: A designated area where compatible pollinator varieties are co-located to ensure cross-pollination and fruit set.

name: Orchard Ground Cover
description: The managed grass, wildflower, or low-planting layer beneath fruit trees that supports biodiversity and soil health.

name: Tree Planting
description: The site activity of excavating planting pits, amending soil, positioning rootballed or bare-root trees, and backfilling.

name: Pruning and Training
description: Regular seasonal cutting and shaping of fruit tree branches to improve structure, airflow, and fruit production.

name: Fertilisation and Soil Amendment
description: The application of compost, feeds, or pH adjusters to optimise soil nutrition for fruit tree health and yield.

name: Pest and Disease Management
description: Scheduled inspection and treatment programme to control aphids, canker, scab, and other fruit-tree-specific threats.

name: Harvesting
description: The seasonal collection of mature fruit from trees, including picking, storage, and post-harvest handling activities.

name: Tree Pit
description: An excavated below-ground void designed to accommodate tree roots while supporting surface loads in urban or built environments.

name: Tree Guard / Bollard Frame
description: A protective above-ground frame or enclosure surrounding a tree trunk to shield it from vehicle and pedestrian impact.

name: Root Barrier System
description: Geotextile or rigid deflection panels installed around a tree pit to direct root growth away from adjacent structures and utilities.

name: Structural Soil / Silva Cell System
description: A modular load-bearing cell or engineered soil system beneath paving that provides structural support while enabling uncompacted root growth.

name: Tree Irrigation & Drainage System
description: Subsurface pipes, aeration tubes, and drainage layers that deliver water and air directly to the root zone of planted trees.

name: Soil Substrate & Growing Medium
description: Specially engineered or blended growing medium placed within the tree pit to support healthy root development and water retention.

name: Paving / Permeable Surface Around Tree
description: Permeable or semi-permeable hard landscaping material used in the immediately surrounding area to allow water infiltration to tree roots.

name: Tree Planting & Establishment Activity
description: The construction process of sourcing, transporting, positioning, and securing a tree within its designated pit or planter.

name: Tree Pit Excavation
description: Earthworks activity involving the digging and preparation of the below-ground void to the specified dimensions for tree installation.

name: Root Zone Backfilling & Compaction
description: Controlled placement and gentle compaction of growing medium or structural soil around tree roots following installation.

name: Tree Grate & Guard Installation
description: The fixing and levelling of surface grates and protective guards to finish and protect the tree place after planting.

name: Street Tree Space
description: A designated linear or point space along a street corridor specifically allocated for tree planting within the public realm.

name: Courtyard Tree Space
description: An open semi-enclosed space within a building courtyard or atrium designed to accommodate specimen trees as a focal amenity.

name: Rooftop / Podium Tree Space
description: An elevated outdoor space on a roof deck or podium structure engineered to support the weight and drainage requirements of large tree planting.

name: Indoor Tree / Atrium Planting Space
description: An interior void or atrium space with controlled climate conditions designed to sustain living trees within a building envelope.

name: Raised Planter / Tree Planter Box
description: A contained above-ground structure built from masonry, concrete, or Corten steel that holds growing medium and supports a tree at an elevated level.

name: Tree Species Selection
description: The design and specification activity of selecting appropriate tree species based on climate, root behaviour, canopy spread, and spatial constraints.

name: Canopy Management & Pruning
description: Ongoing maintenance activity involving the trimming and shaping of tree canopies to manage growth, safety clearances, and aesthetics.

name: Wildflower Meadow Zone
description: A designated area within the garden allowed to grow freely with native wildflowers and grasses.

name: Unmanaged Shrub Border
description: A border region where shrubs and woody plants are left to spread and layer naturally without pruning.

name: Self-Seeding Plant Bed
description: A planting bed populated by plants that reproduce and spread through natural self-seeding processes.

name: Naturalistic Pond or Bog Area
description: A water feature or saturated ground zone that supports spontaneous aquatic and marginal plant colonisation.

name: Rewilded Lawn Area
description: A former lawn section deliberately left unmowed to encourage natural grass and herb diversity.

name: Deadwood Habitat Pile
description: An intentional stack of logs, branches, and woody debris providing habitat for invertebrates and fungi.

name: Compost and Leaf Mould Bay
description: An open-sided bay structure that collects garden waste and leaf litter to decompose naturally on-site.

name: Dry-Stone or Rubble Boundary Wall
description: An unmortared stone or rubble wall forming a garden boundary that also supports mosses, ferns, and insects.

name: Informal Timber Edging
description: Low-level rustic timber boards or logs used loosely to define path edges without formal fixing.

name: Climbing Plant Support Structure
description: A trellis, pergola, or rustic pole framework that allows climbing plants to spread freely across vertical surfaces.

name: Native Hedgerow
description: A dense planting of native shrub and tree species forming a boundary or internal divider that supports wildlife.

name: Gravel or Bark Mulch Path
description: An informal permeable path surface of loose gravel or bark that allows groundcover plants to colonise the edges.

name: Rainwater Harvesting Butt
description: A simple tank or barrel that collects roof run-off to supply water to the wilder garden zones.

name: Natural Drainage Swale
description: A shallow vegetated channel that directs surface water slowly across the garden, recharging soil moisture.

name: Soil Ecosystem and Mycorrhizal Network
description: The living underground web of fungi, bacteria, and soil organisms that sustains plant health without chemical input.

name: Pollinator Corridor System
description: A planned sequence of flowering plants and habitats that provides continuous foraging routes for bees and butterflies.

name: Topsoil and Subsoil Layers
description: The stratified native soil profile retained and built upon to support spontaneous vegetation without imported growing media.

name: Organic Mulch Material
description: Shredded bark, straw, or wood chip spread across beds to suppress weeds, retain moisture, and feed the soil.

name: Native Seed Mix
description: A blend of regionally appropriate wildflower and grass seeds used to initiate or supplement natural plant cover.

name: Reclaimed Stone or Brick
description: Salvaged masonry used for paths, edging, or habitat features, reducing waste and blending with a natural aesthetic.

name: Untreated Hardwood Timber
description: Chemical-free wood used for structures, edging, and habitat features that weathers and decays naturally over time.

name: Wildflower Turf Roll
description: Pre-grown turf containing established wildflower species used to quickly establish meadow-like ground cover.

name: Initial Site Clearance and Scarification
description: Removing invasive species and scarifying the soil surface to create conditions that favour native plant establishment.

name: Native Plug Planting
description: Installing small potted native plant specimens across the site to accelerate natural colonisation and biodiversity.

name: Reduced or No-Mow Maintenance Regime
description: Adopting a schedule of infrequent or selective mowing to allow grasses and herbs to flower and set seed.

name: Deadwood and Habitat Feature Installation
description: Deliberately placing logs, stone piles, and other structures to create microhabitats for insects, amphibians, and small mammals.

name: Soil Amendment and Impoverishment
description: Removing excess nutrients or adding sand and grit to reduce fertility, which promotes diverse wildflower establishment over coarse grasses.

name: Seed Broadcasting and Overseeding
description: Hand or machine scattering of native seed mixes across prepared or existing ground to increase species diversity.

name: Invasive Species Management
description: Ongoing targeted removal of non-native or aggressive species that would otherwise outcompete desired wild plants.

name: Biodiversity and Ecological Survey
description: Periodic recording of plant, invertebrate, and animal species present to monitor and guide the evolution of the wild garden.

name: Boundary Permeability Modification
description: Installing hedgehog gaps, removing solid fencing sections, or lowering walls to allow wildlife to move freely through the site.

name: IfcSpace – Landscape Zone
description: The IFC classification used to represent defined outdoor landscape spaces such as wild garden areas in a building information model.

name: IfcFurniture – Garden Structure
description: IFC class used to model loose garden elements such as habitat piles, compost bays, and informal seating within the landscape.

name: Footing / Foundation Base
description: The below-ground concrete or masonry base that distributes the wall's load and prevents movement or settlement.

name: Wall Core Masonry Unit
description: The primary structural block (brick, stone, or concrete masonry unit) forming the main body of the garden wall.

name: Mortar Bed Joint
description: The horizontal layer of mortar between courses of masonry that bonds units together and transfers compressive loads.

name: Coping / Coping Stone
description: The protective cap unit placed on top of the wall to shed rainwater and prevent moisture ingress into the wall core.

name: Weep Hole
description: Small openings left in the lower courses of a retaining or cavity garden wall to allow trapped water to drain freely.

name: Pilaster / Pier
description: An integral thickened column of masonry built at intervals to stiffen the wall and increase its lateral stability.

name: Dry-Stone Wall
description: A traditional wall variant constructed without mortar, relying on the careful interlocking of natural stones for stability.

name: Cavity Garden Wall
description: A double-leaf wall construction with an air gap between the two skins, improving moisture resistance and thermal performance.

name: Decorative Screen Block Wall
description: A wall variant using ornamental pierced blocks to provide partial enclosure, visual interest, and ventilation.

name: Wall Gate / Gate Opening
description: A framed opening within the garden wall designed to accommodate a gate leaf, including posts, lintel, and threshold.

name: Gate Post
description: A reinforced or dedicated masonry or metal post at a wall opening that supports gate hinges and latch hardware.

name: Wall Light Fixture Housing
description: A recess or bracket point built into the wall structure to accommodate external luminaires for security or landscaping lighting.

name: Surface Render / Plaster Coat
description: A cement or lime-based finishing coat applied to the wall face for weather protection and aesthetic appearance.

name: Wall Paint / Masonry Coating
description: A breathable or waterproof coating applied over render or bare masonry to provide colour and additional weather protection.

name: Natural Stone Facing
description: A thin veneer or full-depth natural stone cladding applied to give the garden wall a premium or traditional aesthetic finish.

name: Drainage Layer / Backfill
description: Free-draining granular material placed behind a retaining garden wall to relieve hydrostatic pressure and channel water to weep holes.

name: Site Excavation & Setting Out
description: The initial activity of marking the wall alignment, excavating the trench, and preparing the ground for the footing.

name: Footing Concrete Pour
description: The construction activity of placing and curing concrete into the prepared trench to form the wall's structural foundation.

name: Masonry Laying / Bricklaying
description: The skilled trade activity of laying masonry units course by course in mortar to build the wall to the required height.

name: Mortar Mixing & Application
description: The activity of batching, mixing, and applying mortar to joints and beds during masonry wall construction.

name: DPC Installation
description: The activity of cutting and laying the damp-proof course membrane at the specified height within the wall build-up.

name: Wall Rendering & Finishing
description: The activity of applying scratch coat, render coat, and finish layers to the masonry wall faces for protection and aesthetics.

name: Trellis Framework
description: The primary load-bearing lattice or grid structure that forms the overhead and side framework of the trellised walk.

name: Upright Post
description: Vertical support columns anchored into the ground that carry the weight of the trellis overhead structure.

name: Cross Beam
description: Horizontal beams spanning between upright posts to form the top structural layer of the trellis walk.

name: Diagonal Bracing
description: Angled structural members that resist lateral forces and provide rigidity to the trellis framework.

name: Lattice Panel
description: Interwoven or criss-crossed panel sections fixed between posts to support climbing plants and provide visual screening.

name: Climbing Plant Support Wire
description: Tensioned wires or cables strung along the trellis to guide and support the growth of climbing vegetation.

name: Post Base Anchor
description: Metal fixing plate or socket set into the ground or plinth to secure upright posts and resist uplift forces.

name: Pergola Rafter
description: Longitudinal roof members running along the length of the walk, resting on cross beams to complete the overhead canopy.

name: Paved Walkway Surface
description: The hard-landscaped floor surface beneath the trellis, typically finished in stone, brick, or concrete pavers.

name: Edging Kerb
description: Linear edge restraints along the sides of the walkway surface that define the path boundary and retain paving materials.

name: Planting Bed
description: Defined soil areas at the base of trellis posts where climbing plants are established and maintained.

name: Covered Pedestrian Walkway
description: The sheltered linear passage created beneath the trellis structure intended for pedestrian circulation.

name: Wrought Iron
description: Decorative and durable ferrous metal sometimes used for ornamental trellis panels and finials in traditional designs.

name: Concrete Footing
description: In-situ concrete poured into excavated holes to provide stable foundations for upright posts.

name: Exterior Wood Preservative
description: Chemical treatment or stain applied to timber elements to protect against rot, insects, and weathering.

name: Post Excavation and Foundation Works
description: Site activity involving digging holes and placing concrete footings to anchor the trellis upright posts.

name: Trellis Framework Erection
description: The on-site assembly and installation of posts, beams, rafters, and lattice panels to form the complete trellis structure.

name: Timber Treatment and Finishing
description: Application of preservatives, stains, or paints to all timber components before and after installation to ensure longevity.

name: Paving and Surface Laying
description: Installation of the walkway floor finish including setting out, bedding, laying, and pointing of paving units.

name: Planting and Establishment
description: Horticultural activity of selecting, planting, and initially training climbing plants onto the trellis structure.

name: Routine Maintenance and Pruning
description: Ongoing upkeep including structural inspection, timber re-treatment, and pruning of climbing plants to keep the walk safe and attractive.

name: Arbour
description: A smaller, often arch-shaped garden structure clothed in climbing plants, related in form but distinct in scale and use.

name: Green Tunnel
description: A fully vegetated arched or tunnel-shaped walkway formed by trained plants, related to the trellised walk in landscape design.

name: Climbing Plant Training System
description: The integrated arrangement of wires, ties, and support elements used to direct plant growth across the trellis surface.

name: Landscape Lighting System
description: Low-voltage or solar-powered lighting fixtures integrated into or alongside the trellis to illuminate the walk at night.

name: Glazing Panels
description: Transparent or translucent panels (glass or polycarbonate) forming the roof and walls to admit maximum sunlight.

name: Foundation Slab
description: A concrete or paved base that anchors the structure and provides a stable, level floor surface.

name: Gutter & Rainwater Drainage System
description: Channels and downpipes that collect and redirect rainwater away from the structure to prevent waterlogging.

name: Irrigation & Watering System
description: Drip lines, sprinklers, or misting nozzles that deliver precise quantities of water directly to plants.

name: Shading System
description: Internal or external blinds, shade cloth, or automated screens that limit excessive solar gain and protect plants.

name: Artificial Lighting System
description: Grow-lights (LED or HPS) installed to supplement natural daylight and extend growing periods.

name: Climate Control & Automation System
description: Sensors, controllers, and actuators that automatically regulate temperature, humidity, CO₂ levels, and irrigation schedules.

name: Potting & Work Bench Area
description: A dedicated zone with benches and storage for potting, propagation, and routine horticultural tasks.

name: Plant Growing Bed / Raised Bed
description: In-ground or elevated planting beds filled with growing media to support root development of cultivated plants.

name: Hydroponic / Aquaponic System
description: A soil-free cultivation system using nutrient-rich water channels or tanks to grow plants at higher density and efficiency.

name: Potting Mix / Growing Media
description: Blended substrate (peat, perlite, coir, or compost) providing aeration, moisture retention, and nutrients for plant roots.

name: Polycarbonate Sheeting
description: Twin-wall or multi-wall plastic sheeting used as a lightweight, thermally efficient alternative to glass for cladding.

name: Lean-to Greenhouse
description: A single-slope variant built against an existing wall that shares structure and heat with the adjacent building.

name: Cold Frame / Mini Greenhouse
description: A small, low-profile enclosure used for seedling propagation and frost protection without active heating.

name: Commercial / Industrial Glasshouse
description: A large-scale production facility variant with advanced climate control, used for high-volume horticultural or agricultural output.

name: Geodesic Dome Greenhouse
description: A spherical structural variant using triangulated panels that maximises interior volume and structural efficiency.

name: Shade House
description: An open-sided mesh-covered structure variant that provides diffused light and wind protection without full enclosure.

name: Propagation House
description: A specialised sub-space with bottom heat and misting systems dedicated to germinating seeds and rooting cuttings.

name: Site Preparation & Levelling
description: Excavation and grading of the ground to create a flat, well-drained base prior to foundation construction.

name: Frame Erection
description: Assembly and installation of the structural aluminium, steel, or timber skeleton on the prepared foundation.

name: Mechanical & Plumbing Fit-Out
description: Installation of heating pipes, irrigation lines, drainage, and ventilation ducting within the completed shell.

name: Electrical & Lighting Installation
description: Running of electrical conduit, wiring grow-lights, climate sensors, and control panels to meet horticultural needs.

name: Sealing & Weatherproofing
description: Application of glazing tape, silicone sealant, and gaskets to eliminate draughts and moisture ingress at panel joints.

name: IfcSpace (Greenhouse Zone)
description: The IFC spatial element used to represent the enclosed greenhouse volume for energy analysis and space management in BIM.

name: IfcCurtainWall (Glazed Envelope)
description: The IFC class representing the lightweight glazed wall and roof assembly that forms the primary building envelope.

name: IfcMember (Frame Members)
description: IFC structural members representing individual glazing bars, purlins, and rafter elements of the greenhouse frame.

name: Seating Surface
description: The flat or contoured top surface of the garden seat on which occupants sit, typically made from timber, stone, or metal slats.

name: Seat Frame
description: The structural framework that supports the seating surface and bears the load of occupants, usually fabricated from steel, timber, or concrete.

name: Seat Legs / Supports
description: Vertical or angled members that elevate the seating surface off the ground and transfer loads to the foundation or ground.

name: Backrest
description: An optional vertical or reclined panel fixed behind the seating surface to provide lumbar support for occupants.

name: Armrests
description: Horizontal extensions at each side of the seat that provide lateral support and comfort for occupants' arms.

name: Fixing Brackets / Anchor Bolts
description: Mechanical fasteners or cast-in anchors used to secure the seat assembly to a hard-standing base or foundation pad.

name: Foundation / Base Pad
description: A concrete or paved sub-base cast or laid beneath the seat legs to spread loads and prevent settlement.

name: Timber Seat
description: A variant of garden seat constructed primarily from hardwood or softwood timber, offering a natural aesthetic in landscape settings.

name: Metal / Steel Seat
description: A variant of garden seat fabricated from mild steel, stainless steel, or cast iron, valued for durability and low maintenance in public spaces.

name: Concrete / Stone Seat
description: A monolithic or precast garden seat formed in concrete, natural stone, or reconstituted stone, providing a permanent and vandal-resistant seating solution.

name: Recycled Plastic Seat
description: A garden seat manufactured from recycled plastic lumber, offering weather resistance and sustainability credentials.

name: Integrated Planter Seat
description: A combined seating and planting unit where raised planter beds form the structural support or surround of the seat.

name: Tree-Surround Seat
description: A circular or polygonal seat that wraps around the base of a tree, utilising the tree as a central design element.

name: Protective Surface Coating / Finish
description: Paint, varnish, powder coating, or oil applied to seat components to protect against weathering, corrosion, or UV degradation.

name: Hardwood Timber (e.g. Iroko, Teak)
description: Durable, naturally weather-resistant wood species commonly specified for outdoor seating surfaces and frames.

name: Galvanised / Stainless Steel
description: Corrosion-resistant steel products used for seat frames and fixings in exposed external environments.

name: Ground Preparation & Excavation
description: Site clearance and earthworks carried out to create a level formation for the seat's foundation pad or anchor points.

name: Concrete Base / Foundation Pour
description: The casting of in-situ concrete to form the seat's structural base, including formwork, reinforcement, and curing.

name: Seat Assembly & Installation
description: The on-site assembly of prefabricated seat components and their securing to the prepared base using specified fixings.

name: Surface Treatment & Finishing
description: Application of protective coatings, stains, or oils to timber or metal elements on-site or in the factory prior to delivery.

name: Inspection & Quality Check
description: Post-installation verification that the seat is level, secure, free from defects, and compliant with relevant safety standards.

name: Periodic Maintenance & Re-finishing
description: Scheduled upkeep activities including cleaning, re-oiling or re-painting, tightening fixings, and replacing worn components.

name: Vandalism Repair & Replacement
description: Reactive works to repair or replace seat components damaged through vandalism, impact, or wilful misuse.

name: IFC Furniture Element (IfcFurniture)
description: The IFC class used to model fixed or loose seating items including garden seats within a BIM environment.

name: Landscape Paving / Hard Landscaping Zone
description: The immediate hard-surfaced area surrounding the garden seat that forms its setting and provides accessible approach routes.

name: Lighting Column / Feature Lighting
description: External lighting infrastructure positioned near garden seats to ensure safe use at night and enhance the landscape aesthetic.

name: Accessible Rest Area
description: A designated zone incorporating garden seating that meets accessibility standards, including clear turning circles and level approach paths for wheelchair users.

name: Litter / Waste Receptacle
description: A bin or receptacle co-located with the garden seat to manage litter and maintain cleanliness of the seating area.

name: Signage / Wayfinding Element
description: Interpretive or directional signs mounted on or adjacent to the seat to provide information about the landscape or direct visitors.

name: Raised Bed
description: An elevated planting structure built from timber, stone, or metal that contains growing soil and defines individual planting zones within the garden.

name: In-Ground Planting Bed
description: A directly excavated and amended soil area at grade level used for sowing and growing vegetables without raised framing.

name: Greenhouse / Cold Frame
description: A glazed or polycarbonate-covered enclosure that extends the growing season by protecting plants from frost and harsh weather.

name: Polytunnel
description: A semi-permanent tunnel-shaped structure covered in polyethylene film that provides a controlled microclimate for year-round vegetable production.

name: Compost Bin / Bay
description: A contained structure for decomposing organic kitchen and garden waste into nutrient-rich compost for soil amendment.

name: Water Butt / Rainwater Harvesting Tank
description: A storage vessel that collects and retains rainwater from roof downpipes for reuse in garden irrigation.

name: Garden Shed / Tool Store
description: A dedicated outbuilding or enclosed storage area for housing tools, seeds, pots, and garden equipment.

name: Potting Bench
description: A work surface, typically with storage below, used for potting seedlings, mixing compost, and preparing planting trays.

name: Fencing / Perimeter Enclosure
description: A boundary barrier of timber, wire, or metal that protects the vegetable garden from pests, animals, and unauthorized access.

name: Garden Path / Walkway
description: A hard or permeable surface route between beds that allows access for maintenance without compacting growing soil.

name: Edging
description: Low-profile strips or boards of metal, timber, or plastic that separate planting beds from paths and lawn areas.

name: Grow Bag / Container Planter
description: A portable growing vessel filled with compost, used for cultivating vegetables in confined or hard-surfaced areas.

name: Topsoil / Growing Medium
description: A prepared blend of loam, compost, and amendments that forms the primary root-zone substrate for plant growth.

name: Horticultural Grit / Sand
description: Coarse inorganic aggregate mixed into soil to improve drainage and aeration for root vegetables and other crops.

name: Mulch
description: Organic or inorganic surface dressing applied over soil to retain moisture, suppress weeds, and regulate soil temperature.

name: Weed-Suppressing Membrane
description: A permeable geotextile fabric laid beneath paths or between beds to inhibit weed growth while allowing water infiltration.

name: Timber Sleeper / Raised-Bed Board
description: Sawn or reclaimed timber planks or sleepers used to construct the frame walls of raised planting beds.

name: Trellis / Plant Support Structure
description: A framework of timber, bamboo, or metal wire used to support climbing and vining vegetable crops such as beans and tomatoes.

name: Cloche
description: A small portable glass or plastic cover placed over individual plants or rows to provide frost protection and encourage early growth.

name: Irrigation Controller / Timer
description: An automated device that schedules and regulates irrigation cycles to optimise water use and reduce manual watering effort.

name: Soil Preparation & Amendment
description: The activity of digging, aerating, and incorporating compost or fertilisers into existing ground to create a suitable planting medium.

name: Raised Bed Construction
description: The construction activity of assembling and securing timber, metal, or stone frames and filling them with growing medium.

name: Fencing & Enclosure Erection
description: The construction activity of setting posts and fixing panels or wire to create a secure perimeter around the garden area.

name: Path & Hard-Landscaping Laying
description: The activity of excavating, compacting sub-base material, and laying paving, gravel, or bark chips to form garden walkways.

name: Greenhouse / Cold Frame Erection
description: The assembly and installation activity for glazed or polycarbonate growing structures, including foundation base preparation.

name: Composting Operation
description: The ongoing management activity of layering, turning, and monitoring organic waste in compost bays to produce usable soil amendment.

name: Crop Rotation Planning
description: The seasonal planning activity of rotating plant families across beds to maintain soil health and reduce pest and disease build-up.

name: Pest & Wildlife Control System
description: A combination of netting, traps, barriers, and deterrents designed to protect crops from insects, rodents, and larger animals.

name: IFC Annotation – IfcZone
description: The IFC class used to group and designate the vegetable garden as a named functional zone within a building information model.

name: Compost Bin
description: A contained vessel or enclosure used to hold organic waste material undergoing decomposition.

name: Compost Tumbler
description: A rotating drum-style compost container that accelerates decomposition through regular tumbling and aeration.

name: Compost Bay
description: A dedicated open or enclosed bay structure within a building or site for large-scale composting operations.

name: Compost Storage Area
description: A designated zone for storing finished or curing compost before use or distribution.

name: Worm Farm (Vermicomposting Unit)
description: A specialized composting system using worms to break down organic material into nutrient-rich castings.

name: Aeration System
description: A network of pipes or turning mechanisms that supply oxygen to the composting mass to support aerobic decomposition.

name: Leachate Collection System
description: A drainage system that captures liquid run-off (leachate) produced during the composting process for safe disposal or reuse.

name: Odour Control System
description: A ventilation or biofilter system installed to manage and reduce odours emitted from composting operations.

name: Organic Waste Input Point
description: A designated drop-off or intake point where organic waste materials are deposited to begin the composting cycle.

name: Compost Screening Unit
description: A mesh or mechanical sieve device used to separate finished compost from undecomposed materials.

name: Moisture Management System
description: A system incorporating irrigation or drainage controls to maintain optimal moisture levels within the composting material.

name: Compost Turning Activity
description: The regular manual or mechanical turning of compost piles to introduce oxygen and promote even decomposition.

name: Site Preparation for Compost Area
description: Construction activity involving grading, paving, or lining the ground surface to prepare a dedicated composting area.

name: Compost Bay Wall Construction
description: The building of retaining walls or partition structures that define and contain individual composting bays.

name: Biofilter Installation
description: The construction and fitting of a biofilter unit to treat air extracted from enclosed composting spaces.

name: Green Waste
description: Plant-based organic material such as grass clippings, leaves, and garden trimmings used as feedstock in composting.

name: Food Waste
description: Organic kitchen scraps and food by-products that serve as nitrogen-rich inputs to the composting process.

name: Bulking Agent (Brown Material)
description: Carbon-rich materials such as straw, wood chips, or cardboard added to balance nitrogen content and improve compost structure.

name: Finished Compost (Humus)
description: The stable, dark, soil-like end product of the decomposition process ready for use as a soil amendment.

name: Compost Liner
description: An impermeable membrane or concrete base used to prevent leachate from contaminating surrounding soil and groundwater.

name: Waste Transfer Station (Organic)
description: A nearby facility or area where organic waste is sorted and transferred before being directed to the composting zone.

name: Composting Enclosure / Shed
description: A roofed or walled structure that houses composting operations to protect the process from weather and minimise odour escape.

name: IfcWasteTerminal
description: IFC entity class (schema IFC4). Supertype: IfcFlowTerminal.

name: Recessed Shelf
description: A fixed shelf built into the wall recess of an alcove to provide storage or display space.

name: Alcove Seating
description: Built-in bench or seating unit fitted within an alcove, often with storage beneath.

name: Alcove Wardrobe
description: A fitted wardrobe unit installed inside an alcove, maximising use of recessed wall space.

name: Alcove Bookcase
description: A bespoke or fitted bookcase designed to fill an alcove opening from floor to ceiling.

name: Alcove Cabinet
description: A closed storage cabinet unit custom-built to occupy the full depth and width of an alcove.

name: Alcove Desk
description: A work surface or desk unit integrated into an alcove to form a compact home-office nook.

name: Alcove Lighting
description: Dedicated electrical lighting system—often LED strips, spotlights, or picture lights—installed within or around an alcove to illuminate its contents.

name: Alcove Electrical Outlets
description: Power sockets and USB points fitted inside an alcove to support lighting, devices, or appliances housed there.

name: Alcove Framing
description: The structural or decorative timber, metal, or drywall frame that defines and finishes the edges of an alcove opening.

name: Alcove Plasterwork
description: Plaster or render finish applied to the internal walls and ceiling of an alcove to create a smooth or decorative surface.

name: Alcove Tiling
description: Ceramic, stone, or mosaic tiles used to line the interior surfaces of an alcove, common in bathrooms and kitchens.

name: Alcove Trim & Moulding
description: Decorative architrave, cornicing, or beading applied around the perimeter of an alcove to integrate it with surrounding interior finishes.

name: Alcove Curtain or Blind
description: A curtain track, roller blind, or drape used to conceal the contents of an alcove when not in use.

name: Bed Nook
description: A sleeping alcove sized to accommodate a bed, providing a semi-enclosed, cosy sleeping area within a larger room.

name: Inglenook
description: A traditional fireplace alcove or chimney recess flanked by seats, creating an intimate fireside seating area.

name: Prayer Niche (Mihrab)
description: A recessed niche in a wall indicating the direction of prayer, a specialised alcove type found in Islamic architecture.

name: Coat & Bag Nook
description: A small entrance-hall alcove fitted with hooks and a bench for storing outerwear and bags.

name: Wet Niche (Shower Niche)
description: A waterproofed recessed shelf built into a shower or bath surround wall for storing toiletries.

name: Wall Recess Formation
description: The construction activity of cutting back or forming a recess in an existing or new wall to create an alcove void.

name: Alcove Fit-Out & Joinery
description: The carpentry and joinery activity of measuring, building, and installing bespoke units—shelves, cabinets, or seating—within an alcove.

name: Alcove Waterproofing
description: Application of tanking, membranes, or sealants to the internal surfaces of an alcove located in wet areas such as bathrooms or kitchens.

name: Alcove Painting & Decorating
description: The finishing activity of applying paint, wallpaper, or specialist coatings to the interior surfaces of an alcove, often in a contrasting colour or texture.

name: Alcove Structural Reinforcement
description: Engineering and construction work to install lintels, supports, or reinforcement required when forming an alcove in a load-bearing wall.

name: IfcWallElementedCase
description: IFC entity class (schema IFC4). Supertype: IfcWall.

name: Window Seat
description: A built-in bench or platform integrated into the window place, providing seating and often storage directly at the window.

name: Window Jamb Lining
description: The finished interior lining applied to the side walls of the window reveal to create a smooth, habitable enclosure.

name: Window Head Soffit
description: The finished underside of the wall above the window opening, forming the ceiling of the window place recess.

name: Seat Cushion
description: A removable padded cushion placed on the window seat to provide comfort for occupants using the window place.

name: Storage Drawer Unit
description: Built-in drawers housed beneath the window seat, utilizing the volume of the window place for concealed storage.

name: Bookshelf / Side Shelf
description: Built-in shelving integrated into the side jambs of the window place to hold books or objects within easy reach.

name: Window Glazing System
description: The complete assembly of glass panes, frames, and seals forming the transparent barrier of the window place.

name: Operable Sash / Casement
description: The movable portion of the window assembly within the window place that allows for ventilation control.

name: Interior Shading System
description: Curtains, blinds, shutters, or roller shades installed within or adjacent to the window place to control light and privacy.

name: Solar Control / Glazing Film
description: A specialist film or coating applied to the glazing to reduce solar heat gain and glare within the window place.

name: Thermal Insulation Lining
description: Insulation material installed within the reveal or seat structure of the window place to prevent cold bridging and condensation.

name: Timber Seat Framing
description: Structural timber framework used to construct the seat platform and base enclosure of the window place.

name: Bay Window Space
description: A projecting window place variant that extends beyond the main wall plane, creating a larger alcove with a multi-faceted window surround.

name: Oriel Window Space
description: An upper-floor projecting window place variant that is cantilevered or corbelled out from the facade rather than rising from the ground.

name: Inglenook-style Alcove
description: A deeply recessed window place variant that provides a semi-enclosed nook for intimate seating separated from the main room.

name: Dormer Window Place
description: A window place formed within a dormer projection in a sloped roof, creating a cosy recess at attic or roof level.

name: Lintel / Header Installation
description: The activity of installing a structural lintel or header above the window opening to carry loads over the window place recess.

name: Joinery & Millwork Installation
description: The finishing activity of fitting bespoke or prefabricated timber seat, shelving, and lining elements within the window place.

name: Glazing Unit Installation
description: The activity of setting and sealing the window glazing assembly into the frame within the window place opening.

name: Insulation & Draught-Proofing Works
description: The activity of applying insulation, vapour barriers, and draught seals around the window place structure to meet thermal performance requirements.

name: Decorating & Surface Finishing
description: The activity of applying paint, stain, wallpaper, or tile finishes to the reveal, sill, and seat surfaces of the window place.

name: IFC Window Element (IfcWindow)
description: The IFC schema class used to model the window assembly hosted within the window place opening in a building information model.

name: Daylighting Performance Zone
description: The analysed zone immediately inside the window place where daylight levels, glare indices, and solar access are modelled and optimised.

name: Radiator / Underfloor Heating Unit
description: A heating element positioned beneath or in front of the window place seat to counteract cold downdraught from the glazing.

name: Integrated Lighting System
description: Recessed or surface-mounted lighting installed within the window place reveal or head to provide task or accent illumination.

name: Fire Escape Route
description: A designated path or corridor providing safe egress for occupants during a fire emergency.

name: Fire Exit
description: A door or opening specifically designated and marked for emergency evacuation during a fire.

name: Fire Detection System
description: A system of sensors and alarms designed to detect the presence of fire, smoke, or heat and alert occupants.

name: Fire Alarm Panel
description: The central control unit that receives signals from fire detection devices and manages alarm outputs and notifications.

name: Fire Extinguisher
description: A portable device containing an extinguishing agent for manual suppression of small fires.

name: Fire Hydrant
description: A water supply connection point on the building exterior or interior enabling firefighters to access pressurised water.

name: Hose Reel Cabinet
description: A fixed installation housing a hose reel and nozzle for first-response manual firefighting within the building.

name: Standpipe System
description: A series of piping and outlets installed within a building to distribute water for firefighting on multiple floors.

name: Smoke Vent
description: An opening or automated panel in the roof or wall that releases smoke and hot gases to the outside during a fire.

name: Fire-Resistant Cladding
description: An external or internal facade material with tested fire-resistance properties to slow the spread of flame across surfaces.

name: Passive Fire Protection (PFP) System
description: Building elements and materials that contain or slow fire spread without requiring activation, such as fire walls and compartmentation.

name: Fire Stopping
description: Sealing material or assemblies used to close off openings and joints in fire-rated barriers penetrated by services or structure.

name: Emergency Lighting
description: Battery-backed or independent lighting that activates automatically to illuminate escape routes during a fire or power failure.

name: Fire Safety Signage
description: Standardised signs indicating exit routes, fire equipment locations, and assembly points for occupant guidance during a fire.

name: Assembly Point
description: A designated safe outdoor area where building occupants gather after evacuating during a fire emergency.

name: Fire Risk Assessment
description: A systematic evaluation process to identify fire hazards, assess risk levels, and determine protective measures for a building.

name: Fire Drill
description: A planned rehearsal exercise to practise and evaluate the evacuation procedure of building occupants in case of a real fire.

name: Fire Safety Inspection
description: A formal inspection by authorities or competent persons to verify that fire safety measures comply with applicable codes and standards.

name: Fire Protection Installation
description: The construction and commissioning activity of fitting fire suppression, detection, and protection systems within a building.

name: Fire Compartmentation Survey
description: An inspection activity to verify the integrity and completeness of all fire compartment boundaries and fire-stopping installations.

name: Evacuation Plan
description: The development and documentation of procedures defining how occupants should safely exit a building in the event of a fire.

name: Seating Arrangement
description: Configuration of chairs, booths, banquettes, and tables that shapes social interaction and spatial flow within the dining area.

name: Decorative Finishes
description: Wall coverings, flooring materials, and surface treatments selected to reinforce the aesthetic character and theme of the space.

name: Ventilation & Odour Control System
description: HVAC and air-purification equipment that manages temperature, humidity, and cooking odours to maintain a pleasant atmosphere.

name: Background Music System
description: Distributed audio infrastructure delivering curated soundscapes that complement the desired mood of the dining environment.

name: Colour Scheme & Branding Elements
description: Palette of paints, graphics, and branded fixtures applied to surfaces to create a cohesive visual identity for the space.

name: Bar or Beverage Counter
description: Dedicated zone for drink preparation and service that contributes to the social and sensory character of the overall eating environment.

name: Waiting / Reception Area
description: Entry zone where guests are greeted and queued, setting the first impression of the dining atmosphere.

name: Private Dining Room
description: Enclosed or semi-enclosed space offering an intimate dining experience separated from the main dining floor.

name: Outdoor / Alfresco Dining Zone
description: External or semi-external seating area extending the dining atmosphere to an open-air environment.

name: Feature Ceiling Design
description: Decorative or architectural ceiling treatment—such as exposed beams, coffering, or suspended elements—that anchors the spatial character above diners.

name: Natural Lighting & Glazing
description: Windows, skylights, and glazed partitions that introduce daylight and views to enhance the sensory quality of the space.

name: Greenery & Biophilic Elements
description: Indoor plants, living walls, or water features integrated into the interior to evoke a natural, calming dining atmosphere.

name: Table Setting & Tableware
description: Coordinated arrangement of crockery, cutlery, glassware, and linen that directly influences the perceived quality and tone of the dining experience.

name: Wayfinding & Signage
description: Directional signs, menus boards, and numbering systems that guide guests through the space while reinforcing its visual identity.

name: Interior Fit-Out Works
description: Construction and installation activities covering partitions, flooring, ceilings, and joinery to realise the designed atmospheric intent.

name: Lighting Design & Commissioning
description: Professional design, installation, and tuning of the lighting system to achieve target lux levels and mood settings.

name: Furniture Procurement & Installation
description: Sourcing, delivery, and placement of all dining furniture to match the spatial layout and atmospheric brief.

name: Mechanical & Electrical Services Installation
description: Trade works encompassing HVAC, electrical, and plumbing rough-in and fit-off required to support atmosphere-critical systems.

name: Quiet Focus Room
description: A small, soundproofed enclosure intended for individual deep-work or confidential calls.

name: Partition / Demountable Wall System
description: A relocatable non-structural wall system used to subdivide open workspace into smaller enclosures without permanent construction.

name: Building Automation & Controls (BAS)
description: An integrated network of sensors and controllers that monitors and regulates lighting, HVAC, and occupancy within the workspace.

name: Fire Suppression & Detection System
description: Sprinkler heads, smoke detectors, and alarm panels installed throughout the workspace to ensure life-safety compliance.

name: Data & Power Distribution System
description: Structured cabling, floor boxes, and electrical panels that deliver IT connectivity and electrical power to workstations.

name: Operable Wall / Movable Partition
description: A manually or motor-driven folding or sliding panel system that allows flexible reconfiguration of workspace areas.

name: Suspended Ceiling Grid
description: A metal T-bar framework hung from the structural slab to support ceiling tiles, lighting, and services within the workspace.

name: Workstation / Systems Furniture
description: Modular desk, panel, and storage units that define individual work positions and can be reconfigured as needs change.

name: Storage Locker Unit
description: A freestanding or built-in secure cabinet used for personal or shared storage of documents and equipment in the workspace.

name: Internal Door & Frame Assembly
description: A hinged or sliding door leaf, frame, and hardware set providing access control and acoustic separation between workspace zones.

name: Vision Panel / Sidelight
description: A narrow glazed unit mounted adjacent to or within a door or wall to provide visibility without full transparency.

name: Raised Floor Panel & Pedestal
description: Individual modular floor tiles and support pedestals that form the surface of a raised access floor system.

name: Perimeter Skirting & Cable Trunking
description: Surface-mounted ducts fixed at floor or wall level to route and conceal power and data cables around the workspace perimeter.

name: Gypsum Board (Drywall)
description: A panel of gypsum plaster faced with paper, used as the primary lining board for internal partition and ceiling construction.

name: Mineral Fibre Insulation
description: Glass or rock wool batts installed within partition cavities and ceiling voids to provide thermal and acoustic performance.

name: Interior Paint / Wall Coating
description: Decorative and protective surface coatings applied to partition and ceiling surfaces to achieve desired aesthetics and hygiene standards.

name: Acoustic Panel / Wall Fabric
description: Fabric-wrapped or foam-backed wall panels that absorb mid- and high-frequency sound energy within the workspace.

name: Structural Steel Stud Framing
description: Light-gauge cold-formed steel profiles used as the skeleton framework for non-load-bearing internal partition walls.

name: MEP Second Fix & Commissioning
description: The final connection, fitting, and functional testing of all mechanical, electrical, and data services within the completed workspace enclosure.

name: Furniture Installation & Churn
description: The physical placement, assembly, and periodic reconfiguration of workstation furniture and storage units as organisational needs evolve.

name: Workplace Condition Survey
description: A scheduled inspection activity that assesses the physical condition, compliance, and occupancy suitability of workspace enclosures over time.

name: IfcWall / IfcWallStandardCase
description: IFC classes representing vertical planar building elements, covering both permanent and demountable internal partition walls bounding the workspace.

name: IfcSystem (IfcDistributionSystem)
description: IFC classes grouping MEP distribution components—HVAC, electrical, data—serving the workspace into logical, queryable systems.

name: Work Triangle
description: The spatial relationship between the refrigerator, sink, and cooktop that defines efficient movement paths in a kitchen layout.

name: Galley Kitchen
description: A narrow, two-wall linear kitchen layout optimized for single-cook efficiency in constrained floor plans.

name: L-Shaped Kitchen
description: A kitchen layout using two adjacent perpendicular walls to create an open corner working zone.

name: U-Shaped Kitchen
description: A three-wall kitchen layout that maximizes counter and storage space by wrapping cabinetry around three sides.

name: Single-Wall Kitchen
description: A compact kitchen layout where all appliances and cabinets are aligned along one wall, typically used in studio apartments.

name: Peninsula Kitchen
description: A kitchen layout that extends a connected counter arm from a wall or cabinet run to create an open-sided island-like workspace.

name: Base Cabinets
description: Floor-level cabinet units that support countertops and provide primary storage within a cooking layout.

name: Wall Cabinets
description: Upper cabinets mounted on the wall above countertops to maximize vertical storage in a kitchen space.

name: Tall/Pantry Cabinets
description: Full-height cabinet units used to store dry goods, appliances, or integrated tall appliances like ovens and refrigerators.

name: Countertop
description: The horizontal work surface installed on top of base cabinets, used for food preparation and small appliance placement.

name: Kitchen Backsplash
description: A wall surface treatment behind countertops and cooking areas that protects walls from splashes and defines the aesthetic zone.

name: Cooktop / Hob
description: The cooking surface unit—gas, electric, or induction—embedded in or placed on the countertop as a primary heat source.

name: Range / Oven Unit
description: A combined or standalone appliance providing both a cooktop and oven cavity, forming a central cooking station.

name: Range Hood / Extraction System
description: A ventilation system mounted above the cooktop to capture and exhaust or filter cooking fumes, heat, and moisture.

name: Kitchen Sink
description: The primary basin fixture in the kitchen used for food washing, prep, and dishwashing, typically integrated into the countertop.

name: Refrigerator Alcove
description: A dedicated recessed or defined zone within the kitchen layout sized to house the refrigerator and integrate it flush with cabinetry.

name: Dishwasher Bay
description: A built-in cavity within base cabinet runs designated to house and plumb a dishwasher, typically adjacent to the sink.

name: Kitchen Flooring
description: Durable, easy-to-clean floor finish material selected specifically for the high-traffic and moisture-prone kitchen zone.

name: Plumbing Rough-In for Kitchen
description: The construction activity of installing supply, waste, and vent pipes within walls and floors prior to cabinet and fixture installation.

name: Electrical Rough-In for Kitchen
description: The activity of running dedicated circuits, outlet positions, and appliance wiring within the kitchen zone before finishing works begin.

name: Kitchen Appliance Installation
description: The commissioning activity of positioning, connecting, and testing all built-in and freestanding kitchen appliances.

name: Ventilation Duct Routing
description: The construction activity of designing and installing ductwork that connects the range hood to an external exhaust point or recirculation system.

name: Granite / Stone Countertop
description: A natural or engineered stone slab material commonly specified for kitchen countertops due to its durability and heat resistance.

name: Stainless Steel Finish
description: A corrosion-resistant metal surface material frequently used on appliances, sinks, and commercial-style kitchen components.

name: IfcSpace (Kitchen)
description: The IFC entity used to model the bounded kitchen room or zone within a building information model.

name: IfcFurniture (Kitchen Units)
description: The IFC entity class representing fitted kitchen furniture elements such as base and wall cabinet units in a BIM model.

name: IfcFlowTerminal (Kitchen Sink)
description: The IFC classification for end-point plumbing fixtures such as the kitchen sink within a flow system model.

name: Central Feature Element
description: A focal point object such as a sculpture, planter, fire pit, or water feature placed at the center of the sitting circle.

name: Ground Surface Paving
description: The finished floor or ground treatment within and around the sitting circle, such as stone pavers, timber decking, or compacted gravel.

name: Armrest
description: A horizontal support element fixed at the sides of seating units within the circle for occupant comfort and division of seating positions.

name: Seating Foundation / Base
description: The structural footing or base element that anchors bench units or seating walls to the ground.

name: Retaining Edge / Border Curb
description: A low edge treatment such as a kerb, timber edging, or stone border that defines the perimeter of the sitting circle.

name: Electrical / Low-Voltage System
description: Conduit, cabling, and connection points serving lighting, audio, or power outlets within the sitting circle.

name: Planted Surround / Landscape Buffer
description: A planted zone of shrubs, grasses, or trees immediately encircling the sitting area to provide privacy and visual enclosure.

name: Accessible Pathway Approach
description: A designated accessible entry route connecting the sitting circle to the wider pedestrian network in compliance with accessibility standards.

name: Fire Pit Zone
description: A dedicated sub-zone at the center or edge of the sitting circle designed to safely accommodate an open fire or gas fire pit.

name: Natural Stone
description: Granite, sandstone, or bluestone used for paving, seat capping, or decorative edging in the sitting circle.

name: Compacted Gravel / Decomposed Granite
description: Loose-bound surface material used as a permeable ground treatment within or around the sitting circle.

name: Formwork and Concrete Pouring
description: Construction activity involving the setting of formwork and casting of concrete for benches, bases, or paved surfaces.

name: Bench / Seating Unit Installation
description: The fixing and anchoring of prefabricated or custom-fabricated seating elements into their final positions within the circle.

name: Electrical Rough-in and Fixture Installation
description: The installation of conduit, cable pulls, and connection of lighting or power fixtures serving the sitting circle.

name: IFC Furnishing Element
description: An IfcFurnishingElement instance representing fixed seating, central feature objects, or other furniture-class components within the sitting circle.

name: Dormitory Room
description: A shared sleeping room containing multiple beds assigned to several occupants simultaneously.

name: Bunk Bed
description: A tiered bed frame allowing two or more sleeping berths to occupy the vertical footprint of a single bed.

name: Single Bed Frame
description: An individual bed support structure used within shared sleeping areas where bunking is not required.

name: Sleeping Pod
description: A semi-enclosed individual sleeping capsule within a larger communal space, offering minimal privacy.

name: Under-Bed Storage Drawer
description: A sliding drawer integrated beneath a bed frame to provide occupant storage without consuming extra floor area.

name: Privacy Curtain
description: A fabric partition hung around individual beds to provide a degree of visual separation between occupants.

name: Bed Partition Screen
description: A solid or semi-solid panel placed between beds to create acoustic and visual separation in open dormitory layouts.

name: Mattress
description: A padded sleeping surface placed on a bed frame, typically standardised in communal settings for ease of replacement.

name: Pillow and Bedding Set
description: Soft furnishing items including pillows, sheets, and blankets provided to each occupant for sleeping comfort.

name: Reading Light Fixture
description: A dedicated low-level luminaire mounted at each bunk or bed position to allow individual lighting without disturbing others.

name: USB/Power Outlet at Bunk
description: An electrical outlet integrated near each sleeping berth to allow occupants to charge personal devices.

name: Ventilation Diffuser
description: An air-distribution grille supplying fresh conditioned air to occupants within the sleeping area.

name: Wall Cladding / Paint
description: Interior surface finish applied to walls for hygiene, maintenance ease, and appropriate aesthetic in shared sleeping spaces.

name: Shared Bathroom / Sanitary Facility
description: An adjacent or nearby toilet, shower, and washbasin area serving the occupants of the communal sleeping space.

name: Changing Room / Dressing Area
description: A dedicated space adjacent to sleeping quarters where occupants can dress and store clothing privately.

name: Common Corridor
description: A shared circulation passage providing access between sleeping areas and other parts of the building.

name: Night Manager / Reception Area
description: A staffed or supervised station near sleeping quarters for security, check-in, and occupant assistance.

name: Bed Installation
description: The construction or assembly activity of installing bed frames, bunk structures, and sleeping pods within the space.

name: Partition and Screen Installation
description: The trade activity of erecting privacy screens, curtain rails, and bed partition systems within the sleeping area.

name: Electrical Rough-In for Bunk Outlets
description: The electrical installation activity of running conduit and wiring to each bunk position prior to fit-out.

name: Fire and Safety System Commissioning
description: The testing and certification activity ensuring all fire detection, suppression, and emergency systems in the sleeping space are fully operational.

name: Painting and Decorating
description: The surface finishing activity involving application of paint or cladding to walls and ceilings of the sleeping space.

name: Deep Cleaning and Sanitisation
description: A scheduled maintenance activity to thoroughly clean and disinfect all surfaces, mattresses, and fixtures in communal sleeping areas.

name: IfcSpace (Dormitory)
description: The IFC schema class representing the defined spatial boundary and metadata of a communal sleeping room or zone.

name: IfcFurniture (Bed)
description: The IFC schema class used to model individual bed units and bunk assemblies within the building information model.

name: Bed Frame
description: The structural base and surround that supports the mattress and defines the physical boundaries of the marriage bed.

name: Headboard
description: A decorative and functional vertical panel fixed at the head of the bed, often ornately crafted for ceremonial or aesthetic significance.

name: Footboard
description: A vertical panel at the foot of the bed that completes the frame enclosure and adds structural and decorative value.

name: Bed Canopy
description: An overhead fabric or structural covering suspended above the bed, historically used in marriage beds for privacy and symbolic grandeur.

name: Canopy Frame / Four-Poster Posts
description: Vertical posts and horizontal rails that form the structural skeleton supporting the canopy or draping fabric over the bed.

name: Bed Curtains / Drapes
description: Fabric panels hung from the canopy frame to enclose the sleeping area, providing privacy, warmth, and ceremonial decoration.

name: Base / Box Spring
description: A supportive sub-layer placed between the bed frame and mattress to absorb load and improve sleeping comfort.

name: Bed Slats
description: Horizontal timber or metal supports spanning the bed frame to carry the mattress and distribute weight evenly.

name: Bed Linen Set
description: The collection of sheets, pillowcases, and covers that dress the marriage bed, often made of premium fabrics such as linen, silk, or embroidered cotton.

name: Bridal Embroidery / Decorative Textile
description: Ornamental fabric featuring symbolic motifs, monograms, or traditional patterns woven or embroidered specifically for a marriage bed.

name: Timber / Hardwood
description: Solid wood such as oak, walnut, or cherry used in crafting the bed frame, posts, and carved decorative elements.

name: Metal Hardware & Fixings
description: Bolts, brackets, and ornamental metal fittings used to assemble and embellish the bed frame structure.

name: Upholstery Fabric
description: Padded and covered fabric applied to the headboard, footboard, or frame panels for comfort and decorative finish.

name: Alcove / Bed Recess
description: A recessed niche or enclosed spatial zone within a room specifically designed to house and frame the marriage bed.

name: Bridal Chamber
description: The dedicated private room or suite containing the marriage bed, traditionally prepared and furnished for the newlywed couple.

name: Dressing Area
description: An adjacent or integrated space near the marriage bed used for personal preparation, grooming, and clothing storage.

name: Ceremonial Space / Blessing Zone
description: The spatial area immediately surrounding the marriage bed designated for ritual, blessing, or celebratory activity during wedding traditions.

name: Bed Installation & Assembly
description: The on-site construction and fitting activity of assembling the bed frame, posts, canopy, and all structural components in the designated space.

name: Room Preparation & Dressing
description: The act of decorating and furnishing the bridal chamber, including placing linens, flowers, and ornamental items on and around the marriage bed.

name: Joinery & Carpentry Work
description: Skilled woodworking activities involved in crafting, carving, and finishing the timber components of the bed frame and surrounds.

name: Upholstery Work
description: The craft activity of padding, covering, and finishing fabric surfaces on the headboard, footboard, and other upholstered bed elements.

name: Textile & Soft Furnishing Installation
description: The hanging and fitting of curtains, canopy drapes, and decorative textiles onto the bed frame and surrounding fixtures.

name: Bed Space Fit-Out
description: The broader construction and interior finishing activity of preparing the room zone, including lighting, flooring, and wall treatments, to receive the marriage bed.

name: Alcove Niche Wall
description: The three surrounding walls that define and enclose the bed alcove recess within a room.

name: Alcove Opening
description: The open face or entrance of the alcove that connects it to the main room space.

name: Alcove Soffit
description: The overhead ceiling surface within the alcove recess, which may be lowered relative to the main room ceiling.

name: Built-in Bed Platform
description: A fixed raised platform constructed within the alcove to support the mattress, eliminating the need for a freestanding bed frame.

name: Alcove Curtain Track
description: A ceiling-mounted or wall-mounted track system that allows curtains or drapes to be drawn across the alcove opening for privacy.

name: Alcove Privacy Curtain
description: A fabric curtain hung across the alcove opening to provide visual separation and privacy from the main living area.

name: Alcove Sliding Door
description: A sliding panel or door system used to close off the bed alcove from the adjacent room when required.

name: Alcove Shelving Unit
description: Fixed shelves built into the alcove walls at the head or sides of the bed for books, lighting, and personal items.

name: Recessed Bed Lighting
description: Integrated lighting fixtures recessed into the soffit or side walls of the alcove to provide ambient or task illumination without protruding fixtures.

name: Reading Light Sconce
description: Wall-mounted directional light fixtures positioned at either side of the bed within the alcove for focused reading light.

name: Alcove Electrical Outlet
description: Electrical outlets and USB charging points installed within the alcove walls to power devices used at the bedside.

name: Ventilation Grille
description: A grille or vent integrated into the alcove to ensure adequate air circulation in the enclosed sleeping recess.

name: Acoustic Insulation Panel
description: Sound-absorbing material applied to the alcove walls or ceiling to reduce noise transmission and improve sleep quality.

name: Alcove Structural Lintel
description: A structural beam or lintel spanning the top of the alcove opening to support the wall or partition above it.

name: Murphy Bed Alcove Variant
description: A fold-down wall-bed variant where the mattress and frame fold flush into the alcove when not in use, converting the space for daytime activities.

name: Loft Bed Alcove Variant
description: An elevated alcove variant positioned at mezzanine or loft height, accessed by a ladder or compact stair, freeing floor space below.

name: Sleeping Nook
description: A smaller, more informal recess or nook designed for sleeping, typically without a full structural enclosure, closely related to but distinct from a full bed alcove.

name: Box Bed Enclosure
description: A fully enclosed traditional bed alcove variant, historically common in Nordic and Scottish vernacular architecture, featuring doors or panels on all sides.

name: Children's Cabin Bed Alcove
description: A bed alcove scaled and themed for children, often incorporating play elements, guardrails, and integrated storage ladders.

name: Studio Apartment Sleeping Zone
description: A defined sleeping area within an open-plan studio unit, often delineated by a partial wall or stepped floor level forming a de facto alcove.

name: Partition Wall System
description: The lightweight or structural wall partition system used to form the three sides of the bed alcove within a larger room.

name: Built-in Furniture System
description: An integrated system of custom joinery elements—shelves, drawers, and headboards—designed to fit precisely within the alcove dimensions.

name: Low-Voltage Lighting System
description: A dedicated low-voltage or LED lighting circuit serving the alcove's recessed and task lighting fixtures with dimming control.

name: Alcove Framing Timber
description: Structural timber stud framing used to construct the partition walls and platform base of the bed alcove.

name: Plasterboard Lining
description: Gypsum plasterboard applied to the interior framing of the alcove to create smooth, paintable wall and ceiling surfaces.

name: Upholstered Wall Panel
description: Fabric-wrapped padded panels fixed to the alcove walls to add comfort, acoustics, and a finished decorative appearance.

name: Concrete Micro-topping
description: A thin polished concrete finish applied to the bed platform surface for an industrial or minimalist design aesthetic.

name: Alcove Partition Construction
description: The construction activity of framing, boarding, and finishing the walls that form the bed alcove recess.

name: Bed Platform Carpentry
description: The carpentry work involved in building the structural raised platform base within the alcove to support the mattress.

name: Built-in Joinery Installation
description: The installation of custom-fitted shelving, drawers, and headboard units within the alcove space.

name: Alcove Electrical Rough-in
description: The first-fix electrical work of running conduit and cables within alcove walls before linings are applied.

name: Alcove Lighting Installation
description: The second-fix activity of fitting and commissioning recessed lights, sconces, and dimmer controls within the alcove.

name: Plastering and Skimming
description: The finishing activity of applying plaster skim coats to alcove wall and ceiling surfaces prior to decoration.

name: Curtain Track Installation
description: The fixing of ceiling or wall-mounted curtain tracks across the alcove opening to enable privacy screening.

name: Wardrobe Unit
description: Built-in or freestanding storage furniture housing hanging rails, shelves, and drawers for garments.

name: Vanity Mirror
description: Large illuminated or non-illuminated mirror mounted or freestanding, used for grooming and outfit inspection.

name: Dressing Table
description: Dedicated flat-surface table with integrated or adjacent mirror used for make-up application and personal grooming.

name: Clothes Rail / Hanging Rod
description: Horizontal rod fixed to walls or within cabinetry providing a hanging point for garments on hangers.

name: Drawer Unit
description: Modular chest or integrated bank of drawers for folded clothing, accessories, and small items.

name: Island Unit
description: Freestanding central storage unit with drawers, display top, or padded seat, typical in luxury dressing rooms.

name: Seating / Ottoman
description: Upholstered seat or bench placed within the dressing room for comfort while dressing or putting on shoes.

name: Full-Length Mirror
description: Floor-to-ceiling or tall wall-mounted mirror enabling full-body outfit assessment.

name: Dimmer Switch
description: Electrical control device allowing adjustment of light intensity to suit different grooming and dressing tasks.

name: Electrical Outlet / Socket
description: Power point installed within the dressing room for hair dryers, steamers, phone chargers, and other grooming appliances.

name: Ventilation / HVAC Diffuser
description: Air supply or return grille ensuring adequate climate control and odour management within the enclosed space.

name: Flooring
description: Finish floor material—commonly carpet, hardwood, or luxury vinyl—selected for comfort underfoot and aesthetic cohesion.

name: Wall Finish / Panelling
description: Interior wall surface treatment such as paint, wallpaper, or timber panelling that defines the room's aesthetic character.
