description: The activity of applying painted finishes to ornamental surfaces, including faux marbling, wood graining, and polychrome schemes.

name: Facade Ornamentation System
description: The integrated assembly of decorative components—moldings, reliefs, quoins, and string courses—that together define the ornamental language of a building exterior.

name: Interior Decorative Scheme
description: A coordinated system of ceiling roses, cornices, friezes, and wall panels that establish the ornamental character of interior spaces.

name: IFC Annotation Element
description: The IFC class used to represent non-structural, informational, and ornamental elements attached to building components in a BIM model.

name: Red Wall Paint
description: A wall finish material in red hues used to evoke warmth and energy in interior spaces.

name: Orange Accent Tile
description: Ceramic or porcelain tiles in orange tones applied as accent surfaces to reinforce a warm color palette.

name: Yellow Ceiling Finish
description: A ceiling coating or paint in yellow shades that reflects light and contributes to a warm spatial atmosphere.

name: Terracotta Flooring
description: Earthen-toned floor tiles or pavers in terracotta red-orange that anchor a warm color scheme at floor level.

name: Amber Glazing Film
description: A translucent amber-tinted film applied to glass surfaces to cast warm-colored light into the space.

name: Warm-Toned Fabric Upholstery
description: Textile furnishing materials in red, orange, or gold that introduce warm color through soft surfaces.

name: Gold Metallic Finish
description: A metallic coating or leaf application in gold tones used on architectural details to enhance warmth.

name: Warm Color Lighting System
description: An artificial lighting system using bulbs or LEDs with a low color temperature (2700K–3000K) to reinforce warm hues.

name: Color Rendering Specification
description: A documented specification defining the CRI and color temperature targets that support warm color perception in the space.

name: Warm Color Accent Wall
description: A single feature wall finished in a deep warm color to serve as a focal point within the space.

name: Color Zoning Layout
description: A spatial planning strategy that delineates areas within a building where warm color palettes are consistently applied.

name: Interior Color Scheme Design
description: The design activity of selecting, coordinating, and documenting warm color palettes for all interior surfaces and finishes.

name: Surface Preparation for Color Application
description: The construction activity of priming and preparing walls, ceilings, and floors before applying warm-colored finishes.

name: Painting and Coating Application
description: The trade activity of applying warm-colored paints, stains, or coatings to interior surfaces per specification.

name: Tile and Stone Installation
description: The construction activity of laying warm-toned tiles, terracotta, or stone finishes on floors and walls.

name: Color Consultation
description: A professional service activity where a color consultant advises on warm palette selection aligned with spatial and psychological goals.

name: Warm Color Space
description: A designated interior zone intentionally designed and finished with a cohesive warm color palette throughout.

name: Sunroom
description: A glazed interior space that leverages natural sunlight to amplify warm color tones in finishes and furnishings.

name: IfcSpace (Color Zone)
description: An IFC model entity representing a spatial zone in a BIM model attributed with warm color finish properties.

name: Dining Chair
description: A standard four-legged chair designed for use at a dining table, typically with a supportive back.

name: Office Chair
description: An ergonomic, often wheeled chair designed for prolonged desk-based work with adjustable height and lumbar support.

name: Lounge Chair
description: A low-slung, reclined seating piece designed for relaxation in living or waiting spaces.

name: Rocking Chair
description: A chair mounted on curved runners allowing a gentle back-and-forth rocking motion.

name: Folding Chair
description: A lightweight, collapsible chair used for temporary or flexible seating arrangements.

name: Stacking Chair
description: A chair specifically designed to nest vertically on top of identical units for compact storage.

name: Bar Stool
description: A tall, leggy seat intended for use at bar counters or high tables, with or without a back.

name: Counter Stool
description: A mid-height stool designed for kitchen counters or breakfast bars, shorter than a bar stool.

name: Accent Chair
description: A decorative single chair used as a focal point or complementary piece in an interior design scheme.

name: Wheelchair
description: A mobility aid chair fitted with wheels, enabling movement for individuals with limited ambulation.

name: Gaming Chair
description: A bucket-seat style chair with ergonomic support and adjustable features optimised for extended gaming sessions.

name: Saddle Chair
description: A seat shaped like a horse saddle that promotes an upright posture by angling the hips forward.

name: Kneeling Chair
description: An ergonomic chair with a forward-tilted seat and knee rests designed to distribute body weight and improve spinal alignment.

name: Throne / Ceremonial Chair
description: A large, ornate chair associated with formal, ceremonial, or high-status settings in heritage or institutional buildings.

name: Cantilever Chair
description: A chair with no rear legs, instead using a continuous structural frame that flexes under load for a springy feel.

name: Chair Frame
description: The structural skeleton of a chair, fabricated from wood, metal, plastic, or composite materials.

name: Seat Cushion / Padding
description: Foam, latex, or fibre fill used inside chair seats and backs to provide softness and support.

name: Casters and Glides
description: Wheels or floor-contact pads attached to chair legs to enable rolling movement or protect flooring.

name: Lumbar Support Insert
description: A built-in or add-on cushioned pad positioned at the lower back zone of a chair to support spinal curvature.

name: Chair Leg Caps / Floor Protectors
description: Rubber or felt tips fitted to chair leg bottoms to prevent floor scratching and reduce noise.

name: Seating Zone / Furniture Layout Space
description: A designated floor area within a room planned and dimensioned to accommodate chair placement and user circulation.

name: Chair Storage Area
description: A dedicated room or cupboard space for housing folding or stacking chairs when not in use.

name: Chair Manufacturing and Procurement
description: The process of sourcing, ordering, and acquiring chairs from suppliers for installation in a building project.

name: Chair Installation and Placement
description: The physical activity of positioning and assembling chairs within a space according to a furniture layout plan.

name: Chair Upholstery Work
description: The trade activity of applying, replacing, or repairing fabric, leather, or padding on chair seats and backs.

name: Chair Maintenance and Repair
description: Scheduled or reactive servicing of chairs including tightening joints, replacing worn parts, and refinishing surfaces.

name: Ergonomic Assessment
description: A workplace evaluation activity that determines appropriate chair specifications to meet occupant health and safety requirements.

name: Furniture Schedule
description: A building information document or database systematically listing all chairs and furniture items with specifications, quantities, and locations.

name: Seating Layout System
description: An integrated planning system governing the arrangement, spacing, and accessibility of chairs within a building's occupiable spaces.

name: Oculus
description: A circular opening at the apex of a dome or ceiling that casts a dramatic, moving disc of light onto the interior below.

name: Diffuser Panel
description: A translucent screen or baffle used to scatter and soften direct light beams, creating soft, distributed luminous zones.

name: Solar Tube / Tubular Daylighting Device
description: A reflective cylindrical duct that captures rooftop sunlight and delivers a focused pool of diffused daylight to interior spaces below.

name: Reflective Floor Finish
description: A highly polished or light-toned floor surface such as terrazzo, polished concrete, or marble that visually amplifies pools of light falling upon it.

name: Translucent Ceiling Panel
description: A semi-transparent ceiling element in glass, polycarbonate, or stretched fabric that glows when back-lit, simulating a luminous sky plane.

name: Low-Iron Glass
description: A high-clarity, ultra-transparent glazing with minimal green tint used in skylights and apertures to maximise the quality and colour fidelity of admitted light.

name: Solar-Control Glazing Film
description: A spectrally selective coating or applied film that moderates solar heat gain while preserving visible light transmission through apertures.

name: White or Light-Reflectance Paint Finish
description: High-LRV interior wall and ceiling paint that bounces incident light deeper into a room, enlarging and brightening perceived pools of light.

name: Daylight Simulation & Modelling
description: Computational analysis using tools such as Radiance or Velux Daylight Visualizer to predict, optimise, and document light pool size, intensity, and movement.

name: Solar Path Analysis
description: Study of the sun's seasonal and daily trajectory relative to a building to determine when and where natural light pools will form on interior surfaces.

name: Aperture Positioning & Sizing
description: Architectural design activity focused on determining the optimal location, orientation, and dimensions of openings to produce intended light pool effects.

name: Skylight Installation
description: Construction activity involving the structural cutting, framing, waterproofing, and glazing of roof apertures to introduce overhead daylighting.

name: Light Shelf Installation
description: Fabrication and fixing of horizontal reflective shelf assemblies at window heads as part of a daylighting enhancement strategy.

name: Glare Control Assessment
description: Evaluation and mitigation of excessive luminance contrast caused by concentrated pools of sunlight that may cause visual discomfort to occupants.

name: Sun Room / Solarium
description: A glazed room or conservatory designed to maximise solar penetration, creating immersive, bath-like environments of pooled natural light.

name: Interstitial Ceiling Plenum
description: The concealed void above a suspended ceiling used to route light from remote sources—such as solar tubes or fibre optics—to controlled delivery points below.

name: Personal Storage Room
description: A dedicated room or area within a building designed to store personal belongings, mementos, and life possessions.

name: Display Shelving Unit
description: Open or closed shelving designed to display personal collections, photographs, and decorative objects.

name: Memory Wall
description: A dedicated wall surface configured to mount and display personal photos, artwork, and memorabilia.

name: Trophy and Award Cabinet
description: A glazed or open cabinet specifically designed to house and display trophies, medals, and personal achievements.

name: Media Storage Unit
description: A shelving or cabinet system designed to organize books, vinyl records, CDs, DVDs, and other personal media collections.

name: Home Archive Room
description: A climate-controlled or secure room used to preserve important personal documents, photographs, and records.

name: Hobby Workshop Space
description: A dedicated area equipped for personal hobbies such as crafting, model-making, or painting.

name: Keepsake Storage Box System
description: Modular box or drawer systems specifically sized and organized for storing sentimental keepsakes and heirlooms.

name: Climate Control System
description: An HVAC or environmental control system maintaining temperature and humidity to preserve sensitive personal belongings.

name: Lighting System for Display
description: Specialized ambient and accent lighting systems designed to highlight and illuminate displayed personal items.

name: Custom Millwork
description: Bespoke timber or composite joinery crafted to create personalized storage and display solutions tailored to specific collections.

name: Archival Storage Material
description: Acid-free, pH-neutral materials such as boxes, sleeves, and folders used to safely preserve photographs, documents, and textiles.

name: Anti-UV Glazing
description: Specialized glass or acrylic panels that filter ultraviolet light to protect displayed items from fading and degradation.

name: Installation of Storage Systems
description: The construction activity of fitting, anchoring, and assembling built-in or modular storage units within a space.

name: Wall Preparation and Mounting
description: The activity of preparing wall surfaces and installing fixings, rails, or framing to support display systems and shelving.

name: Climate Control Installation
description: The activity of installing HVAC, dehumidification, or sealed environment systems to preserve sensitive stored items.

name: IfcStorageDevice
description: The IFC class representing devices or enclosures used for storing objects, applicable to archive boxes, cabinets, and secure safes.

name: Antique and Heirloom Display Case
description: A sealed or climate-controlled glazed case designed to safely display fragile antiques and inherited family heirlooms.

name: Personal Library / Reading Nook
description: A dedicated intimate space with built-in bookshelves and seating for housing and engaging with a personal book collection.

name: Safe Room / Valuables Vault
description: A reinforced, secure room or enclosure used to store highly valuable personal items such as jewellery, documents, and collectibles.

name: Pegboard and Tool Storage Wall
description: A perforated panel wall system used in hobby or workshop spaces to organize and display personal tools and equipment.

name: Humidity and Moisture Barrier
description: Vapour-resistant materials applied to walls, floors, or ceilings to protect stored personal items from damp and moisture damage.
